tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi rtogs brjod ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi rtogs brjod ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi rtogs brjod ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rten cing 'brel 'byung chos// thugs su chud nas 'gro la 'dom mdzad cing*// ma rig srid mtsho las sgrol thar lam 'god// ston pa thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs theg pa'i rim pa bsam yas las// zab dang rgya che'i bka' bsdu rgyal ba'i sras// mkhyen rab bdag po rgyal tshab ma pham pa// shing rta gnyis dang brgyud pa'i bla mar 'dud// thugs nyid ye shes rnam par dag pa las// rang bzhin 'dzad pa med pa'i thugs rje 'phro// rang shes rig pa chos nyid kun tu bzang*// ston pa rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// de nyid ngang las rigs lnga gtso dang 'khor// grangs med bsam 'das nyid kyi longs spyod du// rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen por 'od 'bar ba// mkha' khyab rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud par 'dud// ston pa'i yon tan dgu bcu rtsa drug chos// gnad kyi brda la brten nas mngon sum rtogs// zag pa rang zad dbyings su sku gshegs pa// brda brgyud rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro zhing*// gsang sngags brtul zhugs spyod pa'i thabs la mkhas// gdul bya'i rgyud sbyong gangs can 'gro ba 'dul// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// kun tu bzang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// zhal nas snyan brgyud tshig don spros pa chod// sprul pa'i gang zag sa dang lam la dbang*// snyan brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// kun mkhyen yab sras brgyud pa rin po che// man ngag gsang ba chen po'i snyan brgyud la// tshig la lhag chad don la nor 'khrul med// ji bzhin rtogs pa'i pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// bum pa gang byos chad lhag med pa ltar// gsang chen man ngag nges pa'i rtogs brjod 'di// gab sbas tshig bsgyur phri bsnan med pa ru// skal bzang gdul bya slob ma'i don du spro// de yang bdag gi rjes su 'jug cing mos pa can gyi gang zag rnams kyi ngor/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas da lta'i rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rim par byon pa'i gong ma dag gi rang rang gi rnam thar 'god pa'i srol yod pa ltar/ 'dir yang brgyud pa khungs la thug cing man ngag nges pa'i khyad par gyi che ba ston pa'i phyir cung zad 'god na/ snyigs dus kyi chos smra'i ming tsam 'dzin pa bdag ni thog mtha' mi mngon pa'i srid pa'i grong khyer mtho dman du snang ba'i gnas ris bsam gyis mi khyab par las kyi gzhan dbang gis kha lo drangs nas dbang med du 'khyams pa tsam las de dang de 'dra ba'i sa lam gyi mngon rtogs khyad par can lta ci/ tshogs lam gyi sne zin pa tsam gyi yon tan dang mngon par rtogs pa'i cha phra mo tsam yang ma mchis par ma zad/ ji skad du/ lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ rang gi yon tan brjod pa ni// lha dbang yin yang btsun ma lags// zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi yon tan brjod pa skabs su ma bab mod/ 'on kyang rang la mos pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang pos snga phyir bskul ba don yod par bya ba'i phyir rang rgyud la skyon gyi phung po sa rdul tsam 'tshubs pa'i khrod na yon tan gyi cha su war+ṇa'i khams yod par bshad pa tsam gyi dpe zlar song yang*/ gnas tshul drang po sgro skur dang bral bar mdo tsam smros pa la gsum/ dang po skyes nas byis lo nar ma son pa'i bar dang*/ chos kyi bsam pa skye ba'i 'go dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pas dam pa bsten cing mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs ris su ma chad par thos bsam ji ltar sbyang ba dang*/ rang nyams la med kyang gzhan don ltar snang la 'jug pa'i khur 'dzin tshul rnams cung zad 'god pa las/ dang po ni/ mkha' 'gro snying thig las/ gsal rje gangs kyi shar phyogs su// lcags sgrom 'bar ba lta bu'i stod// 'brong pho nyal 'dra'i dpyi steng na// sogs lung gcig gis skye phreng du ma bstan pa 'dra tshod 'ol spyi tsam du bsgrub na/

de yang mdo khams chu bzhi sgang drug ces grags pa'i nang tshan 'bri zla zal mo sgang dang nye ba'i cha gnas chen nyer lnga'i ya gyal kaḥthog sham po rong gi ra ba'i phrin las kyi gnas mchog sngon byon 'phags pa'i skyes bu mkhas grub du mas bsten pa'i gling rmog pad+ma brag dkar gyi nye 'dabs su smug po sdong gi rigs las mched pa dkar po gling gi brgyud pa la che rgyud/ chung rgyud/ 'bring rgyud gsum mchis pa'i nang nas chung rgyud las mched pa/ lha ru'i jag pa mi bdun las gling phrug a bkra zer ba'i rgyud las smyo shul zhes grags pa'i 'brog sde nyung ngu zhig gi nang pha rnam rgyal dang*/ ma rdza stod 'ju ba zhes pa'i sde tshan 'gru chu khams pa'i brgyud pad+ma mtsho gnyis bsdebs pa'i bur rab byung bco lnga pa'i myos ldan zhes pa sa mo yos kyi lo/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu'i snga dror khro rda snyag shar zhes pa 'brong bu nyal ba'i dpyi steng 'dra ba der skye ba'i myu gu gsar du sad pa'i dus su tshon shar ba dang rol mo'i sgra thos par bshad rgyu 'dug skyes nas zhag gsum nangs par snga dro ting nge 'dzin gyi 'dug stangs kyis oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sogs sngags brgya skor nye ba bsgrangs bar grags/ de nas bzung byis pa mgo lcog thub pa ngu ba dang mal sa btsog par mi byed pa sogs yon tan khyad par can yod pa zhig yin zhes ma la gleng rgyu 'dug rang gis da lta ched du blo gtad na skyes nas da bar gyi bya byed phal mo che dran pa la gsal lhag ger 'char/ byis pa zla ba brgyad tsam nas gog 'gros la ma ltos par langs nas rgyug thub pa tsam du song bas 'brog pa rgan rabs la byis pa chung ngu langs snga na rnam rtog rtsi srol yod pas rgan po rnams nas ngan par rtsis/ de'i dgun zhig na ma'i rum du nyal bas mtshan dkyil gyi dus mnal sad pa'i snang ba la ma de bud med nag mo bzhin gnyer zhing mche ba gtsigs pa zhig gis skra dmar ser gyi chun pos nged lcibs snang gis 'jigs ste/

a ma zhes bos pas mas ci zer nga 'di na yod zer ba dang ma ji bzhin du 'dug de nas bzung smra shes pa zhig byung*/ yang de'i dgun der mtshan mo zhig la nged ma bu gnyis shin tu grang ngar gyis gtser 'dug pa la bdag gis rlung bzung nas gtum mo cung zhig bsgom pas bde drod kyis ma de me dpung khar 'dug pa ltar bsran mi bzod pa tsam du gyur nas bdag ma'i rum nas phyir bton te mi mi 'dra ba'i 'dre phrug khyod su yin zer bas bdag gis ma la/ nga shar kha bla brang phyogs ded nas// rlung gtum mo gnyis la rang dbang thob// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i grub thob yin// ngo shes na a lag rig grwa yin// zhes glu blang bas ma nas mi shes mi shes zer/ mar rum du shed 'dren byas nas phyin chad mi sngon la de 'dra'i 'di yin de min gyi lab bshad ma mang*/ nyin gcig nged kyi bla ma yin zer ba'i nges nges tig tig zhig byung na mi sbyin thabs med ma gtogs de min rang bzhin gtam mang po de ma bshad ces sbran byung bar de phan de rigs kyi lab gleng gtan nas ma bgyis/ phyir nangs a phyi rgan mo zhig yod pas mdang sum khyed ma bu gnyis nas ci bshad 'dug ces dris byung bar mas min min kho gnyid sad byed pa red ces lab song*/ rgyun par rmi lam na rgya gar du yin snyam pa'i ljongs yid du 'ong ba bkod pa smra mi shes pa zhig tu bha seng nags kyi dur khrod dang dur khrod chen po tha chung gnyis su res mos kyis res rab tu byung ba dang*/ res rnal 'byor spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyis rgyu ba'i snang ba rtag tu 'char ba dang*/ sngags kyi srung ma dang drang srong chen po gnyis kyi dngos gzugs dang sprul pa ci rigs pas bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad/ 'di skor nas lo bcu gsum ma lon par dgongs mo sa rub tsam na nam mkha' nas ging chen dgu bya rgod kyi rnam par brdzus te sa la babs 'phral keng rus dgur gnas gyur te nga rang la bskor tshul gyis 'khrab pa dang*/

rgyug pa dang*/ gar byed pa'i tshul gyis mdun du 'khod tsam la nged rang gi lag par bdud rtsi ril bu 'dra ba re sbyin rgyu byung ba de ster ba dang 'khrab pa sogs dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mang pos nam mkhar dengs 'gro ba rtag tu byung*/ lo gcig tsam lon pa dang a phyi byams po byed pa zhig yod pa des ma ma bgyis nas mtshan mo rgyun par de'i rum du nyal ba la*/gnyid kyi mgor zin tsam nas rna bar 'brug gi sgra lta bu'i gdangs shin tu che ba grags pas rkyen byas/ snang ba thams cad gangs la nyi ma phog pa ltar dkar lam mer song*/ yud tsam nas de gnas 'gyur te 'od dmar po 'thug shas che ba sprin dmar 'dra bas g.yogs nas sems 'thum la khad khad zhig tu gnas/ yang snang ba de yang dkar la mthing shas che ba'i nang du dril nas sems shin tu 'thum nas ci yang mi dran par gyur pa dang*/ ji zhig na sems stong gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba ngos bzung med pa zhig tu gnas/ de dang mnyam du rang gi snang ba thams cad kha dog lngas khyab pa de'i nang na 'od zer shing phung 'dra ba mang po dang thig le che phra bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po las 'od zer mu med par mched pa dang*/ khyad par du 'od mtshon cha 'dra ba mang po mig la zug pas 'tsher snang gis mtshan mo nyal mi phod par a phyi la smras pas rum du sgron me btegs nas ci yang mi 'dug ces brda sprod dgos pa yod/ lo ngo gsum tsam gyis sos thog cig tu mdzo mo'i rto le zhig 'dam rdzab gyi khrod na 'chi mi thub par skad 'don bzhin par 'gyel 'dug pa mthong bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la kho sngar yang las ngan gyi rgyus 'bras bu lus ngan blang bas da lta sdug bsngal 'di lta bu'i khur gyis non bzhin da dung yang sdug bsngal 'di 'dra kho na las mi 'ong bas/ 'dam 'di nas 'don mkhan gyi mgon skyabs gang nas 'tshol/ kho'i sdug bsngal gyi khur nga la babs snyam nas rto le 'dam nas bton te sa gtsang sa zhig tu bzhag

'pho ba'i dmigs rnam gzhan ma shes kyang rnam par shes pa 'od dkar po sran ma tsam du bsam nas steng gi nam mkhar 'phen dgos snyam pas bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ phaṭa phaṭaḥmang po brjod pas dbugs 'gro ba dang mnyam du spyi bo nas rlangs pa chu tshan phyur ba bzhin byung ba dang mnyam du skra rtags byi zhing thod pa'i rus pa mthe bong tsam gog 'dug ces grags/ khu bo bla ma bgres song zhig yod pa des de rnams mi phal pa'i spyod tshul ma yin kyang dgos pa med pas su la'ang ma bshad ces gleng song*/ de'i rkyen byas nas de phan sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can mthong thos su gyur pa rnams la snying rje nas mi bzod pa shugs 'byung du byung*/ 'khor ba'i snang tshul skyid sdug mtho dman 'byor rgud gang la'ang yid brtan med pas 'khor ba 'di las thar pa'i thabs shig ci drag snyam pa'i dus rgyun par sems skyo lhang nge ba dang*/ dman sprang lta bu nam mthong dus de la sbyin rgyu zhig ngos lkog gang rung nas ji rnyed byas nas byin/ sprang po de dang 'grogs nas ru skor mang po ma 'khor bar 'gro 'dug mkhan zhig yin par pha ma rnams nas 'dis byed lugs gang la'ang la nye yag po mi 'dug ces gleng par thos/ dman pa'i sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pa'i dus nam 'ong snyam pa'i blo rgyun chad med par byung bas bsam pa bzang po 'di lhan skyes su yod pa de tsam theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi nus pa phra ba zhig e yin snyam pa 'di bdag gi rnam par thar pa'i gtso bo lags/ yi ge drug ma rgyun par bgrangs bas bye chen gcig tsam gyi grangs su longs/ bdag skyes pa'i khyim gnag phyugs shin tu mang ba phyug por rtsi rgyu zhig yin gshis lo re la bshas lug mang po gsod pas de nam mthong gi dus nyin re tsam ri la bros nas snying rje sran mi bzod pa tsam gyi ngang la 'di dag skyob pa'i nus pa bdag la ni med snyam yid chad drag pos mchi ma char bzhin 'byin pa zhig yod/

yang rang lo lngar phyin pa'i dgun smad zhig la zog 'brog steng nged ma bu gnyis phyin/ ring mo dil rgyug zer ba'i sa cha dog po zhig gi mdar sdod pa bgyis pas sos kha nyin re bzhin lung phran de yi stod kyi gangs chus phyugs lhas dang nged ma bur sbra chung zhig yod pa shwa 'ud kyis 'ded du cha ba la/ mas nyin bzhin chu rag bgyis kyang mi khegs pas dka' tshegs chen po byung bar/ nyin gcig bdag gis shing snyags ma la phur bu'i dbyibs bcos pa zhig yod pa chu byung ba'i dus de bzung nas/ nga rgya gar yul na bi ma la// chu bo gaṅgā bzlog nus na// lung pa'i chu phran smos ci 'tshal// ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo a mas ltos// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces smras shing phur pa bsgril bas chu 'ud de rlung gis ded pa bzhin pha tshad du log song bas/ ma nas go bcad go bcad zer shwa 'ud log shul da lta'ang snang*/ lo ngo bdun par slebs dus khu bos da yi ge zhig bslab dgos zer nas ka smad sum cu pa bris te bslab/ khong gis ka gsung dus ngas kha zhes bskyar zlos ma byas pas he sngon rgyug ma byed 'bru re re nas ltos la thon ma gtogs mi 'ong gsungs/ de bzhin tshar gnyis gsum zhig bslab pas blo la 'don chog pa byung*/ khu bo ma mnyes par bka' bkyon stabs kyis yi ge 'bru thog nas ma nges nas blo 'don 'dra ba 'dis mi thar zer ba yi ge mi shes pa'i tshad du brtsi rgyu zhig yod pa de la dpe blang nas mi thar 'dra ba zhig las mi 'ong gsungs te thur ma zhig gtad 'bru re re nas thur ma tshugs la thon gsungs pa ltar bgyis pas/ e e da bzang spyod zhig bslab na chog par 'dug zer nas bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa zhig 'bru ded bslab byung ba zhag nyi shu skor thog bdag byis par song bas nam rgyun sngon la nyal bar nub gcig khong rnams srod kyi ja btung ba'i skabs bdag gnyid sad 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis bzang spyod dbu mjug tshang ba tshar gcig bklag pas khu bo mnyes nas yi ge slob mi dgos par 'dug gsungs te bslab 'phro bshol/

rjes sor kaḥthog chos spyod kyi dpe cha zhig gtad nas 'di thon gsungs/ de bzhin bton pas da thos grol zhig 'don shes na khyod klog bzang ba'i rtags yin zhes dpe cha zhig gtad byung bar nga rang gi yin pa la los shes zhus te bklag pas btags grol nang sngags 'ga' zhig brjod mi bde ba bcos/ gzhan bcos dgos pa ye ma byung bas ngo mtshar bar brtsi/ de dus 'bru ded ma byas pa'i skyon gyis da lta 'bru ded 'grigs po zhig mi lo ba 'di yin/ da pad+ma bka' thang zhig sbyangs dgos phebs par tshar mang du bton pa'i rkyen gyis bod ljongs 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas kun las bka' drin dang thugs rje bla na ma mchis pa khong kho na yin snyam mos gus blo gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa'i nges pa rnyed nas tshig bdun ma'i gsol 'debs dang badz+ra gu ru kho na bgrangs/ mtshan mo rmi lam na'ang skrag snang byung dus o rgyan mkhyen ces dran thub pa zhig byung*/ yang skabs shig na bdag bud med gcig gis sna khrid de lho nub phyogs kyi nam mkhar bya ltar 'phur nas song song ba las/ ji zhig na yul khams mi 'dra ba du ma mthong ba bud med des so sor brda sprad/ de nas rgyal khab chen po lcags ris bskor ba zhig mthong ba'i mod la de'i byang phyogs kyi sgor babs pas/ mtsho rgyal gyis dal gyi bum pa zhig gis khrus byas byung ba dang mnyam du skyes pa dkar po dam can yin rgyu ba zhig gis lcags ri'i shar sgo nas nang du khrid pas zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang tshad dang ldan pa mjal ba'i lho sgo nas nang du thon/ bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su shin tu mdzes pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad zhig gi steng sder so'i rnam pa lta bu'i gu ru mtshan brgyad bzhugs snang bar mos gus drag pos rdo rje tshig bdun mas gsol ba btab pas sngar mthong ba'i sder so'i shun pa de na bun ltar yal nas gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi sku dngos su gyur/

bzhugs gdan gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma re re'i steng stong gsum 'jig rten gyi bkod pa re re gsal bar snang*/ de na ston pa re dang gu ru re yang bzhugs/ gu ru'i mdun nas dbang zhig thob pa phyis bsam na rad gling thugs sgrub kyi dbang de 'dra/ khyod 'di nas lo nyer lnga na lha'i bu dbang phyug gi ming can zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan thob pa de phyis rang lo nyer lngar dpe cha rdzogs pa 'di la dgongs pa 'dra snyam/ klog sbyang skabs nas byis pa shed ma phye ba zhig gis don gyi gting dpog par dka' yang tshig de'i dngos bstan de 'di 'dra zhig yin snyam pa'i don lam tsam blo la 'char/ lo ngo brgyad pa'i dbyar thog der pha rgan nas khal ma mang po 'dod pa'i sna bskor khrid bzhin song ba khal sna ma lon par kho tshig pa zos nas mang du 'thab byung bas rkyen byas/ 'khor ba 'di'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig tu snang bas chos shig nges par bsgrub dgos/ de yang gnyen bshes kyi 'khri ba btsan thabs su chod pa zhig ma byung phyin 'khor ba'i 'ching thag kho nar snang bas nges med kyi rgyal khams 'grim nas gyong lto gos la bskur/ bla ma bzang po re dang mjal ba dang chos gsha' ma zhig nges par sgrub dgos snyam pa de zhe thag bcad/ ma la blo babs 'byung min zhib tu bltas nas blo babs zhig byung phyin 'gro dgos snyam/ de tshul gyi rgyu mtshan rgyas par ma la bsnyad kyang mas khyod 'dres brlam pa yin nam/ byis pa chung ngu khyod 'dra ba chos bros la phyin pas khyi ngo yang mi lon/ lto yang mi phyid/ khyis za ba'am mu ges 'chi ba las 'os med/ re zhig sdod dang lus skyed rdzogs dus bla ma bzang po nye skor 'dir yang yod pas chos nus na chog sogs rgyu mtshan zhib par mol byung bas de ga'i ngang du lus/ skyid sdug mtho dman gang la yang yid gtad med par sdug bsngal gyis rang bzhin 'ba' zhig la nges 'byung bcos mi dgos par shugs 'byung du shar/

gu ru chos dbang gi gter byon sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum de kha ton du bcangs bas der mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po dang*/ chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs gnyis kyi mtshan gyi phan yon mthong bas rang nas kyang sems can gyi don du 'di lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig ma thob na thabs mi 'dug sangs rgyas de 'dra zhig byung na sems can dung phyur bgrangs kyis mi langs ba 'khor ba las bsgral nas sangs rgyas de 'dra ba'i go 'phang la bdag gcig pus 'god snyam pa rgyun par blo la bcags/ rang bzhin gyi byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas kyang dran shes bag yod gsum gyis rtsed mo dang 'phyar g.yeng la shin tu rgyud bsdams pa dang*/ khyad par bud med ma gtam smra ba dang rtsed mo sogs la shin tu ngo tsha'i gnas su bgyis pas rgan po rnams nas ming yang byis pa bla ma zhes 'bod/ nyin re bzhin chos spyod blo 'dzin ldeb mthug lnga bcu re snga dro re la 'dzin thub pa byung*/ rjes sor rdzogs chen dgon du slob gnyer la yod dus dbyar gnas 'don cha yongs rdzogs sdom gsum rnam nges dang bcas pa nyin gcig gi khongs su 'dzin nus pa byung bas dge phyogs kyi grwa pa zhig yin na dge bshes blo 'dzin bzang por brtsi ba zhig 'ong tshod du yod/ zhe chen rab 'byams 'di phyogs su phebs skabs khong tshang gi sprul sku yin pas bslu gtad dgos tshul sogs phebs shing ming bstan pa rab 'phel du btags/ de rjes rdzogs sprul rin po che dgung lo bco brgyad pa'i thog dbyar sgar du phebs dus gtsug phud bzhes/ ming gzhon nu pad+ma legs grub ces btags/ de rjes dzi phu bco brgyad zhabs drung mkhan chen blo gros rgya mtsho zhes pas sa lugs kun rig gi dbang gnang*/ ming ngag dbang dpal bzang po zhes btags/ 'phan po nā len drar 'gro na bstan 'gror phan pa'i zhal bsgos bzang po dang phyi lor slar yang khams su phebs rgyu dkrig chod yin pas de dus 'gro dgos zhes gsungs par phyir lo khong yang gshegs nas 'gro ma thub/

mi tshang gcig gi rim gror tshogs pa mang po'i gral du phyin/ zab mdo dang sgrol ma 'don gral du bsdad pas bdag ja 'dren la bab/ ban rgan sangs rgyas 'od zer bya ba zhig la ja drangs tshul legs por ma byung bas khong tshig pa zos nas mig gis ltos la ja drongs zhes 'thab byung*/ ngas mig gis ji lta/ de ring nyin gcig gi ring la mig med rna ba med ces bton pa min nam byas pas khos 'don med lugs ci 'dra yin zer dang po khyod kyi yod tshul zhig zhog dang byas pas khong gis a tsi ham pa la he he zer/ ngas kyang med tshul ji bzhin smra ma shes pas don la mno bsam btang gin bsdad/ phyi shig tu khyim tshang gi ru ba 'khyil ko zer sar skyas byas nas bdag dgong mor phyugs bsdur phyin pas mig phye la kha zer bar 'jag ma'i spyil bu mang por dge slong mang zhig bzhugs 'dug pa la dge slong gcig gi mdun du phyin nas khyed su yin dris pas/ nga zla ba grags pa'o gsungs/ byin rlabs zhus/ sngon zhig la mi tshang gcig par zab mdo 'don gral du phyin pas mig med rna ba med sogs la ban bgres zhig dang tshag rtsid bgyis pas khos yod tshul dang*/ ngas maid tshul 'jog ma shes pas ji ltar lags zhus pas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag khong du chud pa las yod med 'jog dgos gsungs/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min// lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad ma min// gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad yin na// 'phags pa'i lam gyis su la ci zhig bya// zhes pa'i tshigs bcad de gsungs/ de'i don ji ltar lags zhus pas/ da dung khyod byis pa blo gros kyi shed la phye ba yin pas 'phral du go mi nus/ rim pas tshig de la dpyod dang go rgyu yod 'ong gsungs/ chos shig gsung bar zhus pas dpe cha po ti zhig mgor bzhag te 'di dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa yin zhes sngags 'dra ba mang po zhig gsung nas paṇa zhwa ser po rnying nyams can zhig dang dpe cha de gnyis gnang byung bar zhus/

khyim pa rnams rnam rtog tsha bas sbra mthong tsam gyi brag stong zhig tu bzhag khyim du phyin pas khyod de tsam ji la 'gor zer/ gong gi rgyu mtshan rgyas par bsnyad kyang rdzun ma lab/ sa stong na dgon pa yod don med/ yod na mi ma yin yin 'gro/ khyod rang yang der bsdad na chog pa la/ sa stong na zhwa dang yi ge 'dra rnyed rgyu yod na ste dga' mo zer nas rtsis su mi byed/ phyir nangs tsam na khu bos lo rgyus thos nas zhwa dang dpe cha khyer shog gsungs/ sngar shul bltar phyin pas mi snang ngo*// de yan ni rang nyid byis pa chung ngu'i dus kyi bya byed kyi rnam thar rags rim yid la dran rigs lhug par brjod pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ ༈ /theg pa gsum gyi yang dag pa'i lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa rnams lam rkyen bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten pa la rag las shing*/ de yang shing rta chen po zung gi lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams la thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab yang dag pas rang don du lam gyi rtogs pa bskyed pa dang*/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i snang bas ma khyab pa'am khyab kyang nyams par gyur pa'i phyogs thams cad du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i ring lugs nyin mo'i snang ba bzhin gsal bar byed pa ni dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar ba'i gnas yin na'ang de lta bu'i yon tan dngos gnas rang rgyud la shin tu phra yang*/ 'on kyang sngon byon dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su yid kyi 'dun pa phyogs pa tsam la dgag bya'i gnas chung ba dang*/ so thar gzhi chog las/ shākya gtso bo de'i/ rjes su slob bo// rjes su sgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'dir yang dang po lam rkyen bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji ltar mjal ba'i thog ma ni/

sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba rgyal sras byang chub rdo rje'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes dpal sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal slob rgyu skar phreng ba'i dbus na chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor bzhin mkhyen pa'i rtsal/ brtse ba'i snying rje/ nus mthu byin rlabs/ rtogs pa nyams myong gang la yang bsgrun du ma mchis par chos ldan bde chen po'i ljongs 'di tsam na grags shing grub pa ste/ rdza stod pa'i ngag rgyun la/ smyo shul lung rtogs med na dpal dge rabs chad yin/ zer ba'i dpe bzhin dam pa 'di las gling gi lung byang las mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang*/ rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos kong smyon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dang rje dbon kun grol rnam rgyal yin par lung bstan/ gang ltar yang o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po mi lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du nye gnas tshul gyis 'bral med bsten/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams la thos bsam dpyis phyin pa dang*/ khyad par zab rgyas kyi lam thun min rnams dang*/ man ngag gsang ba snying thig gi lam gnad mthar thug pa shes bya'i gshis las 'das pa'i rang gnas kyi ye shes mngon sum rang thog tu ngo sprod pa nyams len mthar thug pa ka dag khregs chod dang*/ sku gsum lam snang du ngo sprod pa 'od gsal thod rgal gyi rim pa gnyis po bum pa gang byos tshul du gsan nas de yang go thos tsam du ma bzhag par de'i don lung rigs kyi skya bar nas tshig gi zhun thar bcad/ bsam pa'i shes rab kyis don gyi gnas gtan la phabs/ de'i don dpon slob gnyis kas dben pa'i ri khrod du sgom pa nyams bzhes kyi srang la gzhal/ sgro 'dogs kyi gnas lhag ma ma lus par chod pas rgyud kyi rdo rje'i gnas rnams dang thugs rgyud zhus dag 'pher bar mdzad/ slar yang dbon bstan 'dzin nor bu dang*/ mkhan dkon mchog 'od zer/

me nyag kun bsod/ nag thal sprul sku bcas nang chen ri bo cher sku tshe ril po la bya bral bsod snyoms kyi 'tsho ba kho nas dus 'da' bar dgongs nas a bu rin po cher zhus kyang ma gnang bar dkon mchog 'od zer rdzogs chen dgon du mkhan po bsko 'jags mdzad/ khyed gsum rang yul du song la ri khrod re zungs/ dbon po tshang nas nged kyi dge mang dgon par 'chad nyan ci nus su gyis gsungs pa bzhin bla ma bka' drin can lung rtogs rin po che 'di phyogs su phebs shing gdan sa'i gtso bo ljon pa lung 'dir mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug la lo bcu/ ngal gso skor gsum la lo gsum ste snga phyi lo bcu gsum gyi bar la thugs sbyong gnang*/ zhal kyal gyi tshul du ngas sngar shug gu shar nas lo bcu gsum gyi bar du rnam rtog bkye bsdu kho na byas pas yar 'phar ma bcug dang po nas rdzogs pa chen po kho na bsgom na da tsam na lta sgom bzang po re 'ong thang ba la gsungs/ gzhan yang rdzongs nag dang*/ zangs nga ma/ dkar sdengs ri khrod/ gnam skong*/ 'or li ma/ rgya sdug ri khrod rnams su lo shas re bzhugs/ de bar gshin gson gyi dkor ye ma bzhes/ rjes sor grub chen sgar du phebs nas lo dgur bzhugs ring byung ba'i dad 'bul gyi dngos rdzas rnams mchod sbyin gyi tshogs su bsngos nas snga phyir spong dag lan bdun mdzad/ bka' gdams pa chen po dag gi ring lugs gtsang ma bdag gir bzhes nas rgyal bu 'brom ston pa'i rnam thar lta bur byung zhing mdo sngags kyi gzhung lam nas bshad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ma tshang ba maid pa nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid rgya sdug ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i dus/ rang nyid lo lngar son pa chu lug gsar 'char kyi dus phas khrid nas mjal du phyin/ de nas bzung tshad med pa'i bka' drin dang thugs rjes bskyangs pa ste/ 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid ni dus phyis kyi mkhas grub tu rlom pa phal mo che ltar zol sbyor gyi grags skam phran bus thugs rgyud khengs nas 'jig rten gyi rmi lam bzang po tsam byung na'ang sa lam mthon po'i yon tan du bcos nas dkor gyi gzi byin don du gnyer bya'i gtso bo dang skyid nyal gyis grub pa'i go sar phyin pa dag ltar tshul 'chos gyi mgo skor rigs cung zad kyang mi mnga'/

bdag yun ring por sku rtsar bcar ba'i skabs su gsung 'phros phebs pa las khong rdzogs chen gangs khrod du mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i zhabs brtan du lo gsum bzhugs skabs khong la 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ni cher med/ rdzogs chen bla brang yang da dus dang mi 'dra bar sgog sgog zhig las med pas sgrub brgyag gnang rgyu yang dkon/ a bu bka' drin can nas kyang ci yang gnang ma byung stabs 'tsho ba bkren po zhig gi ngang lo gsum song*/ na bza' yang nang gos sha 'gags rnying pa zhig dang chos gos gsum las med/ gdan gyi dod rdo leb zhig la byas pa yin/ lo gsum gyi dam bca' zin 'phral a bu'i mdun mjal du phyin pas khyod 'tsho ba sdug po byung ngo gsungs/ 'tsho ba ye med kyang nyid kyi bka' yin pa dang mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i zhabs brtan la dmigs pas skyid po byung zhus par/ a bus/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ma nyams na// 'tsho ba snang srid lha 'dres sbyor// zer ba de khyod 'dra la zer ba yin gsungs/ 'tsho ba lha 'dres sbyor lugs ci yang gsung las ma phebs/ yang phran la khyed rnams nas chos zhu ba tsam las nyams len la rtsis su mi byed/ nyams su blangs na chos pa rab la zhag skyed/ 'bring la zla skyed/ tha ma la lo skyed mi 'ong ba mi srid/ de yang chos nyams su len pa la gnad shes dgos pa yin/ nyams su blangs kyang skyed mi 'ong ba gnad ma shes pa'i rtags yin/ rgyal bu 'brom ston pas chos la thos bsam sgom gsum dkrugs dmar byed pa ni chos kyi gnad ma nor ba yin gsungs/ khong rnams la dpal sprul rin po ches chos thun re gnyis gsung nas da sgom dgos gsungs/ yun ring du sgom 'jug khong dpon slob ko 'or ma na bzhugs dus khong la ma rgan nas dbyar tshe 'o ma nam srub skabs mar bu lu re zur du bcad nas snga ma'i steng phyi ma bslan pa'i grod thum zhig bskur byung ba'i mar de a bu rin po cher gsol tsam nang drang bar brtsam pa la gzigs nas cung zhig bzhugs/

khyod kyi mar de lcum gyi 'bog tho 'dra ba ci yin gsungs/ lo rgyus zhus pas/ 'o na ngas za mi bde gsungs nas ma bzhes/ nyin gcig khyod nas a ma dran nam gsungs/ de tsam mi dran lags zhus pas/ 'o snying rje ma bsgom pas lan/ da pha gi lcang ma'i nang song la mar shes drin dran sogs zhag bdun bsgom la shog gsungs/ de bzhin du zhag bdun ring mar shes drin dran sogs bsgoms pas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyes pa zhig byung*/ sku mdun du de tshul zhus pas 'o de yin bsgom na rgyud la skye ba chos nyid yin/ de 'dra ba dgos/ ngas de sngon khyod la dkor ma za byas kyang da res kyi theb 'dir za rgyu ci rnyed gyis la re zhig ma rgan dang 'phrad du song la slar shog gsungs/ a bu'i ma 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs la phyin pas rta pho gcig dang dngul srang bcu gnang*/ de'i steng rdza chu kha nas yid lhung bar ldom bu zhig byas pas ja sbag re zung dang zog cha shas rnyed pa ma rgan la sprad/ dkor ngan de phar ded na rnyed rgyu zhig min/ mi dgos dus tshur steng du spungs pa ltar byed 'dug gsungs/ yang skabs shig na khong dpon slob rdo a ris nags nang du sku gsum gyi ja bskol rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso sogs ngal gso skor gsum po bshad kyin sgom gyin nyams khrid du bskyangs pas sgyu ma ngal gso bsgom dus shig tu nga'i snang ba bden 'dzin gyi rdzun phug rdib nas chos thams cad bden med sgyu ma'i yo lang du shar song gsungs/ de rtogs pa yin nam zhus pas min nyams bzang po re yin gsungs/ sku gsum gyi dza dzi lags zhus pas nged dpon slob la mthun rkyen dkon po zhig las med pas nangs mo ja cung zhig btab nas bskol bas kha dog dri ro bzang tsam byung bas de la sprul sku'i ja zer/ nyin gung ja lhag de nang chu gcig bsab nas bskol bas sngar las zhan tsam byung ba la longs sku'i ja/

dgong mo de steng chu bsab pa la kha dog dri ro gang yang ma byung bas chos sku'i ja zhes a bu'i zhal kyal mdzad nas btags pa yin gsungs/ 'o na bzhes rgyu ji 'dra lags zhus pas nangs dus rtsam pa nyung ngu zhig 'debs rgyu dang*/ nyin gung gsol tshigs kyi dus rtsam pa nyung zhig gsol rgyu yod/ bar skabs shig na de yang zad nas rdo sa'i ru ba rnams kyis zog ngan shi ba'i sha khyi sngon du 'phangs pa rnams yar blangs nas bzhes dgos byung*/ chos kyi mjug rdzogs par nye ba na dmar bshal gyi rims zhig byung bar a bus 'bros dgos gsungs nas mi re re bzhin so sor thang shing re'i rtsa bar song ste sur dkar gyi rtsa ba kho nas 'tsho dgos pa yun ring byung*/ dbyar zla lnga pa'i nang tsam na a bus mdun nas dpal chen rdo rje 'bod mi btang byung bas phyogs so so nas tshur 'dus/ nged rnams chos gos lhung bzed mkhar bsil can sha stag yin pas a bu rin po che nyid nas spos sna gnang zhing bsu ba la phebs/ e rgya gar gyi dge slong rnams dang 'dra gsungs/ sku mdun du thud sgor zhig yod pa 'dis khyed rnams kyi thab 'go zhig sdus gsungs nas gnang*/ des de nyin gyi gsol tshigs ky-i go bcad de me yang ma bus/ da res khyed tshos dka' las de 'dra gang yang mi dgos par chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'di tsam 'dzol dus chos la nyams len mi nus pa gyong che gsungs/ skabs shig ye lo sgar du gter gsar gyi bum sgrub zhig 'dzugs par bdag mjal du phyin pas grwa pa mang po la ye shes pa phebs nas 'khrab 'dug pa dgong mo mar 'ong dus sku mdun du shog gsungs/ phyin pas de ring khyed bum sgrub kyi ltad mo ci mthong khong*/ rnam pa ji 'dra mdzad gsungs/ lo rgyus zhus pas/ 'o sems yod 'khrab pa de rang yin/ sems med 'khrab pa'i skabs kyang yod 'dug gsungs/ de ji 'dra lags zhus pas ngas shug gu shar nas bka' ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gsum la bsnyen pa zhig btang bas rog gi phur pa bsnyen skabs dkyil 'khor gyi steng mdun rten zangs phur chung ngu zhig yod pa de yang 'khrab 'dug gsungs/

de ji lags zhus pas bzang ngan ci yin mi shes gsungs/ phur pa de yod dam zhus pas gter ston bsod rgyal la gnang ba yin/ khong la phur pa de yod dus gter len tshe brag ci 'dra zhig brko yang 'dam la btab pa ltar yod zer/ rjes sor phur pa de go 'jo khang sar tshang la gnang ba yin 'dug de rjes gter len dus brag ni brag rang brko ba ltar 'dug zer/ khong gru chen du song bas li gter sogs las de 'dras thugs mi tshim pa 'dra/ nga la a bu bka' drin can nas khyod lo lnga bcur ma slebs par rdzogs chen gzhan la ma bshad/ de nas bshad thub na shod gsungs kyang lnga bcur ma sleb gong dge mang dbon bstan dgas ma bshad thabs med yin tshul gyis cung zhig bshad shor/ de min a bu'i bka' dang 'gal ba skad cig kyang 'gro ma myong bas brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag la dam sel gyi g.yas ma gos pa zhig yin gsungs/ de ltar bka' drin can de thugs sgam pas nang gi yon tan rnams shin tu sbas pa'i rnam thar kho na lhur mdzad kyang zhar la phebs pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi phra mo res kyang theg pa gsum gyi mngon rtogs gzhi tshul khrims la brten/ rten ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrub/ ngo bo byams snying rje dang 'brel/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong dang thun min gyi gnas thams cad la nyams bzhes kyi mthar son pa rgyud gzhung rnam dag gi dpang po 'pher ba lags/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ nga yi brgyud pa 'di chu phug gangs la thug pa lta bu zhig ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas nga yi bla ma a ti sha'i bar/ de'i bla ma ni de yin zhes brgyud pa re re nas mdzub mo 'dzug chog pa zhig yin/ rin chen byang chub sems kyi nyams len zam ma chad pas brgyud pa byin rlabs dang ldan pa yin/ zab mo lta ba dang rgya chen spyod pa'i man ngag yongs su rdzogs pas theg pa chen po'i lam gyi gnad lus pa med par tshang ba zhig yin gsungs pa bzhin 'dir yang brgyud pa phug la thug pa zhig yin no// dam pa 'di nyid rgya sdug ri khrod na bzhugs dus bdag lo gnyis tsam gyi steng phas khrid nas sku mdun mjal kha zhus pas thugs dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/

shing phor rtsi la gcig rgun 'brum dkar nag dang bu ram gyis bkang ba tshe ril srung mdud/ kha btags sker sgron bcas bsod nams bye ba'i dpal gyis 'khyud pa'i phyag zung spyi bor bkod de rnam kun bkra shis su bgyid pa'i byin rlabs smon lam gnang shing*/ pha la 'di cung zad nar son pa na chos zhur khrid 'ong dgos tshul gyi bslab bya brtsam pa phyis kyi rten 'byung du mngon/ khu bo byang chub zer ba sgar thog yod par gsung 'phros las/ de ring gi bu chung de de 'dra ngo mtshar can zhig 'dug ces yang yang gsungs 'dug pas gtsang sbra sogs legs po dgos rgyu 'dra/ bla ma rin po che'i mdun mtho dman su slebs kyang de 'dra'i bzang ngan gtan nas mi gsungs bas de brtag bya che tshul 'phrin du springs par thos/ de nas lo dgur son pa me mo phag gi lor chu khol tsha thog tu grub chen 'ja' lus pa chen po'i thugs kyi sras gcig bcom ldan rdo rje'i mtshan gzhan bla ma mtha' yas su grags pa tsha gzims phebs pa'i mdun nged pha bu yul gyi skyes pa bud med mang po'i grogs dang bcas mjal khar phyin/ zab chos mkha' khyab rang grol gyi sngon 'gro'i chos thun nyin bdun gyi bar gnang*/ de dus blo shed ma phye bas gsung gi gnas la ji bzhin gting dpog pa ma byung yang zhal mjal ba tsam gyis blo sna 'gyur 'gro ba lta bu'i mos gus thob/ tshe rabs las kyi bla ma zhig yin par nges kyang khong yun ring por ma bzhugs par zhing khams su gshegs/ lo bcu gcig gi dus rang gi khu bo rdo rje bsam 'grub mdun gang blo ma'i 'grel pa sbyangs/ rtsa ba dang rje mkhyen brtse'i 'grel pa bcas blo la bzung*/ de'i dgun da lta'i dgon gong 'og 'di tsho med pas sbyin bdag zhig gi yon 'tshogs la rta khrom gnyis kyi tshogs pa rags bsdus shig rdzong dkar gnas nang 'tshogs/ der gang blo ma'i tshogs bshad zhig kyang byas pas rgan pa rnams nas ngo mtshar bar brtsi/

de nas lo bcu gnyis dus khu bo bkra chung zer ba bla ma bzang po zhig yod pas kaḥthog lugs mgon po tshogs bdag gi sgrub pod gcig bri dgos par ngas shog las byas/ bla ma rdor les phyag bris gnang*/ zhus dag byed dus ma dpe bdag gi bton pas dug byung mgor smreng gyer ba ni zhes pa'i tshig brjod ma bde nas bla ma la dris par khyod bla ma mi dgos skya bo gyis zer dus grwa pa byed 'dug da yi ge tsam yang mi shes gsungs mang du bka' bkyon pa'i nub mor rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la gsol ba drag tu btab pas tho rangs khar rang gi khog pa'i nang nas a ra pa tsa'i sgra 'ur gyis grags shing snang ba la a ra pa tsa dmar ser mang po 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin khong nas phyir byung snyam pa shar ngang nas brgyal/ phyi nyin nas bzung klog 'don pa la sngar dang mi 'dra bar shin tu bzang bas nyin phyed re la 'phags pa brgyad stong dag po tshar re klog thub pa byung*/ bcu gnyis dus klu'i bud med zhig gis yid bzhin gyi nor bu yin zer ba zhig byin pa dang*/ bcu gsum dus rdzong dkar nas sman gyi dpe cha pod gcig rnyed pa bcas gter bdag so so la phyir sprad cing de 'dra'i rigs la rtsis che gtan nas ma byas/ rang lo bcu bzhi pa'i dus na kaḥthog dri med zhing skyong sku phreng bzhi pa rig 'dzin mi 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob shud pu dpal seng gi rnam sprul rtsod bral dus bab kyi sprul pa'i gter chen ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nam 'jigs bral mthu stobs gling pa'i mdun klong gsal rdo rje snying po'i sngon 'gro'i khrid 'bring po'i thog nas zhal khrid rgyas pa thob/ dge rtsa che chung gang bsgrub kyang dam pa gsum dang 'brel dgos par go ba rnal ma chags/ khrid de'i lugs kyi sems bskyed/ maṇ+ḍal/ rdor sems phyi nang gi bzlas pa/ mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mtshan 'bum gsaul 'debs/

bar chad sel phyir hūm̐ ring bgrangs ba bcas gnad du smin par byas/ bco lnga na gter chen de nyid kyi mdun klong gsal rdo rje snying po'i zab gter dang zhal skong gsung 'bum pod bcu gcig gi dbang lung tshang bar thob/ de dus dang po sta gon nyin nged sku mdun yod pa la do nub rmi lam ci rmis nangs par nged ma bshad rgyu yod pa dgos gsungs/ do nub nyal ba'i tho rangs khar shing lcang ma'i sdong po chen po zhig gi rtsar bdag gis mkhar rnga chen po zhig brdungs pas pha gi thag ring po'i sa nas khrom 'tshogs mang po zhig 'dus 'ong ba rmis/ nangs par de tshul zhus pas gter chen rin po ches lcang sdong de kaḥthog yin/ mkhar rnga'i brdas khyod rang phyin chad kaḥthog tu chos 'chad nyan byed mkhan zhig 'ong ba'i ltas yin gsungs pa phyi mtha' gzigs par go dngos gzhi'i ye shes dbab pa'i dus slob ma lhar bskyed pa'i dmigs rim phog par rnam smin gyi phung po skad cig gis gnas 'gyur nas blos bcos pa la mi ltos par dpal chas yongs rdzogs kyi khro bo'i sku yul gsum gyad du gyur pa'i lha snang gi ngang nas rdo rje'i gshog pa g.yos pa'i sgra rang gi rna lam du thos rgyu yod pa lta bu'i nga rgyal brtan po skyes/ de lo khang tshig sgar nang du song bka' drin can lung rtogs rin po che'i thugs sras mkhas btsun bzang gsum mkhyen brtse nus gsum gang la'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan mnga' ba mkhan chen rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis mkhan po gnang*/ las slob sku lung mkhan tshul khrims nor bu/ dus bsgo ba karma dam chos 'od zer/ grogs dan pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ las kyi kha skong smin gling rdor 'dzin rnam grol rgya mtsho bcas dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i mdun tshigs gsum rim nod kyis dge tshul sdom pa blangs/ bka' drin can lung rtogs rin po che'i mdun shog gsungs phyin pas thugs shin tu mnyes mnyes dang khyed rab byung gi sdom pa thob pa skal ba bzang*/

gzhi chog las/ de ltar dge tshul thob ma thag /'di la khyim pa thams cad kyis// phyag 'tshal smon par 'gyur ba yin// ces gsung pa bzhin khyim gyi 'ching ba las grol zhing*/ yon tan bla na med pa'i rten byed pa lags/ mgon po klus/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs// zhes pa ltar phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pas bslab bya'i gnas rnams nges par bsrung dgos/ de yang rnam nges las/ srog gcod ma byin len dang mi tshangs spyod// rdzun smra chang 'thung phyi dro'i kha zas dang*// gar sogs phreng sogs mal stan che mtho dang*// gser dngul len spangs rags pa bcur dril gsungs// zhes pa bzhin/ rtsa ba bzhi dang*/ de steng yan lag drug gi spang blang rnams ji lta ba bzhin lag len la thebs dgos/ zhib mo sum cu'ang de nang phyogs 'thus zhes bslab bya zhib mor bstsal zhing zhal ta bzang po dang*/ ras dar dmar kha lnga gnang*/ de phyin rang nas kyang bslab bya'i gnas la dran shes bag yod dang 'brel dge tshul la 'bral ba'i spang ltung ma gsungs kyang chos gos dang mthang gos 'bral med 'chang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spang ba sogs dang gser dngul len pa la'ang len pa lta ci reg pa tsam yang spangs te rags pa bcu lag len la thebs nges byas/ de yang ngo lkog can gyi tshul 'chos min par nges 'byung gi bsam pas bslab pa'i gnas rnams la shin tu gus par bslab pa yin no// lar tshul khrims gtsang ba gcig pu'i yon tan gyis deng sang thams cad kyis bla mar brtsi zhing bkur ba 'di yin pas nged kyi rjes su 'jug pa dag gis sdom pas rgyud legs par sdom pa dang bslab bya'i gnas la dran shes kyis bsrung ba gal che/ karma chags med rin po che'i zhal nas/ ban rgan sdom pa gtsang ba de// grub rtags nang nas che shos yin// gsungs pa de shin tu thugs mad/ de rjes lo gnyis tsam la rnam g.yeng du lus/

bcu bdun lor sher phyin rgyas pa tshar gcig bklags pas rkyen byas stong pa nyid kyi don la shin tu spro ba skyes/ sgyu mas sgyu ma la rlom sems sogs kyi skabs snang ba bden med rmi lam lta bu'i nges pa sems la shar/ de'i dgun stod zhig la bden pa'i gcig du bral gyi nges pa yid yul shar bas chos dang gang zag gi bdag ces bya ba de legs par btsal bas yul dang phyogs dang dus gang na'ang mi 'dug snyam pa'i nges pa sngar las lhag par 'drongs/ sngar zla grags kyis/ mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min// sogs kyi don rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa la nges pa'i shes pa gting tshugs pa rnyed nas de'i ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas dang po 'dzin pa'i sems 'gags nas snang ba tsam zhig thad ka na snang*/ ci zhig na snang ba tsam po de yang nub nas sems gsal stong gi yul stong seng zhig snang*/ de nas de yang nub pas blo dang stong pa gnyis ka log ste blo dang stong pa gnyis chu la chu bzhag pa ltar ro gcig tu song ba'i skabs rtog med du lus/ de'i ngang nas sems rags pa'i steng tshur ldang bar rtsom pa na snang ba thams cad bden med sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shar nas bden 'dzin res 'ga' tsam las mi 'char tshul 'di la dpag na 'phags pa sa thob pa rnams la'ang yun mi ring ba tsam ma gtogs bden 'dzin gtan mi skye ba min pa 'dra/ yul stong nyid la mngon sum can gyi rtog med dang phyis rang lo nyer bdun par son dus tshad phebs kyi rtags rdzogs pa'i skabs yul yul can gyi gnas lugs rig pa ye shes dang*/ rtsal shes rab kyis mngon sum de gnyis khyad par shin tu che ba zhig yod pa rang gi myong ba yang dag pas grub/ rjes thob na nyon sgrib spangs pa dang rtsal gyi chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab la'ang shugs che chung yod pa rnams ni spros pas chog par sems/ deng sang mdo sngags kyi mthong lam gnyis dang de 'jal byed kyi shes rab kyang gcig par 'dzin pa rnams la brtse bas bshad pa'o// bka' drin can bla ma sgar du lo dgu'i bar bzhugs nas slar rang yul du phebs bzhed kyis bla ma 'od zer la gsung byon par/

da res khyed tsho'i rtogs ldan bya sgong 'dra ba 'di rnams la kha mig ro ni btod zin/ nged kyi rmi lam du gser gzhung gi lung pa'i smad tsam na gser gyi mchod rten chen po nyal thabs su yod pa zhig 'dug pa yar bslang bas theg la khad lan mang du rmis pas 'gro dgos gsungs/ phyis lo zla ba lnga pa'i mjug sgar thog nas btegs te chu tshan khar bzhugs 'di nas rta khrol gnyis ka'i bla grwa tshang la rkya bsur song*/ chu khol tshwa thog nas mjal kha zhus/ zhag shas bzhugs/ phebs nyin chibs thog nas da thams cad kyis skya phreng bsgrigs la song*/ ngag li dang sangs rgyas skyabs gnyis bla chen tshul gyis/ nga'i g.yas g.yon du shog gsungs/ mo rkung dmag lam sgang du rgya shod pa'i thab bsu dang 'phrad/ bla ma ngag dbang bstan pa 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs nye skor zhig la phebs nas bsngo smon gnang te gsol ja bzhes/ der a 'dzom rig 'dzin chen po'i sprul sku ngag dbang yang phebs/ phyag rten du dngul gyi mgo rgyan rtags brgyad kyi ri mo bkra ba dang bla ma 'das pa'i rdor dril spus legs gcig phul nas rang yul du phyag phebs pa spro dga' bka' drin che tshul dang*/ rta khrom gnyis gtsos 'di phyogs kyi gdul bya la dgongs nas chos kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gnad ma nor bar ston pa nyid tsam las gzhan du ma dmigs pas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba dang*/ zhabs pad bskal brgya'i bar brtan nas rdzogs chen tshang gi yar gdan 'dren zhu ba byung yang mi gsan par mkhyen mkhyen/ gal srid phyogs gzhan la phebs mdzad tshe nged ban rgan nas nyid kyi gzan mthur 'ju dgos byung yang btang re zhes lugs gnyis kyi zhu ba gcam bu tsam min par snying nas gsol ba btab pa gsan te bzhugs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang*/ de nas e le sgar pa'i thang stod du bla brang gis gzim gur thab tshang bzhugs gdan sogs shin tu gra sgrig legs po gnang 'dug pa der bzhugs nas bsu ma rnams so sor gyes/

zhag shas nas nged sku mdun phyin pas zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcur tshogs bskang zhig btang rgyu yin pas mos pa can yod na khyod nas cha rgyob la tshogs mchod ci 'byor khyer shog gsungs/ de bzhin so so'i sgor gsung phrin bskyal bas da res gzab dgos zer nas rta khrom gnyis kyang da lta dang mi 'dra bar sde shas mi srab stabs mar chur do bo phul ba yang mang du byung*/ gzhan mar thud 'o zho 'bul mkhan shin tu mang*/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi zab gter gu ru yon tan gter mdzod kyi tshogs bskang rgyas pa zhig gsungs/ phran la ston kha 'dir sngon 'gro zhig bshad rgyu yin pas shog gsungs der zla shas bzhugs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin pad+ma ri mthor sgar btegs/ nyin gcig nged sku bcar zhus pas da res sa rgya 'di yang chung*/ chos zhu yang mang tsam 'dug pas sa 'di bgo dgos gsungs/ chos zhu lnga bcu tsam yod pa la sa bgos mdzad/ nga la'ang khyod kyi sbra chung phub pa yin gsungs/ mi re la sa rtags phur pa re brdung bcug khong gi gzim sbra 'di yan su yang sdod mi chog bla sprul mang po 'byor rgyu yod ces phebs/ de nas zla ba dgu pa'i mgor kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung gi dbu btsugs nas gsungs kyang phran gyi ru ba khrom smad du yod pas ma go nyin gcig gsung phrin 'byor/ de 'phral phyin pas 'jug pa sems bskyed mgo bar gsungs tshar 'dug da zhu e chog zhus par khyod la 'phrin mang po bskur yang ma 'phrod pa 'dra zhu chog gsungs/ phyi nang maṇ+ḍal rten mtshon dngul sgor gsum/ mar chur gzhong pa gang*/ lug khog gcig bcas phul nas chos gral du bsdad/ chos thun zin 'phral/ sems mchog bskyed pa mi gtso skyes pa gtso// zhes lan mang du gsungs/ a tsi/ chos mtshams kyi rten 'brel shin tu legs gsungs/ thugs dgyes tshor chen po dang sems bskyed man chad zla ba gcig gis rdzogs par mdzad/

zhar la dbu nas gnad bsdus te nyin re bzhin gsungs/ sems bskyed man chad la zin bris zhig btab/ chos mjug rdzogs pa dang thugs blo zhus par/ khyod kyis snga sngon 'gro thob ma myong bas 'bum lnga zhig kyang bsags dgos ste go rim ltar mi 'ong bas dgun tshe 'dir rdor sems yig brgya thon/ 'don lugs nged kyis rim bzhin bslab gsungs nas yig brgya 'don bcug mtshams rnams su stobs bzhi'i dmigs rnam zhib cha mdzad de gnang*/ khyad par rten gyi stobs 'dis bskyed rim la sems bslab te 'dris dgos pa yin pas snang cha nas spyan gyi dkar nag ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad gsal ba/ stong cha nas bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa snang stong chu zla lta bu zhig gsal dgos gsungs/ de bzhin bsgom pas thun bsdu ba na rdor sems 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas zhes pa'i skabs su 'ju dka' ba tsam byung bar de'i tshul zhus par/ o ha cang a 'thas che drag pas lan/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa de zhal phyag 'tshogs pa'i cha tsam la blos btags pa las bden dngos ci yang med/ zhal phyag re re nas brtags na 'dug gam gsungs/ de bzhin dpyad pas snang la rang bzhin med pa'i gnas la nges pa rnyed/ zhag lnga bcu na yig brgya 'bum phrag lhag tsam grub sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rmi lam dang dngos su yang lus yang ba sems la ting nge 'dzin gsal ba sogs gzhung nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams so sor mngon du gyur/ da ji 'don zhus pas spyod 'jug las dpung bzhi bshad pa dor ba'i dpung bya ba yin pas re zhig ngal sos gsungs bzhin zhag bcur ngal gsos/ da theg chen tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi grangs med gcig gi tshogs bsags pa'i dod po rdor sems dang maṇ+ḍal gnyis kyi byas nas dngos gzhi'i khrid mthong lam gyi ye shes dang 'dra ba ngo sprod dgos pas maṇ+ḍal zhig gsog 'di byang chub sems dpa' tshogs lam pa'i tshogs kyi sgo dang po yin pas sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi rten du 'di rnams khyer gsungs/

sku rten du ston pa'i sku li ma/ gsung rten du mdo sdud pa dang gsang snying rtsa ba gnyis/ thugs rten du bka' gdams mchod rten bcas g.yar po gnang*/ bka' gdams mchod rten 'di la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang sbyar nas 'chad rgyu yod gsungs te gdan gyi pad spangs nas bzung bslab pa gsum dang sbyar lugs zhig gsungs/ 'phros ci yang mi gsung bar cung zhig bzhugs nas kun mkhyen chen po'i 'dra zhal zhig blangs te/ 'di kun mkhyen pa'i dbu klad/ 'jigs gling gi dbu skra bcas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gnang ba yin pas 'di yang khyer/ 'di rnying ma'i bla ma rtsa ba che shos yin pas gsol ba thob dang zhal mjal ba'ang srid/ da res tshogs bsags kyi sgo dang po yin pas mchod pa rnam lnga kha tshang ci 'dzom dang*/ khyod phyug po'i bu yin pas mar me ci mang dgos/ ngas srin bal ster gsungs/ srin bal dang smin gling gi spos dkar dmar brgya chag gcig dri bzang ba byung bcas gnang*/ de nyin nas bzung gnas khang phyag dar byas te rten rnams rdo leb kyi stegs la bkod shing leb chung ngu'i steng du zhal zas dang mar me/ nyin ltar gyi rnam lnga re chag med byas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod 'bru rnams rdo dang*/ yug po bya brun dang*/ gas chag gi skyon med pa 'bru khal bzhi tsam bkru bshal gtsang mar byas/ nyin re bzhin 'god rgyu'i 'bru rnams dri bzang gis sbags/ mchod 'bru rnams yang zlos gtan nas ma byas par snying thig gzhung gi maṇ+ḍal stong gsum 'jig rten ma khri gsum lhag tsam tshar dus sku mdun shog gsungs/ phyin pas ci tsam tshar gsungs/ de tshul zhus par khri bdun kha skong bcas mkhyen brtse'i gsung bdag gzhan ma'am sa gzhi spos chus gnyis gang rung bsags rgyu khyod rang 'dam chog gsungs/ mkhyen brtse'i gsung de mi 'thad pa med kyang chos rgyal chen po'i gsung de bsags na snyam zhus pas de bsags na chog

mnyam med jo bos da lta tshogs bsags dang smon lam gyi sgo gang la'ang sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnam par dag pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam lta bu zhig gal che/ de min 'phags pa sa bcu pa na bzhugs pa rgyal tshab byams pa'i smon lam lta bu zhig dang*/ yang na sa dang po na bzhugs pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gsung smon lam nyi shu pa lta bu'i bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi gsung la brten na khyad par che/ so skyes kyi tshig dang sdeb sbyor ci ltar legs kyang snying po med gsungs pa de ltar yin/ 'on kyang mkhyen brtse rin po che chaus rgyal chen po'i sprul par 'khrul pa med pas de tsam khyad med na'ang khyed rang gi mos pa ltar gyis/ sa gzhi spos chus 'di chos rgyal chen pos gu ru rin po cher rgyal srid mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa phul ba'i dus mdzad par grags/ lar gang la'ang brtag dpyad sngon du btang nas mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lam gnad mi 'chug pa la khyad che/ khyi dang glo ba 'phrad pa ltar chos gang yin yin la 'jug snga byed pa phung la sbyor ba'i gzhi yin tshul sogs zhal ta zhib par gnang*/ de nas mar 'ong zhag grangs tsam la sun pa ma bskyed par bla ma rgyang 'bod dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bcas kyi dmigs rnam 'phrod nges brgya tshar re bsags/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa phyag dang sbrag thun rer tshar bcu re/ tshar phyi ma'i nang maṇ+ḍal blugs nas yun ring tsam na tshar bar byas/ thun mtshams rnams su yang tshar grangs ci lcog bsags/ de'i skabs su rmi lam zhig na g.yu sgron ma yin rgyu'i bud med zhig gis kun mkhyen chen po mjal 'gro zer/ des lam sna byas te song bas gser gzhung gi ri gser de'u 'dra ba zhig gis shar ngos su phug pa zhig tu slebs/ ri de'i nang dung dkar gyi mgrin pa 'dra ba'i khong gseng nas g.yas skor gyis phyin pas ri rtser slebs pa na spang ljang ser gyi thang khang mal tsam zhig na kun mkhyen chen po zhal shar phyogs su gzigs te nam mkha' la spyan lta stangs kyis a āḥzhes gsung nas phyag na shel rdo lug gi snying 'dra ba zhig bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste/

a sems nyid rang byung byang chub sems āḥ a stong pa chen po kun bzang klong āḥ a zang thal rig pa chos kyi sku āḥ a gdangs chen lnga las cir yang 'char āḥ a lta sgom las 'das rig pa'i gshis āḥ a de ring snying la gnas par shog āḥ gsungs pas mos gus kyis sems rtog med du dar cig brgyal/ de sangs pa na mal du gnyid kyang sad 'dug de rjes 'dra zhal de las ring bsrel kyang cha shas phebs/ maṇ+ḍal tshar ba dang rten rnams sku mdun phul pas kun mkhyen chen po e mjal gsungs/ dngos su ni ci yang ma mjal/ rmi lam rmis rgyu ni brjed song bas zhu rgyu lus/ ring bsrel rnams phyag bsnams mdzad song*/ rjes shig tu sngar khyod kyis maṇ+ḍal phul dus kun mkhyen e mjal gsungs/ ma mjal lags zhus pas/ rmi lam 'dra e byung gsungs/ rmi lam zhig rmis tshul zhib tu zhus pas khyed la kun mkhyen chen pos sde gsum rdzogs pa chen po'i tshig dbang gnang ba ma red dam gsungs/ mi shes lags zhus pas/ ci yang mi gsungs/ phyis zhig na slob ma 'ga' rer ngag li la kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal gzigs pa red ces bsngags brjod gnang 'dug zer/ yang de skabs shig na/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni// tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang*// rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las// thabs gzhan brten pa rmongs pa shes par bya// zhes pas mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal la rang gzhung na thun mong thun min sogs gsungs kyang*/ a bus/ snang tshul sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ gnas tshul longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ khyab byed chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal zhes gsungs pa 'di la go ba myong rgyu shin tu che gsungs nas de la rgyas bshad gnang*/ da rang gi lus 'di'i steng nas tshogs bsags pa la ku su lu'i tshogs bsags zhes bya sla la chod che ba zhig yin/ kun mkhyen chen pos sems nyid ngal gso las bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar gsungs kyang kun mkhyen 'jigs gling gis maṇ+ḍal dang phyi nang gi tshogs bsags thabs 'brel bsdebs te gsungs/

gang ltar yang gal che zhes 'gyed chen bzhi'i dmigs rim rgyas par bstsal nas nang dus dkar 'gyed/ nyin gung khra 'gyed/ dgongs dus dmar 'gyed re gyis/ nag 'gyed 'di skabs shig mi dgos gnyan par song nas slong tshad yun ring por ma 'ong ba'am/ 'ong kyang tshar tshad ma rdzogs pa'am/ de rdzogs kyang chod tshad ma 'ong ba la dgos rgyu yin kyang de 'dra'i rnam bzhag shes mkhan su mi 'dug gsungs nas gcod yul mkha' 'gro'i gad rgyang gi rnam bshad phyin drug lang tsho dang a bu'i rnam bshad zung bsdeb te ljags bshad gnang*/ de bzhin maṇ+ḍal dang lus sbyin sbrel nas nyams su blangs pas nub rgyun mar dur khrod chen por ro gsar rnying mang po dang*/ bya gcan rigs mi 'dra ba du mas gang ba zhig na rang lus kyi rnam shes spar nas khros mar gyur pas lus de bya gcan dang dur bdag 'dra ba mang po zhig la 'gyed btang ba rmis/ de tshul zhus pas khyod e skrag gsungs/ ci yang ma skrag zhus/ de u tsā la'i dur khrod yin/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po yang thugs skrag nas phyag gi rdo rje shor la khad khad mdzad na khyod mi skrag pa ci yin zhes zhal kyal gnang*/ bdag gi sems ni nam mkhar spar bas khros ma nag mo sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum du gsungs na sangs rgyas las stobs che ba'i lha 'dre ji la yod/ sems stong pa har sangs zhig las skrag pa'i rnam pa ji yang dran rgyu mi 'dug zhus par de 'dra'i kha hob ma mtho/ phyag na rdo rje las khyod bzang ba yin nam gsungs/ lar de tshe lus sbyin byas pa'i mthu yin/ de rnams bzang ngan ci yin mi shes gsungs/ de nas sos thog der snying thig ngag 'don dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dmigs rim gnyis sbrags te sgar pa spyi la bstsal/ 'di skabs lan gcig dang snga phyir a bu rin po che'i phyag bzhes spyod 'jug le bzhi dang 'brel ba'i sems bskyed sdom chog lan gsum thob/

phran la bla ma'i rnal 'byor de re zhig zhog la blo ldog rnam bzhi nas rim gyis blo sbyong dgos/ chos pa yang dag zhig 'ong ba la sngon 'gro 'di gal che/ dngos gzhi zer ba legs lam zhig tu song na/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ rang don du chos brgyad mgo snyoms/ gzhan don du brtse ba'i snying rje chen po rang shug kyis 'byung gsungs pa bzhin yin/ stong pa nyid kyi don gsha' ma zhig rtogs na stong pa rten 'byung du shar/ rten 'byung stong nyid du 'gro tshul la nges pa gting nas rnyed de rgyu 'bras bslu med la yid ches mi 'byung mi srid de/ 'phags pa klus/ chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas// las dang 'bras bu 'byung ba gang*// ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar// rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung*// zhes dang*/ rgyal bu 'brom gyis/ stong nyid rtogs pa dang snying rje skye ba dus mnyam/ snying rje skye ba dang mi dge ba spang ba dus mnyam gsungs/ 'o na deng sang stong nyid rtogs zer ba 'di rnams kyi nyon mongs pa kha ma bri ba ci lags zhus pas/ de rnams kha stong du song ba yin gsungs/ dus ngan 'di 'drar stong pa nyid dam sems ngo rtogs/ lta ba mtho zer ba rnams mi dge ba spyod pa la spobs pa je mtho/ spyod pa je rtsing*/ nyon mongs je rags la song*/ kha lta yug po zhig la blo rtse gtod 'dug kyang skye 'chi bar do'i 'gags la thug dus rgan mo bsam bzang zhig las dman pa 'di tsho 'dra ba zhig las mi 'ong*/ khas bshad rgyu dang lag len go 'dzol du song bas deng sang rnying ma pa zer dus bon po dang 'dra bar rtsi ba 'di chos dang rang rgyud ma 'dres par lta ba mtho mdog 'dis phung ba yin pas/ rnying ma'i lam rim rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso lta bus rgyud sbyangs/ rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rgyud la skyes nas sgom pa gnyug bsring*/ lta ba shongs yangs pa/

spyod pa zhib la tig pa zhig bgyis na/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa/ dga' ldan khri rin po che/ shar rtse/ byang rtse/ sa skya'i bdag chen rnams kyis bla ma rnam dag tu bkur ba'ang rnying ma'i gzhung dang lam rim rgyu mtshan bsdebs pa red/ da nged rang gnyis khom khom zhig byas nas sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam bzhi 'di la blo sbyong yang yang dgos/ a bu'i phyag len la sems nyid ngal gso'i don khrid 'dis zhag grangs sam khrid tshul sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya pha rol phyin drug yan chad zhag brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa drug gi bar blo sbyong ba yin/ de ltar bgyis na rab bsam gtan bzhi pa/ 'bring bsam gtan dang po/ tha na'ang 'dod sems rtse gcig zhig mi 'grub mi srid/ de grub nas gzod rdzogs chen gyi rig pa zhig ngo sprad na zhi lhag zung 'jug mtshan nyid pa 'ong*/ zhi ba lhas/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces sems rnam par grol ba lhag mthong gi lam la mdo sngags gang yin kyang de'i rten rlung med pa'i mar me'i snang ba gsal ba bzhin mi g.yeng ba'i rgyu zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa zhig bsgrub dgos la/ de yang 'jig rten la chags pa med pa'i rgyu nges par 'byung ba'i kun slong gis yang dag par blangs pa'i tshul khrims la gnas shing*/ bslab pa gsum gyi gnang bkag gi mtshams phyed pa'i go ba rnal ma zhig chags nas de bzhin ma bsgrub na ltar snang phyag rdzogs kyi khrid yin mdog gis mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi zhi gnas su sgro btags pa tsam lo zlar bsgom skad kyi byas yus 'dren pa rnams la bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi lta ci/ 'dod sems rtse gcig tsam yang mi 'grub pa'i lam de 'dras mi tshe stong zad la bskyal ba gyong che gsungs/

lar mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi zhi gnas sgrub lugs de phyag rdzogs kyi gzhung nas ma gsung ngam zhus pas/ rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag las mtshan bcas zhi gnas kun mkhyen chen pos gtan nas ma gsungs/ phyag chen la yod tshod 'dra yang de dus bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa man ngag gi gnad mkhyen pa mang po bzhugs pas/ nyes pa lnga spangs/ 'du byed brgyad brten/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu'i sgo nas shing bu rde'u sogs la brten nas zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa zhig 'ong rgyu yod kyang*/ da ni de 'dra'i man ngag gi gnad ci yang med par rang gar shing bu rde'u la shes pa mdung tshugs zhig gis rtser 'dzin byed pa tsam la zhi gnas kyi dri tsam yang mi bro/ rje rin po ches ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas cha yid shes la sgrub dgos pa ma shes nas mig shes la sgrub pa 'di mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas su gsungs pa de bden par mthong*/ khrid tshul 'di la dmigs yul gyi blo can sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba'i lugs dang*/ rig pa rang snang gi blo can lta thog nas sgom pa 'tshol ba'i lugs gnyis las kun mkhyen chen pos khrid tshul 'dir spyi'i babs kyi 'gros phyi ma ltar yin kyang bsgom tshul gyi dbang gis snga ma ltar byas na legs cha che tshul gsungs pas/ sngon 'gro'i blo sbyong 'dis zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa tsam 'grub dka' yang 'dod sems rtse gcig zhig mi 'grub mi srid/ dang po kun slong nas rim gyis blo sbyong mar shes drin dran 'di bsam pa la rtsa ba'i ma nas bsgom dgos/ thun dang thun mtshams med/ jo bos rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun ldan du bsgom par gsungs kyang a bu'i phyag bzhes la mar shes drin dran sogs lnga po'i nang 'dus te/ yid 'ong gi byams pa bde ba dang ldan 'dod du 'du la/ lhag bsam rnam dag dam bca' dang 'brel ba'i nang du 'du gsungs nas blo sbyong tshul thun re gsungs/ de zhag mang tsam rer bsam bcug nas lo gnyis tsam 'gor/

lo der bla ma bsod rgyal yab sras dang bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin yab sras bcas la sngon 'gro rgyas par gsungs pa de zhus/ de dus zhal rgyun la zin bris zhig kyang btab/ sngon 'gros blo sbyong ba'i skabs sems yul la dbang med du rgyug pa zhi nas dpyad 'jog ci byas kyang bde mor byung ba skabs shig nas sems ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu song nas dpyad rgyu 'jog rgyu gnyis ka med pa'i sems gsal stong zhig gi ngang la rang bzhin lhod kyis song*/ snang ba thams cad thig le 'ba' zhig tu gyur mthar de yang ting nge 'dzin de'i ngor nub nas snang ba gang yang med pa zhig 'char 'dug pa bla ma la zhus pas/ mi shes kun gzhi yin 'gro gsungs byung bas gzab dgos snyam ste blo sbyong gi dmigs rnam re re nas 'dzin stangs ngar cha bton pas grim che na de bas kyang sems rtog med snang yul med pa der phyam gyis brdal/ yang skabs su zhus pas de ci yin mi shes gsungs/ phyis dngos gzhi'i khrid zhu dus sems rig shan 'byed skabs yod rgyu khyod la sngar blo sbyong gi dus nas snang bcas snang med kyi mnyam bzhag 'dra ba zhig bshad rgyu yod pa de red kyang ngas ngo ma sprad/ bsgom bya shor la khyi mi ri zer ba de 'ong snyam pas dogs pa yin gsungs/ de dus sems don skor gyi dpe cha tsam yang mjal kha mi gnang*/ skabs der mkhan chen rgyal mtshan 'od zer phebs byung bar de'i mdun slob gnyer sbyang dgos gsungs pa bzhin rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi phung lnga'i rab dbye sdom byang rgyas bshad/ de gnyis ka'i 'grel pa rdzogs chen mkhan po 'jigs med bsam gtan gyi gsung bcas sbyangs pas 'bru gnyer tsam shes/ de nas 'dra ba dge bshes gsung bka' gdams phug nor bcu'i zhal gdams dang*/ klong snying sems sbyong bdun pa lag len la 'debs tshul dran pa nyer bzhag ri chos zhal gdams ngo mtshar rgya mtsho bcas zhal khrid bstsal/

sdom gsum rnam nges/ spyod 'jug rnams la sbyangs brtson bgyis pas go ba lam tsam chags/ skabs de shed na bla mas da a stobs mdun zung 'jug snye ma zhig zhus/ bskyed rdzogs la go ba 'gangs chen chags rgyu'i zab gnad chen po rang med kyang phyin chad mtshams re 'dug na mkho gal che ba yin gsungs/ bskyaid rdzogs kyi gzhung la go ba chags pa la zab gnad ston pa'i gzhung gang bzang zhus pas/ sems nyid ngal gso 'di gzhung min/ skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa mdo sngags bskyed rdzogs dang bcas pa'i zab rgyas gnyis kyi lam tshang la ma nor ba ston pa'i gdams ngag yin kyang smin gling gter chen yab sras phyin zhig nas bshad rgyun phra bar song*/ a bu bka' drin can nas nged rnams la tshar gcig gsungs kyang de'i gnad sngon 'gro'i nang tshang bar byas nas bshad yod/ phyin chad rgyas par e thob ltos gsungs/ de bzhin zung 'jug snye ma zhus/ bla mas da dung blo sbyong gyis/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed ci tsam tshar gsungs/ thun re bzhin cha gnyis blo sbyong*/ cha gcig skyabs 'gro bsags pas ngag 'don nang skyabs 'gro de 'bum phrag gsum song*/ sems bskyed 'bum phrag gcig tshar zhus pas sems bskyed de khri gsum las mi dgos/ blo sbyong gal che/ btags pa ba khas len gyi skyabs 'gro bsags rgyu des chog rgyun du skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ma de nyams su longs/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba myang 'das gnyis ka'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i grogs dang ra mda' skyel ma lta bu khong rnams las su yod/ srid zhi'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa la sdug bsngal de dag dang bral ba zhig med na skyob mi nus kyang sangs rgyas ni mi gnas pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas pa yin pas de la ston par khas blang na skyob nus/ chos ni sangs rgyas par byed pa 'gog lam gnyis kyi bsdus pa de'i thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa de yin pas/

rnam 'grel las/ bden bzhi'i blang dor mkhyen pas ston pa tshad mar sgrub pa ltar yin/ de lam du khas blangs nas de bzhin bsgrub na skyob nus/ dge 'dun pa ni 'phags pa sa thob pa yan chad yin/ ston pa thugs rje can de'i bstan pa'i lam nyams su blang bas rang rgyud la lam gyi spang rtogs ci rigs dang ldan pa yin pas de mig ltos byed pa'i grogs su khas blangs te ston pa lam grogs kyi tshul du skyabs su 'gro dgos/ dper na tshong pa nor ldan 'jigs bcas kyi lam du 'gro ba la skyel ma dam po med na mgo mi thon pa dang 'dra/ sdud par/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa su yi lag thogs pa// de la bar chad bya phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur// gsungs pas byang chub sems dpa' la bar chad 'jug mi 'jug ci rigs yod/ shes rab dang brtson 'grus gnyis ka med pa de nyid bdud las yin pas bar chad zhugs zin/ shes rab med pa'i brtson 'grus can la'ang bar chad 'jug gnyis ka dang ldan pa la bdud kyi bar chad byin mi nus pa yin na'ang*/ snga ma las/ ma zhig na bar gyur la bu ni mang yod pa// de kun yid mi bde zhing de la rim gro byed// de bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs rgyal ba yang*// yum gyur shes rab dam pa 'di la dgongs par mdzad// ces pa bzhin khyod la shes rab dang brtson 'grus skyon med zhig yod pas lam gyi bar chad sel phyin dkon mchog la yid ches kyi skyabs 'gro 'di gal che/ lam rjes su sgrub pa'i skyabs 'gro ni khas blangs pa de bzhin gang nyams su len pa thams cad skyabs 'gro'i ra ba las mi 'da' ba zhig dgos/ dang po nas dngos gzhi zer ba zhig gi mtho bsnyab mi byed par sngon 'gro 'dis lam gyi rkang rtsa brtan po zhig tshugs dgos/ dge bshes pu to bas/ skyu zab pa yang bzang te de bas skyu ske sra ba 'di rang gal che gsungs pa bzhin yin pas blo sbyong 'dis blo sna 'gyur ba zhig nges par dgos/

khyod la blo sbyong gis blo skyed ci tsam thon gsungs/ lar blo ldog bzhi po ji lta ba bzhin rgyud la skye dka' yang*/ chung ngu'i dus nas bdag 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gang la'ang blo ha cang 'thas pa zhig min steng da skabs bla ma'i thugs rjes rgyu mtshan nges pas nges 'byung ye bcos mi dgos pa zhig byung*/ mchog gsum la yid ches ni kha zhe med par skyes/ byang chub kyi sems 'di yang theg pa chen po'i lam gyi gzhi mar shes nas da lta dgra gnyen gang la'ang*/ tshe rabs brgyud ma'i ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dag bde ba dang ldan 'dod sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi kun slong khyad 'phags kyis drangs pas phan thogs pa'i skabs mchis na srog 'dor ba la yang nyam mi nga ba'i gdengs mchis/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod chung ngu'i dus nas lhan skyes su yod byas kyang ngo mi tsha ba lags zhus pas/ 'o de dgos/ 'on kyang blo sbyong gi mthus dge ba'i blo sna re skyes kyang yang yang blo ma sbyangs na 'gyur 'gro sla bas dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs re re nas ngo bo/ grangs nges/ go rim rnams so so nas blo thog la 'jags pa zhig dgos/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung 'di blo la byang bar gyis gsungs nas khrid yig gi dpe cha zhig gnang*/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin blo la byung bas thugs mnyes/ de 'dra dgos/ glen pa'i sems gnas u tshug zhig la rtsis chen du byed pa'i sgom chen de 'dras mi 'ong*/ sgom chen rab la ston pa rab/ sgom chen 'bring la ston pa 'bring*/ tha ma la tha ma zhig 'ong gsungs pa de bden/ nged kyis bshad pa'i tshig sgros tsam yang ma nyams par ci zin gyis la bsam dgos/ sems sbyong bdun las gsungs pa bzhin dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung la 'chad nyan byed pa bas bla ma'i gsung sgros tshig gcig bzung ba'i bsod nams che bar gsungs pa de yin/ bla ma'i gsung sgros la brtag dpyad ci yang med par rang rang gi kha nas ci thon thon byas pas rnying ma pa'i snyan brgyud phal cher chad/

des na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa la brgyud pa'i man ngag ma nub pa gal che gsungs pa yid la bcags te tshig re re yang blo la bzung*/ zin bris su btab/ deng sang yang bka' drin can gyi dngos slob tu gyur pa rnams las sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gang gi skabs na'ang nged kyi bshad pa 'di zab shos su byung*/ dus phyis bla ma a stobs zhal nas bla ma bka' drin can sku tshe'i stod la a bu'i zhal rgyun rnams cher mi gnang bas da res khyod la gsungs pa rnams ches zab/ nga'i rna ba 'di bsod nams zad pa zhig red/ rtogs 'bul byed pa yin zer mkhan mang po 'ong nas so sor sems ngo 'dra ba re bshad rgyu 'dug kyang sems rig shan 'byed nas rig ngo tsam shes pa yang su mi 'dug nged rang gi shes rgyu de khong rnams la bstan rgyu ni mi 'dug bshad kyang snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa ci bzhin med pas brda 'phrod pa'ang dka' bar 'dug gsungs nas bka' drin can gyi khrid rgyun de gsan/ gang ltar yang a bu'i zhal rgyun bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis kyi khrid rgyun rnams nged rang gcig pu tsam las thams cad la khyab brdal du gnang tshod ma red snyam pa yid la shar/ bka' drin can gyi sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma bsod rgyal/ a stobs rnam pa gnyis/ bar tsam gyi slob ma mkhan po rdor li/ gling mda' nor kho/ sa ngan dbang chen/ la kha sprul sku/ sprul sku a blo/ gser tog sprul sku/ 'phel tsha bla ma yon tan rnams dang*/ sku tshe smad zhig nas 'phel tsha pad+ma rdo rje/ bsod nams nor bu/ pad+ma blo gsal/ rta kho pad+ma rdo rje/ sa ngan dkon mchog rnams gtso bor byon kyang man ngag thams cad kyi yang bcud snying por dril ba gnang nas zhal rgyun cung zad kyang mi nyams par gal che tshul sogs dang*/ don brgyud kyi brgyud pa gtad pa'i gsung 'phros snga phyi du ma la nges pa thob/ bka' drin can gyi slob ma'i gtso bo bla ma rgyal mtshan dang yon tan rnams la gsung 'phros phebs pa las/

nga la a bu rin po ches lo brgya re na snying thig gi bstan pa dag ther byed pa la bi ma la re 'byon par gsungs pa'i dus su nye la khad zhig tu snang*/ khong gis ni mi mjal/ khyod kyis mjal 'ong gsungs/ rdzogs chen sprul sku de e yin bsams kyang a bu rang gi mjal bar ma zad gsang snying gnang ba'i slob ma yin pas brtags na mi 'dra/ da ngag li 'di min na ngas mjal ma song*/ khong rnam dpyod dang lam rtags skye tshul gang la dpag kyang yin pa 'dra zhes phebs 'dug 'on kyang bi ma dngos yin rgyu dka' yang spyi bo na oṃ/ smin mtshams su hūm̐ yig sna rtser yi ge a yi ri mo dang lus la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan sogs yig 'bru rnams kyi mtshan mas spras pa da lta mngon sum snang ba 'di dag dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i chos 'chad nyan gyi sgo dang por phye ba'i skabs 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub pa dang*/ me tog gi char bab pa sogs ltas bzang po snga phyir byung ba dang*/ rjes 'jug gi gang zag mos gus can phal mo che 'chi khar mngon sum rjes su bzung ba sogs ya mtshan mthun snang du byung ba 'di dag la dpag na rjes 'jug dag gis mos gus kyi rten du rung tsam mchis/ bla ma gter chen mdun gter gsar dbang lung yongs rdzogs zhus/ de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor mgor a stobs mdun snying thig gter pod gnyis kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs zhus/ de nas bka' drin can gyis/ da bsnyen pa dang sngon 'gro'i sbyangs pa gnyis 'thus kyi/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor de bsags dgos/ snying thig 'di la byin rlabs bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa la/ phyi sgrub bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas sngon 'gro phyi nang gi khrid kyis rgyud sbyangs/ nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa la brten nas lung a nu yo ga spyi mdo dgongs 'dus kyi le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dgongs pa thun mong bskyed rim gyis ma dag pa bdun non tshul/

de yan gyi pa'i lhag ma rnams snyan brgyud shog dril yid bzhin nor bu'i lam nas ma dag sgyu lus dang dpe'i 'od gsal bskyed nas rim gyis slob pa'i zung 'jug nas mi slob zung 'jug gi go 'phang la sbyor tshul dang*/ rig 'dzin thugs sgrub drag po dpal chen 'dus pa'i 'grel pa dpal chen zhal lung*/ de'i don 'grel 'og min bgraud pa'i them skas/ de'i bka' 'grel a bu rin po che'i gsung dpal he ru ka gal po'i dgongs pa rim pa lnga'i sgo nas bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i nyams len/ gsang sgrub thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol/ yang gsang bla ma'i sgrub pa thig le'i rgya can/ yum bka' bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi khrid/ klong chen snying thig ces yongs su grags pa'i gtso bo ye shes klong gi rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ lung kun tu bzang po'i dgongs nyams/ de dag gi don 'grel ye shes bla ma/ kun mkhyen zhal lung bcas de ltar kun mkhyen 'jigs gling tshun smin khrid kyi phyag bzhes de yod pas/ da bla ma'i rnal 'byor la phyi gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bsnyen pa bye ba gcig gsungs kyang da lam bsnyen pa bye ba gsum 'gro nges dgos gsungs pa bzhin shes pa lnga'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad/ 'di'i yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel brkyang phyag 'bum ther bsags/ de yang bka' drin can zhal mjal chos kyi 'brel ba thob nas bzung bla ma sangs rgyas su lta ba'i mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs pa las mir 'dzin gyi rtog ngan gtan nas 'char ma myong*/ thun phyed yan dngos grub bsgrub pa dang de man dngos grub bskul ba'i gsol 'debs gnyis sid+dhi bye ba gcig ma song bar brgya skor re'i mtshams su btags nas phyi ma gnyis la bsnyen pa stong rtsa re'i mtshams su sgrub pa dang bskul ba'i gsol 'debs kyi sham sbrel/ bsnyen pa'i skabs shig tu sku mdun phyin par nyin gung gsol tshigs mdzad 'phral gzim khang la zhabs skor nyer lnga re chag med gnang ba'i phyag phyi la phyin/

spyang lpags kyi skod lcibs la lham sgrog gis mjug ma 'dra ba zhig btags nas chab bsang la bzhugs dus nga'i rnga li nas 'then gsungs nas der 'then pas gos mtha' nang du mi dril bar bsang khang du bzhugs bde ba'i khyad yod pa de nyin ci yang mi gsung bar sngar bzhin spyod lam nang bzhugs song bar bzhugs stabs mi bde ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ phran nas sngar bzhin bla ma'i rnga li nas i 'then zhus pas brjed song ba red 'then 'then gsungs/ zhor la tshur gzigs nas bu ngas kha ngan lang gis rnga li zer ba khyod la khag med/ lar bla ma 'di sangs rgyas chos skur lta ba las gzugs sku rang mtshan par blta mi rung bar gsungs na rnga mi zhes smros ga la rung*/ gang dag nga la gzugs su sogs lung drangs nas bla ma sangs rgyas chos skur lta mi shes nas de gzugs can sgra can dri can ro can reg bya can du bzung na rtog ngan des bsgribs nas mchog gi dngos grub yang dag bsgrub pa la gegs chen po byed pas/ 'dren pa rnams ni chos nyid lta zhes gsungs phyir chos nyid kyi rigs pas bla ma sangs rgyas chos skur blta dgos gsungs rkyen gyis nges par sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang zhes pa 'di ka yin snyam pa'i nges shes bcos min skyes/ thag nye ring nyin mtshan gang gi dus su yang ye shes kyi gzigs pa rnam par dag pa'i spyan snga na mi gzigs pa gang yang med pas de'i spyan snga na rgyun par yod snyam gyis rtog ngan phra mo tsam la'ang skrag pa dang dogs pa chen po'i sgo nas dran pa dang shes bzhin yang dag pa brten nas gnas pas bla ma dang sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'di lta bu zhig la gsungs snyam pa dran/ bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa sogs lnga po lung rigs kyis bsgrubs pas bcos ma dang bcos min gyi mos gus skye ba snga ma'i lag rjes su song*/ de nas bzung dbang chos kyis 'brel ba'i bla ma rnams bka' drin dang thugs rje tshad med pa'i rnam par bltas nas thugs mnyes pa 'ba' zhig las sun pa skad cig kyang ma bskyed par thugs zin par byas/

phyis su rdzogs chen mkhan po bsod chos zhal nas bdag la dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten mkhas pa 'phags pa nor bzang gi rnam thar gyi rjes su 'gro ba zhes bsngags pa kho na gnang ba bzhin bla mar ma zad rdo rje'i mched lcam la'ang skyon 'dogs ngan brjod lkog lab sogs phra mo tsam bgyis pa mi dran pas dam tshig gtsang shes zhig yin snyam gyi gdeng mchis/ deng sang snyigs ma'i rang shugs kyis chos dang dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i bla ma dang mched lcam la skyon rtog dang ngan brjod ngos dga' dang lkog lab/ ru nga phrag dog tshig ngan gdug rtsub 'ba' zhig gis kun zhe 'gras par byed/ thos rgya dang bshad res 'jig rten phun tshogs kyi gzi byin bskyed/ thob dang go sa tsam skyabs su brten nas dam ldan gyi snyems pa 'chang*/ sgrub pa dang smin grol gyi gzugs brnyan ngoms nas grub rtags dang nus mthu la re ba chen po byed pa rnams dam nyams ngan song gi rgyu las gzhan du ma dmigs pas sngags kyi theg pa 'dir dam tshig gtsang ba zhig shin tu khag che/ zhi ba lha rgyud las/ bla ma lha dang mched lcam rnams// mi 'bral brten pa'i dam tshig gtso// zhes pa ltar lags/ de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zin pa dang mnyam du bskyed rim zhig bslab na legs gsungs nas srog sdom gzer bzhi'i man ngag khams gsum rol pa tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs la rgyas bshad/ 'og min bgrod pa'i them skas de'i dka' 'grel bcas dang*/ khyad par rim pa lnga po 'di ma hā dang a nu gnyis la go ba thun mong du khyer dgos pa'i gnad gal po che yin pas/ he ru ka gal po las/ rdo rje'i bzlas dang sems la dmigs// bdag byin rlabs dang 'od gsal ba// zung du 'jug pa 'di lnga la// rim pa lnga zhes bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams kyi thad nas bshad pa legs par thonapa a bu bka' drin can tsam yin zhes bshad pa gzab rgyas zhig gnang*/ zin bris nyung ngu zhig kyang btab/

de skor gyi dogs sel dang dri ba snga phyi mang du bgyis pas rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa gnyis la go ba rnal ma zhig chags song*/ de 'phral lha bzo bla ma rig 'dzin nas zhus ngor ngal gso skor gsum gyi don khrid gnang ba yang mnyam por zhus/ ngal gso'i don khrid la zla shas su blo sbyang dgos gsungs pa bzhin dmigs rnam rim gyis bskyangs/ bskyed rim skabs shig na bla mas tha mal snang zhen gyi gnyen po rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa gsum gyi sgo nas yul gsum gyad du gyur pa zhig gi bar bsgom dgos/ gzhan gyi lugs la bskyed rkyang bcos ma'i lam las dang po nas lta ba zhig ma gsungs kyang snga 'gyur ba rang gi lugs la dang po nas dag mnyam chen po'i lta ba la nges pa gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa zhig nges par dgos/ de yang rtsa rgyud gsang snying le'u lnga par/ rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul// byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum pa// rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis// thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal po che// zhes dang*/ snod bcud rgyud rnams dag rtogs shing*// zhes dang*/ mnyam gnyis lhag pa'i mnyam gnyis kyis// zhes dag pa gsum mnyam pa bzhi bdag nyid chen po'i gtan tshigs rnams gsungs kyang*/ rtogs pa bzhi'i gtan tshigs gi nang du de dag gi gnad 'du bas/ thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal por gtan la phebs pas grub don nam grub mtha' yin/ de la rgyu gcig pa'i gtan tshigs des dgag bya ma rig pa bden par 'dzin pa'i blo 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ste/ a ho/ srid rtsa'i nyes dmigs bdag tu rtog las 'phros*// sogs dang*/ e ma ho/ bde gshegs snying po las// rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul// zhes gsungs pa de gang yin na khyed rnams kyi zhi khro 'don dus/ rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /ces 'don rgyu'i rnam par rtog pa breng breng po 'di la bdag tu 'dzin pa zer ba yin/

de dgag pa la rgyu stong nyid du rigs gcig pas bsgrub pa yin kyang mtshan nyid theg pa'i thal rang gnyis gang rung gi rigs pas bden med du nges pa zhig sngon du song na 'di sgrub sla/ de min par rgyu rigs gcig pa'i phyir zhes pa'i gtan tshigs gis dbang rnon zhig yin na ma gtogs go mi chod par 'dug gsungs/ de la thal rang gnyis kyi rig pa gal gang che zhus par/ ci zer stong nyid du nges pa la khyad med/ de gnyis tha snyad kyi 'jog tshul tsam la rtsod 'dug kyang sngags kyi bsgrub bya mthar thug don gyi 'od gsal dang sgyu lus zung 'jug rlung dang thig le'i rdzogs rim la brten nas rlung sems dbu mar dag pa'i lag rjes las 'byung ba'i dpe don gyi ye shes 'od gsal dang*/ de'i rjes thob na snang ba bden med sgyu ma lta bur 'char na de dus tha snyad kyi 'jog mtshams la ci byas kyang don la bden zhen med par mnyam/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa grub mtha' sems tsam pa dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa rang rgyud/ zhi ba lha thal 'gyur ba yin kyang de dag gi mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i mthong lam gyi rtogs rigs la khyad ma byung ba yin gsungs/ de ci 'dra lags zhus pas/ de dus rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog tshogs kyang 'gags dgos na tha snyad kyi 'dzin stangs shig la a'u tsi gsungs/ lar de lta na thal rang gnyis kyi lugs gnyis po la tha snyad kyi 'jog tshul des bzang ngan dang phan gnod med dam zhus pas/ ci zer/ tha snyad rang gi gnas tshul la sgro 'dogs chod ma chod zhig los yod/ des lam la gegs chen po byed pa min gsungs/ 'o na da lta thams cad kyis phan tshun rtsod 'dug pa ci yin zhus pas/ de rnams kyis lam gyi 'gro lugs ma shes par lta ba nga bzang khyod bzang gis rtsod 'dug pa yin gsungs/ 'o na sangs rgyas bskyang dang legs ldan 'byed rnams kyis lam gyi 'gro lugs ma dgongs pa lags sam zhus par/
