ga la yin/ de gnyis kyis 'phags pa'i dgongs pa la tha snyad kyi sgro 'dogs bcad lugs la rtsod pa yin/ don dam la rnam grangs dang rnam grangs min pa'i don dam rtsal 'don che chung gi khyad yin ces gsungs kyang las dang po pas rnam grangs pa'i don dam la nges pa 'drongs nas tshogs lam pas de ltar go ba zhig dang zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa zhig grub pa'i steng lam la goms pa bsring pas des tshogs lam chen po bgrod thub na gzod lhag mthong la myong ba cung zad thob pas sbyor lam la 'pho/ stong nyid mngon sum pa'i dus rnam grangs min pa'i don dam pa dang po nas 'jog dgos/ sa dang po'i rtogs bya'i stong nyid de las sa bcu re re nas rtogs bya mi 'dra ba re med kyang blo stobs kyi nus pas 'jog pa ste/ deng sang thal 'gyur ba'i las dang po ba'i skabs su'ang rnam grangs min pa'i don dam khas len kun bral 'phags pa gsum gyi mnyam bzhag dang mthun par gtan la 'bebs dgos skad kyang 'phags pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs la khyad chen po yod par 'chad bzhin mnyam bzhag gsum la khyad par ci yang med pa ci ltar sgrub/ mnyam bzhag rtog med tsam ni bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang khyad ci yang med pas des bdag 'dzin dang bden 'dzin la ci yang mi gnod do// byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal maid phyir// shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min// gsungs pa de yin/ dang po nas nga la khas len med/ spros bral yin zer ba'i chos skad chen po ngag nas gang thon thon du smras pas bdag gnyis dang de'i 'dzin stangs la ci yang mi gnod/ dper na bdag tu 'dzin pa gnyis po yang khas len mod/ spros bral yin zhes brjod pas ci 'ong*/ kha lta ma mtho/ rang re mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i rjes 'jug yin rtsis dgos pas dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba gtso bor 'dzin pa rten 'brel gyi legs cha che/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i lta ba thams cad kyi mtho shos dbu ma thal 'gyur pa yin kyang de la nges pa ma nor ba rnyed dka'/

de'i rgyu mtshan nged thal 'gyur ba yin zer nas rang rang gi zhe 'dod kyi steng du thal 'gyur ba'i lung mang po zhig drangs nas rtsod 'dug kyang lung la blta rgyu ci yod/ lung gla lpags gnyis gar 'then yin/ phyin chad rigs pas dpyad nas nges pa yang dag zhig rnyed dgos/ bsod nams chen pos rtogs bya yin/ dbu ma'i rtags dang gtan tshigs rnams kha phyir ltas shag 'gyed dang rtsod pa tsam la go ba mi len par nang rang gi bden 'dzin gyi 'dzin stangs kyi yul gtso bo de'i thog tu 'gro dgos/ de song na yul la bdag med mthong ba des bden 'dzin gyi blo la mi gnod mi srid do/ dper na mun tshab tshub tu thag khra la sbrul 'dzin skyes pa mar me'i snang ba dang sbyar na thag pa yin par nges shing sbrul 'dzin bzlog nus/ sbrul 'dzin yun ring ma goms pas lan gcig bzlog na slar mi ldog bden 'dzin yun ring por goms pas blo la dpyad stobs kyis nges pa yun ma bsring na bzlog mi nus pas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thugs gzu bor gnas pa zhig bsten/ mig skyon med pa bzhin rnam dpyod ma 'khyog pa zhig gis yun ring por dpyad na go rgyu yod/ des na las dang po pa'i lta ba 'di la gnyis yod/ rigs pas dpyad nas mdo sngags gnyis ka'i rang lugs kyi lta ba la nges shes gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa zhig thon dus nges pa'i lta ba zer ba yin/ sngags kyi dag mnyam chen po'i lta ba la nges pa de 'dra zhig sngon du song nas gzod bskyed rim zhig bsgom na de la bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug zhes btags kyang chog de min par bla ma ga ge mo'i gsung yin/ lung che ge na 'dug zer nas rang la nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med pa de 'dra la mos pa'i lta ba zer/ de 'gyur sla zhing yid brtan med pa zhig yin/ des na nges pa'i lta ba zhig ci nas gal che/ 'on kyang gsang sngags mos pa lam byed ces gsungs pas mos pa tsam 'di yang dgos nus med pa zhig tu bsam mi rung*/

da dus rang la ltar snang bcos ma dang yang dag pa'i lam gang yin 'byed pa'i blo gros med par gzhan zer rjes rgyug gi lad mo ma byed/ a bu'i zhal nas/ yang dag pa'i lam la go ba rnal ma zhig rgyud la e skye bsam na bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba drag tu thob/ tshogs sgo du ma nas bsags/ bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis sbrel la ltos/ blo drangs po zhig gi sgo nas dpyod dang gzod go rgyu yod/ ngas dang po rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs pa blangs/ de nas rjes 'jug mkhas pa'i bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa blangs/ khyung nam mkha' nas lding ba ltar spyi rgya rlabs kyis bcad nas sa la bab pa dang 'dra bar byas/ khyed rnams kyis rdo brko ba ltar tshig 'bru re re nas gnyer/ gzhan gyi gzhung lugs re mjal dus blo gzu bor mi gnas par ngas de la lan ci 'debs snyam pa las ngan 'di mi shes pas rang la phan pa'i blo skyed e 'byung gi bsam pa med pas de 'dras ci phan mi thogs gsungs pa de thugs shin tu bden pa'i gsung byung ba yin/ khong 'phags pa yin pas bka' dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa blangs nas gzigs pa'i 'bras rtags theg chen mdo mthong gi phan yon 'di gcig pus kyang shes/ de 'dra ste dka' mo yin kyang gzhan zer tsam la rjes brjod mi dgos par rang gi rigs pas dpyad thub pa zhig dgos/ a bus/ nged rnams la rigs pa'i sne tsam re bstan nas da rigs pas dpyod/ sdod gsungs pa bzhin rgyu gcig pa'i gtan tshigs kyis chos thams cad ngo bo skye med du gtan la phebs pa zhig dgos/ de ltar stong nyid nges pa'i blo zhig las sngags kyi ye shes de mi dgos sam zhus pas/ ci zer/ ye shes de yang gcig dang du bral gyi rigs ngo la mi stong pa ci yod/ dang po gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos thams cad stong nyid du nges pa chos spyi'i gnas lugs sam gtso bo yul gyi gnas lugs yin/ de rjes yul can sems kyi gnas lugs zhig gtan la 'bebs pa la skabs 'dir lhag pa'i dkor bdun ngo bo nyid du lhun gyis grub pa zhes dbyings dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa de gtan la 'bebs pa la rgyud kyi gtan tshigs de dag gi go ba chags pa tsam las rtogs rgyu dka' bas 'dir yang stong nyid de tshogs lam pas go ba sogs dang sbyar nas shes dgos/

gnyis pa yig 'bru'i tshul gyi gtan tshigs kyis a u ma gsum 'dus pa oṃ gyis mtshon nas/ mdo ltar na stong pa de rten 'byung 'gags med du 'char tshul bsgrub pa bzhin 'dir yang ye shes kyi rol pa sna tshogs 'gag med du 'char ba mtshon pa yin/ ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di ye shes kyi rol pa/ rol pa de dang lha rtog dbyer med du nges pa bskyed tshul yin/ de ltar rgyu mtshan ci yang ma nges par snang ba lha yin zer ba bla ma don pas kha sna gnyis gcig yin zer ba dang 'dra/ gsum pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtan tshigs ni ye shes dang rol pa gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig la rgyas thebs pa/ mdo las stong rten 'byung dbye bsal med par sgrub pa bzhin ye shes kyi rol pa 'di ye shes las gzhan du med pa chu dang rlabs ltar ram/ chab rom du snang dus nas chu yin pa bzhin ma dag pa snang dus rang nas ngo bo ye shes kyi rol par nges pas snang ba stong thog tu spyan ma drangs/ stong pa snang thog tu spyan 'dren ma dgos par dang po nyid nas ye shes kyi rol pa/ lha rtog dbyer med yin pa la yin pa'i nges shes skyes pa zhig dgos/ de ltar rtogs shing goms na mngon du 'gyur ba yin/ spyir blos rtogs tshad mngon du 'gyur mi dgos kyang 'dir ni lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med de dang po lta bas rtogs/ de nas sgom pas mngon du 'gyur dgos pa ni dngos po'i chos nyid dang bden gnyis dbyer med yin pa'i gnad kyis so// bzhi pa mngon sum pa'i gtan tshigs ni blo gang gis rtogs dgos na 'phags pa'i mngon sum yin pa bzhin 'dir yang so so rang rig gi ye shes kyi mngon sum sgrub pa yin/ las dang po pa'i skabs na so so rang rig gi mngon sum ji bzhin med kyang de ltar rtogs dgos pa'i go ba nges pa zhig dgos/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes 'di la skabs tha dad yod kyang phyin chad dngos gzhi'i khrid skabs bshad gsungs/

da lta ba bden gnyis dbyer med nges pa'i steng nas bsnyen pa zhig btang dgos pas tha mal ma dag pa'i snang zhen gnyis kyi gnyen por gong du bshad pa'i gtan tshigs bzhi po las snga mas dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par nges pa lhag pa'i don dam bden pa yin pas de don dam dpyod byed kyi shes rab kyis rtogs dgos/ gnyis pas snang grags rig gsum ye shes kyi cho 'phrul rten 'byung 'gags pa med pa lha dang rtog pa dbyer med lhag pa'i kun rdzob bden pa zhes bya ba tha snyad pa'i tshad mas nges par 'jog pas de gnyis kyi dang pos dngos po rang rgyud pa 'di la bden zhen 'gog par ma zad dbyings ye gnyis med du rtogs pa des ma dag pa'i zhen tshul dngos por zhen pa dang bdag tu zhen pa gnyis 'gog dgos/ tshad ma gnyis pas tha mal ma dag pa'i snang ba'i dang tha snyad pa'i 'khrul shes de gtso bor 'gog pa yin pas de gnyis kyis don dam nges pa'i lta ba gtso bor ston/ gsum pas lta ba nges par goms nas de bzhin mngon du 'gyur nus sam/ nus na'ang phyir mi ldog gam snyam pa'i rtog ngan skye na de la dogs pa gcod tshul yin/ bzhi pa de ltar lhag pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med chos sku chen por rtogs pa la 'phags pa'i blo ltar so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi dngos su rtogs pa'i shugs kyis kun rdzob dag pa lha rtog dbyer med du nges pa'i tha snyad pa'i shes pa de yod dgos te/ snang ba bden par ma bzung yang ma dag pa'i snang ba snang ba ltar bzung na lhag pa'i kun rdzob bden pa la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa yin pas lha rtog dbyer med nges pa zhig rdo rje theg pa'i skabs 'dir shin tu gal che bas de dag gi tshul rnams shes nas nyams su len pa de la sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa zhes btags kyang chog gsungs/ nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa 'di rgyud kyi zin so a nu yo ga ltar yin kyang gter gyi bab tshul la rtsa ba gsum las byin rlabs bla ma'i sgrub pa yin pas/

ma bcos rig pa stong gsal ngang*// zhes a nu'i dbyings ye gnyis su med pa'i rtsal snang lhar sgom pa yin kyang*/ da res ma hā yo ga ltar ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyi sgo nas ting nge 'dzin la sems gzhol ba legs pas/ ngo bo stong pa nyid/ gdangs snying rje chen po/ rnam pa yi ge hūm̐ yig tu shar ba de las dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bskyed pa la rgyu gcig pa/ yig 'bru'i tshul/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtan tshigs de rnams 'dir dran par byas nas bsgom dgos/ de yang bsnyen pa'i zhag grangs tsam la mi re bar/ bsnyen pa bya ba yang yang 'dres pa'i don yin pas rnam pa hūm̐ yig bsgom pa nas dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar sra sra 'thas 'thas su bsgom par gu ru rin po ches gsungs/ de yang mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba sogs rdo rje chos bdun dang ldan pa gzung rnam lhar shar zhing 'dzin rnam stong nyid du dag pa zhig bsgom dgos/ sra ches pas bden par grub ga la dgos/ snang ba'i nga rgyal ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom gsungs pas gsal snang de yul gsum gyad du ma gyur bar bsgom dgos/ stong pa'i nga rgyal snang la rang bzhin med par gsal zhes snang dus nas rang bzhin bden par grub pa spu tsam med par shes pa zhig dgos kyang deng sang de gnyis kyi rnam bzhag ji bzhin ma shes par/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma chu zla 'ja' tshon 'dra ba zhes pas ya le yo le ba zhig dgos par bshad pa de log par bshad pa yin/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lha yal yol zhig gis bskyed rim mtshan nyid pa'i go mi chod/ der ma zad lam gong ma rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du yang 'gro dka'/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad la go ba ma chags pa dag gis bskyed rim 'di bcos ma'i lam yin/ rdzogs pa chen po'i gol sa yin zhes dang*/ gal srid bsgom kyang 'ja' tshon dang sgyu ma lta bu zhig la nan tan gyi bsngags brjod byed pa 'di rnying ma'i bstan pa snyigs pa'i rtags yin pas bzlas brjod kyi zhag grangs gtso bo min/

bskyed rim bsgom pa gal che gsungs/ khyod kyi bsnyen pa'i thog ma yin pas mtshams dam por sdod/ yun ma ring mjug ma bud na bya ba brtsam ldog gi nyes pas tshe rabs du mar bya ba mthar phyin pa mi 'byung bas zhag zhe dgu tsam la sdod gsungs/ de bzhin bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bsnyen pa la zhugs nas thun bzhi re re'i phyed tsam la ting 'dzin rnam gsum gco bor gyur pa la dmigs pa'i 'dzin stangs gsal ngar dang ldan par bslab/ thun gyi phyed man chad bsnyen pa bzla ba'i zhor la gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i gsal 'debs res mos dang cig char gang yang rung bar byas/ 'di dag gi skabs rnams su ma dag pa'i snang ba'i gnyen por rnam par gsal ba'i dus rnam pa la blo kha phyogs tsa na rang nyid de dang der gyur song ba 'dra ba las bsgrim nas bcos mi dgos pa'i gsal snang brtan po skyes/ skabs shig mdun du shog gsungs nas khyod kyi bskyed rim de ci 'dra byed pa yin gsungs/ sgom tshul zhus pas ha lam red 'dug snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gsungs pa de snang ba gang yin lhar sgom ga la dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang sku dang longs spyod mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin gnas dang zhing khams dang gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs phrin las dang bcas par srog sdom gzer bzhi'i man ngag de kun la 'khyer shes dgos/ rnam pa gsal ba sngar bsgom pa des chog 'di ma dag pa'i snang ba'i dngos gnyen yin/ da zhen pa'i gnyen po rnam dag dran pa dang nga rgyal brtan pa gnyis bsgom dgos/ zhen tshul la dngos por zhen pa dang bdag tu zhen paganyis yod pas dang po'i gnyen por rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ de la lha rang rgyud du zhen pa byung na rnam dag dran pa zhal gsum sku gsum/ phyag drug phar phyin drug sogs 'bras chos rnams rten dang brten par shar ba'i nges shes zhig gzhir bcas/

nga rgyal brtan pa de bdag bden par 'dzin pa'i gnyen por res 'ga' lha'i rnam pa ji lta bar gsal nas lha de dang de yin pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ res 'ga' rnam pa mi gsal bar chos nyid don gyi lha gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi ye shes gu ru rin po che'i nga rgyal bskyed la bzlas pa gyis/ 'di rnams bskyed rim gyi gnad che shos yin gsungs pa bzhin bslab pas bskyed rim gyi gsal snang la brtan pa rnyed/ bsnyen pa badz+ra gu ru bye ba gcig dang rig 'dzin spyi dril 'bum phrag bzhi song ba na bla ma'i gsung las da bar chad ma byung bar legs tshe zhog gsungs/ de bzhin mtshams grol nas mdun du phyin par/ de yin spyir bskyed rim 'di zhi gnas sgrub pa dang thun mong gi las rab 'byams sgrub pa la med thabs med/ lam gong ma rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du'ang 'gro ba yin/ dag ma dag gi sgyu lus su ldang ba'ang bskyed rim 'di'i nus pa sems la thengs pa dang 'phen pa'i dbang las lha skur ldang nus pa yin/ spyir lhar bskyed pa gar yod la bskyed rim gyi go ba kho nas mi phan/ ngag dben gyi sngon 'gro/ lus dben sgom pa de dang bskyed rim sgom pa gnyis la khyad chen po yod/ da mkha' 'gro yum ka'i chos 'di gzhung gi dngos bstan la a ti yo ga'i lugs skad cig dran rdzogs kyis lhar bskyed pa'i tshul yin/ snying thig brgyud pa'i rig 'dzin rnams tshul 'di la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes shing bod 'bangs yongs la bka' drin che/ gsang ba rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag mo yin pa dang yab bka' yum bka'i 'brel yang che bas 'di la bsnyen pa zhig btang dgos/ spyir bskyed rim gyis skye 'chi bar do gsum gyi bag chags sbyong ba yin/ bag chags rigs bsdu na skye gnas bzhi'i bag chags la 'dus/ de sbyong byed bskyed rdzogs lam gyis sbyangs pas 'bras bu gnas skabs rig 'dzin bzhi dang*/

mthar thug zung 'jug gi go 'phang brnyes pa yin pas dang po ma hā yo ga'i lugs kyi sgong skyes kyi bag chags sbyong ba la rgyas pa bdag sras gzhan sras kyi sgo nas bskyed pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i sgrub thabs rnams su bstan pa de yin/ dpal chen 'dus pa la dod thub tsam ma gtogs rgyas pa mi 'dug de la bdag gi sras su gzhan bya ba ni rig pa bde gshegs snying po'i rigs kyi che ba'i yon tan 'byin pa'i phyir de ltar bsgom nas 'khor 'das kyi dwangs ma bsdus te rang gi sras su bya ba yin/ gzhan gyi sras su bdag bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gdung rgyud mi 'chad pa'i phyir dag pa mngon gyur gyi sangs rgyas 'bras bu'i he ru ka yab yum du gsal nas yum gyi sras bskrun par yab la gsol ba btab pas bdag gi phung khams skye mched rnams 'od zhu nas thig ler gyur pa yab kyi shangs bug nas rngubs ste bde chen byang chub sems kyi thig le dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa yab yum gyi mkha' gsang nas rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan rdzogs par gsal nas gzod dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su 'god cing bskyed pa yin/ 'bring po mngon byang lnga bskyed dam bzhi bskyed/ rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed rnams kyis sbyangs bya mngal skyes kyi 'byung ba lnga/ phung po lnga/ rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad/ bar do'i rlung sems khu rdul dang dbang po yul la sad nas mnga' ris longs spyod dang bcas pa'i bag chags rnams sbyong tshul 'og min bgrod pa'i them skas su bshad pa de rnams nges dgos/ gu ru'i bka' srol gter ma phal mo cher rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed kho na 'byung ba mang*/ des na phyi sgrub ma hā yo ga nang sgrub a nu yo ga gsang sgrub a ti yo ga'i cho ga'i 'gros shig nges par shes dgos kyang*/ deng sang 'don cha'i tshig mang nyung tsam la btags pa 'di mi shes pa'i gtam du song*/

drod gsher skyes kyi bag chags sbyang ba la a nu yo ga'i mtshan sngags brjod pa tsam gyis bskyed pa dang*/ dbyings ye gnyis su med pa'i rtsal snang lhar gsal ba'i 'gros gnyis yod pa sngar bshad pa ltar yin/ rdzus skyes kyi bag chags sbyong ba la a ti yo ga'i lta ba rig pa chos sku dang rig rtsal chos sku'i rol par ngo 'phrod pa zhig gis snang srid dag mnyam chen por ye nas gzhi la bzhugs par lta bas nges pa de nyid lam sgom pas skad cig dran rdzogs su gsal 'debs pa yin pas/ des na skye gnas bzhi gang rung zhig sbyangs na gzhan rnams shugs la sbyong ba yin te/ sbyang gzhi 'od gsal ba'i ye shes gcig yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sbyang bya 'khor ba'i bag chags su rigs gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ sbyong byed bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir na bskyed rim la rgyas bsdus su gsungs pa de ltar shes dgos/ kun mkhyen chen pos sems nyid ngal gso las bskyed tshul de rnams gang zag gcig gis dang por goms pa dang*/ bar du goms pa dang*/ rab tu goms pa dang*/ mchog tu goms pa'i sgom tshul du gsungs pa lam nges rdzogs kyi dbang du na de ltar shin tu gal che/ mos sgom pas nang rgyud sde gsum gyi 'gros ci sbyar 'di sbyar cang med/ a don khos tshig rjes don dran byed pa yin zer nas kaḥthog nas gsang ba snying po'i rgyud 'chad thabs kyi cho ga de rgyun du kha 'don byed pa 'di 'dra yin/ 'on kyang bag chags bzang po re los 'jog da res a ti yo ga'i lugs kyi yum bka' 'di skad cig dran rdzogs su gsal 'debs pa yin kyang khyod kyis dngos gzhi'i khrid ma thob pas ji bzhin mi 'ong yang rang gi sems nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i rtsal snang du rten dang brten pa'i gsal snang rdzogs pa gal che/ bskyed rdzogs gsum po gang gi lugs la'ang lhar gsal ba la dang po spros pa che chung tsam ma gtogs lha la gsal snang 'don zhing de la brtan cha thob dgos pa la khyad med pas khyod sngon gyi bag chags kyi mthus lhar snang sbyang ba la dka' tshod du mi 'dug pas da res bsnyen pa'i skabs su dzab dgongs rnam pa bzhi las zla ba skar phreng dang*/

rgyal po'i pho nya lta bu'i bzlas pa gnyis ma hā yo ga'i dzab bzla lugs yin/ yang na rgyal po'i pho nya lta bu 'di gsum ka'i bzlas pa byas kyang chog khyogs kyi bzlas po'am do li'i bzlas pa a nu yo ga'i lugs yin cing*/ de yang sems bying ba'i gnyen por thugs ka'i sngags kyi phreng ba sku'i stod nas brgyud yab kyi shangs bug nas yum gyi shangs bug dang mkha' gsang nas rtsa ba'i sngags phreng la thim par bsam pa dang*/ rgod pa'i gnyen por sku'i smad nas dang mkha' gsang nas shangs bug brgyud de mgal me ltar bar ma chad par 'khor bar dmigs nas bzla ba yin/ 'di'i dgos pa gtso bo bde stong gi ye shes 'dren pa dang khyad par thig le dbab 'dren la gal che/ bskyed rim la shin tu goms pa yin na gtso bo yab yum bsgom nas do li'i bzlas pa tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes 'dren/ der ma zad gtso 'khor chos kyi bgro ba dang*/ 'dod rnam gyi lha mo las 'dod yon dngos su len pa'i skabs yod cing*/ ma zad chos kyi rdo rje'i reg byas bde chen gyi ye shes 'dren pa sogs 'byung*/ bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin la goms pa mchog tu thob pas rlung sems gnad gcig phyir sems gar gtad du zin pa zhig 'ong bas de dus rdzogs rim rlung dang thig le la sbyang na sla/ de 'dra ma 'ong na rlung dang gtum mo sgom pas gtso bo rlung dang thig le la dbang thob pa'i zhar la sems las rung khyad par can thob/ de'i stobs kyis spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul khyad par ba thob pa yin kyang deng sang ltar snang tsam du dgun khar rtsa rlung sbyang ba yin zer nas gnad ma zin pa'i 'khyag rgur byed pa rnams phyi rol pa'i khyi dang ba lang gi brtul zhugs dang du blangs pas dag grol nges 'byin du lta ba dang khyad med/ khyod la log lta e yod gsungs/ med lags zhus pas/ khyed dag snang re che kun la dag snang sbyangs/

yin min legs par dpyod la ltar snang bcos ma dang yang dag pa'i lam gnad shan 'byed pa'i blo gros dgos/ skabs 'di na a ti yo ga'i bzlas pa bung ba tshang zhig lta bu zhing khams gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa'i gsal snang thon par gyis la gtso bo sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi rang gdangs su gsal ba gtsor bor 'don gyis bsnyen pa thongs gsungs/ de bzhin nyin mtshan sbrel nas zla ba gcig gi ring bsnyen pa bskyal bas sgrar snang ba gang la'ang blo ched du gtad mi dgos par sngags kyi sgra gdangs su lam lam 'char ba zhig byung bas de dus lha dang snang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul tsam las gzhan du med pa ming gis btags pa tsam las rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes khyad par can thob pa la sgrub pa'i dngos grub kyi rigs mchog nyid du go de nas rang lo nyi shu pa'i gsar tshes zla ba dang po'i yar ngo zhig la bla ma a stobs mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhig zhus gsungs/ dge slong gi bslab pa'i rkang grangs mang bas ci bzhin lag len du theb par dka'/ nga dge tshul gyi rten 'di'i steng nas rang gi bslab pa'i gnas legs par bsrung na rten dge tshul gyis chog pa zhig zhus kyang*/ mi chog da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa 'di don yod par byed pa la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob pa'i thabs med/ sngags kyi rten la'ang dge slong mchog yin te/ dgyes rdor las/ gsum las dge slong mchog yin 'bring*// dge tshul zhes bya de dag las// khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o// zhes gsungs/ dge slong la bslab pa'i rkang grangs mang bas tshogs rdzogs pa la stobs che/ des na sgrib pa dag pa la yang stobs che ba yin/ tshogs rdzogs pa dang sgrib pa dag pa'i stobs ci tsam 'phel ba las lam gyi mngon rtogs khyad par can skye ba'i dngos rgyu thun mong ma yin pa lags pas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen sgron// 'bar ba'i snod ni dka' thub can// ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras// dge slong rnams ni yin phyir ro// zhes gsungs pas bslab pa gsum gyi rten mchog tu gyur pa rin po che'i sgron me lta bu shes rab kyi bslab pa'i mngon rtogs khyad par can gyi rten du ches 'phags pa yin te/

dus 'khor las/ sa thob ma gtogs khyim pa ni// rgyal po'i bla mar mi bya'o// zhes de bzhin gshegs pas chos rgyal zla ba bzang po la 'phags pa sa thob ma gtogs rten dge slong las khyim pa'i rten can bla mar bsten par mi bya bar gsungs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yod med dge slong gi rjes su byed pa yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ bstan rtsa dge slong nyid yin na// zhes gsungs pas dge slong sgrub pa ci nas gal che/ ngas mthun rkyen sbyor gsungs/ da res 'dir sa tshigs kyi mtha' 'khob yin kyang grangs yul dbus dang mthun par thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'od zer gtsos las grwa bcu tsam tshogs dgos gsungs nas dge 'dun bcu tshogs bsdus/ rnam sbyar dang lhung bzed gding ba bcas rung ba tshad dang ldan pa dgos/ nged kyi rnam sbyar lhag po 'di dang lhung bzed gding ba bcas khyer gsungs nas g.yar po gnang ba sogs kyi bdag rkyen las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa legs par thob/ de nas bzung dge slong gi ltung ba sde lnga po ci nus su bsrung*/ yo byad rnams dngos dang rnam btags kyis byin rlabs byas/ 'tsham btsos/ lag nyal/ rjen btsos/ me la reg pa/ rin po che la reg pa rnams la paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi dus dran de brten/ phyis su zang zing gi dngos po gtos che ba byung yang phal cher bla ma dkon mchog la bsngos/ mkhan po dang grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams dang sbyin bdag la yid gtad de bcangs/ rnam btags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa ma gtogs rang gar bzung ba med/ des na yongs bzung gi dngos po la mngon zhen chung ba/ rang nor la chog shes pa/ gzhan nor la 'dod rngams med pa/ 'dod chung chog shes pa'i 'du shes la dran pa mngon du bzhag nas 'phags pa'i rnam thar gyi srol bzung*/ dngos rdzas 'di nga na na dgos/ 'di shi na dgos snyam pa'i gding nor du bzung ba de 'dra yid la gtan ma shar/

gzhan gyi dpal 'byor dang mngon par mtho ba ci mthong yang yid smon dang ngo mtshar mi skye ba 'di zhen log sgom pa'i lag rjes su go 'di skabs shig tu bka' drin can sku bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan par gter ston bsod rgyal gyi lung bstan la dri med bshags rgyud 'bum ther gcig zhabs rim babs byung bar zhal slob brgya phrag phyed gnyis tsam sgar der bzhugs thams cad nas bshags rgyud gsungs/ klog bzang ba nyi shu skor gyis nyin rer tshar bco brgyad bcu dgu tsam ma gtogs mang mas nyin rer tshar mang po ma tshar bas zla shas 'gor/ rang nas kyang rgyud tshar stong phrag gcig dang brgya phrag gcig gi zhabs brtan phul/ slob ma so so nas zhabs brtan tshe thar stong phrag gsum tsam khas len bgyid pa byung ba'i mthus sku khams dwangs skyed thon/ zhal slob rnams kyis bla ma'i zhabs brtan du tshe sgrub zhag brgya re bsgrub par bgros te thams cad sku mtshams la bzhugs/ bla ma'i mdun phyin te phran nas da dung bshags rgyud de ci tshar zhig zhabs brtan du 'bul na zhus par/ da nga rgas nas sgyu lus kyi phung po dus kyis rnying pa'i ljon pa bzhin nam 'dor mi shes yang bla ma dang mched lcam la zhabs brtan phul na yan lag bdun pa'i nang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag yin pas rang gi 'phral gyi tshe gegs zhi/ phugs su tshe mthar phyin pa'i gnad khyad par can yod pas khyed kyang tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud kyi mtshams zhag la sdod/ tshe bum bhan+dha mda' dar rnams mi 'dzoms/ 'di 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril yin zhes shog chags zhig gnang nas 'di dang gtor ma tsam la brten nas sgrubs/ spyir gsang sngags kyi gzhung gi rdzas 'dzoms pa gal che/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum po la rgyu mtshan gyi khyad par re re yod kyang da lam khyod sngar rigs 'dus kyi bsnyen pa'i kha bskang dgos pas de dang khyon dril na legs/

de'ang thun phyed yan chad bsnyen pa bsags/ man chad la rlung dang thig le la brten pa'i tshe sgrub dgos pa rtsa rlung thig le'i spyi rnam tsam ni sngon 'gro'i nang du song ba des 'thus/ 'dir a nu yo ga'i nyams len sa bcad mi stong tsam du rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sgoms/ tshe zhes pa mngon par drod dang rnam shes ji srid du 'grogs pa'i skabs de la tshe zhes btags kyang sngags kyi skabs 'dir dang po ma'i mngal du lus sems rlung gsum 'tshogs pa'i dus na tshe zhes bya ba snying dbus dbu ma na khams dkar cha ba thag 'dra ba zhig chags pa de ring na tshe ring*/ thung na tshe thung*/ 'khyog na nad mang ba sogs bshad rgyu yod pa de la tshe zhes bya/ de nyams na tshe nyams/ zad na tshe zad pa yin pas de mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i ched rlung dang thig le'i sgo nas tshe sgrub dgos/ sems can gyi 'chi ba la rgyu gsum ste tshe zad nas 'chi ba/ las kyi 'phen shugs zad nas 'chi ba/ da lta'i bsod nams kyi 'phel kha phri nas 'chi ba gsum las re re zad pa la bzlog rgyu yod gnyis dang gsum zad pa la bzlog rgyu med/ rnal 'byor pa rlung dang thig le la rang dbang thob na snying ga'i rnam shes kyi rten srog 'dzin de mi 'pho ba tshe la dbang ba yin/ spyir ma hā yo ga'i tshe dbang rig 'dzin mthong lam skabs nas gsungs kyang de lam phyi ma rnams rten der bgrod pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ sngags kyi sbyor lam thob nas mthong lam la ma sbyor bar mi 'pho na de yang tshe la dbang ba yin/ mthong lam thob nas skye 'chi rang mtshan pa med pas ji ltar byas kyang chog sbyor lam dus snying ga dang spyi bo'i srog 'dzin gyi rlung gnyis la rang dbang bas 'dir rags pa'i rtsa rlung gi cha na phra ba dkar dmar rlung gsum gyi tshogs pa mi 'pho ba'i rang dbang yod/ mthong lam tshe dbang nas rags pa'i rtsa rlung gi cha de spangs zin kyang 'phags pa'i ye shes phra ba'i rtsa rlung thig le'i khams la rang dbang ba yin pas 'di gnyis la khyad par che/

gzhan phyi rol pa'i drang srong 'chi med brnyes pa rnams lhas mchog byin pa dang bcud len gyi rdzas kyi nus pa yin pas sngags kyi tshe sgrub pa la bsgrig tu maid/ gu ru rin po che theg pa mchog gi lam nas rnam smin 'byung ba'i snyigs ma ye shes kyi mes sbyang nas don dam pa rang bzhin gyi 'byung ba'i lha sku mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas nyag cig yin pas/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*// snang srid zil gnon thugs ka ru// zhes gsungs/ tshe la dbang ba thams cad yin khyab mnyam du go na nor tshabs che/ de nas rlung bum pa can sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi man ngag dang*/ gtum mo dang phra thig gi rim pa rnams gsungs nas/ zhag brgya bar nga'i rtsar ma 'ong ba sgom gsungs/ de bzhin bsnyen pa la zhugs pa'i mtshams shed na ril bu rnams las 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ gtor ma dang ril bu 'od du zhu ba/ rmi lam du ljon shing las 'bras bu'i rigs mang po la longs spyod pa sogs byung yang re dogs kyi spros pa dbyings su bzhag rlung la goms pa yun bsring bas zhugs gnas thim pa'i rtags rnams rim gyis rdzogs/ rlung gang 'dod du bzung chog pa byung*/ de nas gtum mo bsgom pas lus la bde drod dang khams zhu ba'i stobs kyis sems la bde stong gi nyams shar/ phyi rol du tsha grang gi reg pa gang gis kyang drod dang bde ba'i grogs su 'gro ba byung*/ phra thig la goms pa yun thung ngu tsam gyis sems sems byung gi rtog pa thams cad 'gags/ gnyid mthug lta bu'i mun 'thum de 'dra yang min par sems mi rtog pa de'i snang yul dang po stong seng nge ba la/ de yang nub nas sems stong gsal 'di yin ngos bzung med pa zhig la thun re re 'khyongs thub pa byung*/ zhag brgya song ba dang mtshams grol rjes sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams sku mdun du phul bas cung zad bzhes/ nga rgas pa yun ring bsdad na g.yog dka' ba tsam las med/

khyod lo chung bas skabs shig 'dug rgyu byung na legs pas ngas khyod la tshe dbang zhig bskur gsungs nas tshe 'gugs tshar gcig gsungs/ dngos grub kyi lhag ma thams cad gnang nas lhag med zo/ mi la ma sbyin gsungs/ yang dar gcig bzhugs nas gtor ma rul pa zos pas pho ba na ba'i rgyu las ci yod/ he he/ khyod kyis rtsa rlung de bsgoms pas rtags 'dra 'ong rgyu e 'dug gsungs/ sngar gyi lo rgyus rgyas par zhus pas khyod skye ba snga ma zhig tu rtsa rlung la goms pa'i bag chags sad pa 'dra/ gzhi nga rgyal ma che/ su la'ang ma bshad/ rgyun par nyams len ma skyur/ gsang sngags de ches myur ba'i khyad par e shes gsungs/ de nas da dung blo sbyong dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms/ mtsho rgyal zhus lan las/ thun re re bzhin blo ldog rnam pa bzhi po ma bsgom na thun mgor chos pa yin kyang thun mjug tshe 'di par cha gsungs pas/ chos pa phyi nang mtshungs pa re byed bsam na blo sbyong 'di gal che/ a bu rin po ches/ thun re re bzhin du thugs sbyong gnang nas brang la khu tshur gyis brdung bzhin e shi re gsung gin bzhugs/ dus phyis zhig na lung gces/ da ngas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gtan nas bsam mi phod par 'dug 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom dus mtho ris gsum po'i sdug bsngal tsam bsam pa yin gsungs/ rdo a ris nags nang na bzhugs skabs nangs dus 'jol mo grags dus khyod kyi hud dang kyi hud ces gsungs nas bzhugs pa de yi lad mo dgos/ dngos gzhi'i khrid zer ba'i mtho skad la nyan nas mtho snyab byas na mgo mtho sa nas btags na rke dma' sa nas 'chad zer ba de 'ong*/ dge slong thang pas rlung sems la rang dbang thob kyang rtog ngan zhig lam du ma long pas phyis yul du bab nas dmag dpon byed dgos pa'i gtam rgyud de yin gsungs nas slob ma gzhan rnams 'bum lnga legs po re thon tshad la dngos gzhi'i khrid gnang kyang bdag la yun ring po'i bar ma gnang*/

bla ma'i thugs la ci dgongs las dngos gzhi'i khrid snyegs dang gdams ngag la btsan thabs kyi 'jug pa gtan nas ma byas/ 'on kyang lo zla mang po'i sngon rol nas maṇ+ḍal gyi rten tsam phul nas nged kyi blo 'khos dang bstun pa sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gang gi skal bar ldan pa de gtso bor gnang thub pa thugs rjes rjes 'jin zhus par/ dngos gzhi'i khrid dka' mo yin/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ deng sang rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa'i mtha' la bab pas 'dir 'jug pa la bsags pa rab dang thos bsam rgya chen po zhig gi spyod yul las gzhan gyi skal ba min gsungs pa de yin/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad rnams 'phags pa'i gang zag zhig gi spyod yul las rang gar rgad po rgan mo yan chad kyis shes tshod mi 'dug gsungs/ rang lo nyer gcig pa'i dbyar thog khyim du 'gro rtsis kyis bsu ma slebs pa nyin gung dus mar phyur phran bu zhig 'bul rgyu khyer nas byin rlabs zhu ba bcas sku mdun mjal du phyin par bla ma gzims nas bzhugs 'dug re zhig sku rtsar bcar rgyu byol nas phyi rol du phyag phul te cung zad bsdad par dbu btegs byung*/ mdun du phyin te phyag rten rnams phul bas mar phyur mang po 'di ci yin gsungs/ nga de ring khyim du 'gro rtsis yin ma rgan nas chu gtor zhig bsngo dgos zer bas ston kha bar sleb mi 'ong zhus pas/ bka' drin can nas/ ngas rmi lam mtshar po zhig rmis zhes lan grangs du mar gsung kyang ci rmis zhu ma spobs/ ngos kyi rmi lam la brtag na khyod la dngos gzhi'i khrid gcig bshad na phar bshad mkhan zhig 'ong na ci shes/ khyim du ma 'gro sdod dang*/ khrid rgyas pa zhag brgya tsam bshad dgos gsungs lags/ ma rgan gyi chu gtor de btang mkhan zhag bcu skor tsam dgongs pa zhus/ de 'phral tshur bcar na chog gam zhus pas/ mi chog chos khyad par can zhu ba la le lo dang phyi bshol bgyi mi rung ste/

rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// gang zhig dkon pa'i rin chen 'di ni ma rnyed par// de la bar chad bya phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur// bya ba de yin pas sang nyin nas khrid 'go 'dzugs/ do nub rmi lam ci rmis ltos gsungs pa de thos pa tsam gyis lus ba spu gzeng mig mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i mos gus spro dga' tshad las 'das pa dang sdod mi tshugs pa lta bu'i sems yeng yeng por gyur song bas brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi babs dang ldan par yid ches thob/ do nub rmi lam du mtsho rgyal yin zer ba zhig gis pu sti phra la ring ba kha byang du brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs mdzod zer ba zhig gnang byung ba zhal phyes pas mtha' rgyab med par brda yig 'dra ba'i ye ge phramos gang ba rmis/ phyis nyin maṇ+ḍal gyi rten khyer nas sku mdun phyin pas mdang ci rmis gsungs/ de tshul zhib tu zhus pas brda yig rnams shes sam gsungs/ ma shes zhus pas/ dpe cha de yi ge'i gang lugs kyis sgom shes mkhan rab zhig 'ong tshod 'dra yang mtha' rgyag med par gang lugs 'dis lus ngag gi dge sbyor zhan tsam zhig 'ong ba 'dra/ de min mi shes gsungs/ de nyin dngos gzhi'i khrid mgo btsug khrid rkang 'di rnams rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa nas zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa gser ri'i phreng ba mang la bzang ba sha stag byon pa las rig 'dzin chen po gang gi zhal slob khams su byon pa thams cad kyi gtso bo rdo grub chen 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer te khong gi slob ma rdo rje'i gdung bzhi/ bud+dha mched drug nam mkha'i mtshan can bcu gsum/ dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa brgya rtsa tsam byon pa'i nang tshan nam mkha'i mtshan can bcu gsum gyi gtso bo mi 'gyur nam mkha' rdo rje'i mdun nas chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod thob/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i dngos slob gtso bo 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dang a bu bka' drin can gnyis bzhugs pa bdag gis de gnyis mdun mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung*/

nges don snying po'i lag khrid/ gsang spyod rdo rje'i lam bstan rnams zhus/ lar rig 'dzin 'jigs gling gi zhal nas/ nga yi 'od gsal snying thig gi brgyud pa 'di la pha bas bu bzang*/ bu bas tsha bo/ tsha bo las yang tsha bzang bar lung bstan pas nga yan chad la ngo mi tsha bar byon/ da khyod yang tsha tsam gyi tshod du slebs 'dug pas a bu bka' drin can gyis nged la yun ring po'i bar khrid rkang re re gnyis re gsungs/ ngas kyang rgyud la zhib tu 'dres nges byas mi shes pa dang dogs pa'i gnas la a bu'i mdun rang nas lung dang rigs pa'i lam nas tshig gi sgro 'dogs bcad/ mkhas pa mgu ba'i bshad pa sgros gtsang zhing don gyi nyams myong gis gnad du khel ba brgyud pa byin rlabs kyi babs dang ldan pa yin pas khyod nas kyang tshig sgros tsam yang ma nyams par yid la zin nges dgos gsungs/ dang po khrid rkang re gnad bsdus te gsungs/ nyin cha shas rer bsam bcug yang de la rgyas bshad mdzad cing dogs pa bcad nas zhag shas bsam bcug tshig rnams yid la e 'jags gsungs/ da lta yid la 'jags kyang phyin chad brjed e 'gro mi shes pas zin bris zhig btab na zhus pas/ ci zer snyan brgyud dpe la ma bkod gsungs pa de ma go'am gsungs/ bar zhig na da brjed kyis dogs na rtsa tshig tsam zin bris su btab kyang skyon med/ gsang ba ye ge med pa'i skor rnams kun mkhyen chen pos yi ger btab pa bla ma yang tig gi snyan brgyud skor gsum dang*/ zab mo yang tig gi gsang ba yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud kyi khrid rnams yin kyang da yu bu gnyis kyis de 'dra'i lad mo mi 'ong yang*/ snyan brgyud kyi khrid 'di bshad du'ang phangs/ nub tu'ang phangs gsungs byung bas 'di la phyis su khrid yig rgyas bsdus gnyis su btab/ dngos gzhi mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi lta ba'i skabs der ci yang zhu rgyu ma rnyed pas yid chad drag nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba shugs drag tu btab/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i dbang bzhi blangs thugs yid bsres te bzhag pas sngar sngon 'gro'i dus su sems rtog med snang yul thams cad nub 'gro ba zhig yod pa de kun gzhi red gsungs kyang da brtags na dus gsum dge mi dge bar ma'i rtog pa gang dang yang ma 'dres shing rtog med kyi gnas skabs lnga po'ang ma yin pa'i rig stong rjen la bud pa 'di las 'gro ba mi 'dug snyam pa'i kho thag chod pa zhig byung bar sku mdun phyin nas zhus pas cung zad bzhad de/ yin/ de yin kyang ngas khyod la 'phrig ma bstan/ kun mkhyen chen pos snying thig gi dgongs pa'i ngo ti nges pa ni rig pa rjen la bud pa zhig dgos/ de ma shes na khregs chod thod rgal gang la sbyar kyang phan med gsungs pa bzhin yin mod/ de byung 'dug ces thugs dgyes tshor cher mdzad nas/ pha la bu skyes/ bus brgyud pa zin pa zhig 'ong*/ de ring ston mo zhig dgos gsungs te bu ram dang shing thog mang du gnang*/ nga'i ja 'di la gcig 'thung gsungs nas rang bzhin gyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ khyod sngon 'gro blo sbyong gi skabs nas snang med kyi mnyam bzhag 'dra ba zhig bshad rgyu 'dug pa de yin/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi dus na gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa gnyis kyi dang po 'dzin rtog de nub nas 'gro/ gzung rtog ma nub pas snang ba 'di mnyam bzhag gi thad po de na yod/ de nas gzung rtog nub pas snang ba tsam po de yang mnyam bzhag gi ngo na mi snang bas snga ma de snang bcas mnyam bzhag dang phyi la de snang med mnyam bzhag red/ da lta mkhas pa 'ga' res sher phyin gyi snang snang med kyi mnyam bzhag de stong nyid dang sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis la ngos 'dzin byed kyang de nyams myong med pa'i gtam mtshang bud pa yin/ khyed mnyam bzhag de las ldang ba na dang po rna ba nas sgra ting shag gi skad 'dra ba zhig gis rkyen byas nas snang ba 'di bkra lam gyis 'char 'dug zer ba de/

sangs rgyas sras gcig gi rgyud las/ snang ba'i rang sgra sil skad du// sngon du log ste 'khrul par snang*// zhes 'pho sku bzhengs tshad kyi dus na gsungs pa de da res nang rig pa tshad phebs kyi dus 'dir 'byor che bar snang*/ nga rgyal dang rang mthong ma che/ nga rgyal e 'dug gsungs/ mi 'dug rjes thob na snang ba thams cad bden med rtsis med zhig gi steng nas snang ba skye lhang lhang ba zhig las mi 'dug zhus pas de 'dra dgos/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ de nyid goms pas yon tan nyams rnams 'byung*// snying nas mi rtag blo sna 'thung ba dang*// byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med pa dang*// dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'char ba 'byung*// gsungs pa rnams yod dgos/ sa ra has/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// de ring mgon po nga ltar 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la'ang 'dri bar mi bya'o// gsungs pa'i thog tu phyin pa yin/ a bu bka' drin can des rdzogs chen nags chung ma'i ri khrod du nga la ngo sprod gnang ba yin gsungs/ ji ltar lags zhus pa/ nga dang po sgom dga' chen song yod pas khrom grub thob kyis nga la cig char ba'i ngo sprod gnang byung*/ de nas yar song yid lhung bla ma dga' rab mdun rtogs 'bul zhus pas nga gnyis char ba red song*/ dge mang skyabs mgon rin po che'i mdun song bas zho gcig gnang phor pa med zhus par rang byung gi ka pā li bzed gsungs/ ngas khyor ba gnyis bzed pas rig pa bzang gsungs/ de dus rtogs 'bul zhig zhus pas nga gsum char ba red song*/ de nas a bu'i mdun song nas zhus pas da nga rim gyis pa red song gsungs/ gnyis char dang gsum char ba zhes pa ci lags zhus pas/ de rang rtsed mo byas pa yin/ snyan brgyud man ngag gis bshad pa'i gnad gcig med na khong bla ma rnam pa'i rtogs pa mtho tshod kyis gsung des gar yang mi phyin/

gdul bya rim gyis pa'i blo la ngo 'phrod pa dka'/ deng sang thams cad kyis dpe thog bro brdung rang 'dis kyang go mi chod/ a bu nged dpon slob nags chung ma'i tshur ngos thang shing zhig yod pa'i rtsar bzhugs/ a bu'i nyin re bzhin phyogs dben pa rer phebs nas thun bcad kyin bzhugs/ ngas thang shing de'i rtsar ja bskol dus tshur byon nas bzhugs skabs/ nga la rgyun bar gru gu nag po zhig nyar tshab byed rgyu yod par rmis 'dug pa nub gcig a bu'i gru gu de'i sne nas bshig pa'i dkyil na rdo rje sems dpa'i gser sku zhig 'dug pa nga la sprod pa rmis/ bdag gis bsam par sngon nas gru gu de la de yod par shes na dka' las de ma dgos snyam pa shar/ a bu mun rub dus nam yin kyang thang chung mi shong tsam du bal stan gsar pa zhig yod pa bting ba'i khar sku lus brgyang thabs gan rkyal du nam mkha' sum thug gi nyams len thun rer nyams bzhes gnang nas bzhugs pa la/ dgung gcig sngar gyi de bzhin mdzad nas bzhugs skabs lung gces khyod nas sems ngo mi shes e zer gsungs/ mi shes lags zhus pas mi shes rgyu ci med 'dir shog dang gsungs/ de bzhin mdun du phyin pas khyed rang yang nga sdod tshul 'di bzhin sdod la nam mkha' la ltos dang gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas nam mkha' la skar ma shar ba mthong ngam/ rdzogs chen dgon du khyi zug pa thos sam/ rang re gnyis kyis gtam smra ba go'am gsungs/ so sor lan phul bas 'o sgom zhes pa de yin gsungs pas bdag kyang kho thag nang nas chod/ yin min gyi sgrog las grol/ rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes de dus ngo 'phrod pa yin/ de yang khong gi byin rlabs las 'phrod pa yin/ sa ra has/ bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa// lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra// gsungs pa de yin/ da rjes la dpyad na mig shes rna shes gnyis rig pa yin zhes gsungs pa lta bu las med kyang snying thig gi dgongs pa'i rtogs tshad nges pa don brgyud kyis byin rlabs 'phos pa kho na'i mthu yin par shes dgos/

a bu khong me nyag la'u thang dang nye ba'i dur khrod gnyan pa zhig tu zhag gcig bzhugs pas 'tshub slong mang po byung bla ma la gsol ba btab pas rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa'i gdeng tshad rnyed/ mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje la rtogs 'bul zhus pas khyod kyis bdud bzhi cig char du chod pa red gsungs/ yin tshod kyang red/ de phyin nga la nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog cher ma skyes gsungs/ des na brgyud pa 'dir bla ma'i mos gus kho nas rtogs dgos pa yin/ bla ma bsten thabs mos gus yin te zhe sa min/ bla ma'i sgrub thabs mos gus yin te gsol 'debs min gsungs/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu tsā ri cig char gnas su lo mang por dka' spyad mdzad nas bsgoms/ nyin gcig nyi ma'i nang byon par lha sa'i phyogs spyan lam du gzigs pas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang snying thig brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dran nas mos gus kyis gsol 'debs bgyis pas re zhig thugs dran med du brgyal ba lta bur song*/ de las sad pa na sngar gyi sgom la bdag po sprod dgos pa'i 'dzin pa de dbyings su zhig nas blta rgyu dang bsgom rgyu med cing rig pa yongs 'khrul bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi thog tu son kyang des thugs ma tshims nas/ a kha/ nga nyi ma'i nang der ma phyin na sgom zhig yod kyang da ni ci yang mi 'dug yang du nyams len la dogs bcad dang bla ma yang sku na mtho bas mjal zhus zhor la ma rgan sar yang 'phrad tsam 'gro dgongs nas phebs par dka' spyad kyis sku shin tu rid pas nyin gcig la ri khrod de'i man tsam na chu kha zhig yod pa de las byon ma thub/ de nub gnas bdag zhing skyong yab yum mon pa pho mo'i rnam pas ma rmos lo thog gi rtsam pa dang*/ ri dwags kyi sha phul/ phyi nyin gsol lhag rnams bskur bas 'tsho chas mdzad/ zhag shas phyin pas 'brog pa phyug po zhig gi zhabs 'degs zhus/ lug gcig bshas nas sha drangs pas thugs la ma'i sha bu la byin pa lta bu'i snying rje bzod brlag med pa 'khrungs/

bzhes pa lta ci gzigs pa tsam yang mi phod pa lta bur byung bas de phyin sha gtan nas ma bzhes/ de nas rig 'dzin 'jigs gling mdun mjal du phyin nas rtogs 'bul zhus pas bla ma thugs mnyes nas bu de bla ma rang yin/ chos nyid zad pa'i sar phyin pa yin gsungs/ der lo gcig bzhugs shing bla ma'i mdun sngar gsungs pa'i gdams ngag gi gnas phal cher la sgro 'dogs bcad/ bla ma'i gsung las khyod la 'di 'dra'i shes rab yod pa e yin ma shes/ da nga'i rtsar yun ring sdod dang khyod mkhas pa chen po zhig bgyid gsung kyang*/ da nga yi a ma shi med na 'phrad 'dod kyang che/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i khrid rnams rang gi nyams su len nus na bla ma'i drin las yid tshims par byung zhus pas bkas gnang nas khams su phebs pas ma dang 'phrad/ de nas rdza khra ma nang lo nyi shu rtsa grangs su bsgoms pas mtshan khra ma bla ma zhes thogs pa yin no// des na rtogs pas mi chog bsgom dgos/ goms pa klong du gyur dgos/ klong gyur mthar phyin pa zhig gi bar nyams len thun du bcad nas 'bad dgos/ nam zhig na rang don du rdzogs pa chen po chos zad kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ rig rtsal chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab klong rdol/ theg pa dang grub mtha'i rnam bzhag ma 'dres pa shwa mang gi sul bzhin du rang stobs kyis 'byed nus pa/ gzhan don du dmigs med snying rje chen po ngam ngam shugs kyi 'byung ba na 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dus la bab pa yin pas/ des na dam pa gong ma dag gi rnam thar la gzhi bcol/ rang gi nyams rtogs kyi gdeng tshad nges/ rnam dpyod shes rab kyis lam dang lam ma yin pa'i mtshang rig pa'i sgo nas rang nyams su blang na 'di tsam du mdo 'dus/ gzhan la bstan na 'di tsam gyis chog snyam pa'i man ngag gi gnad bsdu shes dgos/ des na phyin chad kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung mdzod chen bdun snying thig ma bu bcas kyi dgongs pa dang rang rgyud zhus dag gyis/

bla rgan zhig gis ci zer gyi kha la nyan nas mdzod bdun ya bzhi rnams gzhung bshad red ces de rnams log shig tu bzhag da nga yi snyan brgyud bla na med pa bla ma 'di zhes bya bas gnang ba yin zer ba'i mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi zhi gnas zhig dang*/ gnas 'gyur rig gsum zer ba'i sgros gsar pa zhig btags nas slob ma mtho dman thams cad mgo bskor ba 'di rigs rnams bdud kyis brlabs pa'i chos log yin/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ stong lta hed po stong sgom mun rdo 'phen pa lta sgom yin snyam la lus pa zhes gnad med pa'i glen sgom la bka' bkyon gnang ba de yin/ khyod la shes rab skyon med zhig yod pas lam gnad mthar thug pa kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung gi gsang ba 'di la nam yang zhib rtog dang*/ rang gi nyams rtogs la dag ther gyis/ nga'i pha bu'i gsung sgros 'di rnams zla gro gcig khur nas song yang thos rgyu med/ e yod da phyis nas go yong*/ ngas bla ma mi pham/ thar rtse dpon slob/ gsol dpon pad+ma/ bla ma bstan 'phel rnams la ye shes bla ma'i khrid 'bul dus gsung rgyun rags rim tsam phul yang dpon slob ma gtogs khong rnams nas thugs rtsis cher mi gnang yang da phyin khong rnam pa'i gsung rnams mjal na gdams ngag gi mtshon tshul la khyad ci yod shes nas 'ong gsungs yang de 'phros kyi khrid rnams rim par gnang*/ de nas dngos gzhi ngo sprad ran pa na do nub rmi lam ci rmis ltos shog gsungs/ de nub bdag gi rmi lam du lcags ri chen po tshad 'di zhes blos mtshon du mi nus pa gru bzhi phyogs bzhi na sgo chen bzhi yod pa zhig gi nang srog chags rigs mi gcig pa mang pos gang ba'i sgo re re'i steng bla ma mang po sgo srung ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ nub kyi sgo steng du 'jam dbyangs dmar ser ral gri dang pu sti bsnams pa/ de'i g.yon phyogs su 'phags pa klu sgrub dkar po dge slong gi chas can sku stod gcer bu dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa can zhig gi mchan du bdag 'dug

bdag gi 'phror bla ma mang po bzhugs nas thams cad kyis srog chags de rnams phyir shor ba'i zon gyis bsrung 'dug pa zhig rmis/ phyi nangs de tshul zhus pas 'di yin 'di min cang mi gsung bar rmi lam bzang gsungs/ zhor la zhal kyal tshul du sems can de rnams phyir shor na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ral gri des cher brgyab na ni gsad chung ngu zhig gis khog shom mi 'dra/ klu sgrub phyag na ci 'dug gam gsungs/ mi 'dug zhus pas 'o lag yu ma mang bas ci byed/ de las ci rmis gsungs/ mtshan smad tsam na chos rgyal mya ngan med pas bzhengs pa'i tsā+air+ya ste mchod rten yin zer ba zhig gi nub phyogs nas zhig ste/ nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i bar shwa 'ud rgyug pa bzhin song nas chu mdog dmar log ger song ba dang nam mkha' nas sgra zhig las rgya mtsho'i nang gi srog chags bye bas bden pa mthong song zer ba rmis zhus par de la bzang ngan ci yang ma gsungs/ da ngo sprod 'di la brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tsam las phyag srol maid kyang*/ da res ye shes bla ma'i rtsal dbang gnyis bskur gsungs/ yo byad ci dgos zhus pas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul dgos kyang de khyod la med/ bdag gi maṇ+ḍal nang gser gyi me tog zhig yod pa de longs la khyod rang gi ṭaṃ ka cha shas yod rgyu de dang mnyam du phul/ ḍa dril mi dgos yang bla mas dbang mdzad kyin 'dug zer nas thams cad sleb 'ong gsungs/ ye shes bla ma'i khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis ka'i rtsal dbang gnang*/ brgyud pa 'di la dbang de gnyis las bzang ba bskur rgyu med/ khyod nas nga las dbang zhig e thob kyi re ba bskangs pa yin/ ngas tshe 'dir dbang mang po su la 'don ma myong*/ sngar rdo grub mkhan po ngag dbang dang dam chos gnyis la dbang zhig bskur bas khong gnyis nas rigs 'dus rgyun du thugs dam dang*/ sid+dhi dung phyur re khas len mdzad song*/ dus phyis ser shul ngag dbang nas sid+dhi dung phyur gsum tshar gsungs pa'i yi ge 'byor/

dbang zhu na de 'dra'i go chod gcig dgos/ khang tshig sgar du bka' ma'i mchod khag gi dbang lung cha tshang zhig bton/ bka' ma'i gzhung bsrang gter mas zur brgyan dgos gsungs pa 'ong du re yang khong rnams nas gter mas gzhung bsrang ba las bka' mas zur brgyan pa ci yang mi mdzad/ a stobs kyis de phyin bka' ma'i dbang lung lan kha shas 'chad spel bgyis pa de tsam don sgor song ba las sgar spyi la 'di phan snyam pa ma byung*/ na lor bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang rdor li gnyis la ye shes bla ma'i dus mkhyen brtse'i chog khrigs steng nas dbang zhig bton pa de tsam ma gtogs dbang mang po ma bton/ ye shes bla ma'i rtsal dbang gnyis po thig le'i rgya can rang gi dgos dbang thun mong min pa yin/ da phyin thig le'i rgya can bsnyen pa btang chog gsungs/ de nas dngos gzhi'i khrid gzhung gi ngo sprod de gnang*/ 'di tshig dbang dngos yin pas lan gcig las gsung srol med kyang sang nas phan chad zhib cha bgyis te bshad gsungs/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrid dang bcas pa khrid rkang re re nyin re bzhin gsungs/ de yun ring tsam la bsam bcug 'di skor la rang gi shes rab la rtsal ci yod kyis tshig don gnyis po zin par byas nas the tshom dang dka' ba'i gnas la 'dri gtug ci nus zhus pas ltar snang gi khrid zhus lo zhig dang mtshungs zla med snyam pa'i blo bde ba zhig byung*/ thun mong dang thun min gyi sngon 'gros rgyud legs par sbyangs nas dngos gzhi'i khrid la 'jug tshul la zhag

1) mdo sngags thun mong dang thun min gyi sems ye shes su bskyed tshul/ 2) phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i sgo nas gsang sngags kyi chos 'chad nyan bgyis pa'i dgos pa/ 3) rdzogs chen rang gi brgyud pa gsum gyi babs so dang nye ring gi khyad par/ 4) theg pa che chung gi lta sgom spyod gsum gyi khyad par/ 5) de las gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par/ 6) bya rgyud nas a nu'i bar gyi rang rang gi lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khyad par/ 7) de dag las rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud kyi ldang tshad/ de la bka' bsdu mdzad nas sems klong man ngag gsum gyi dgongs pa len tshul/ 8) snga ma gnyis las man ngag gi sde khyad par 'phags tshul/ 9) de la phyi nang gsang ba'i skor (130)tshe bzhi las yang gsang bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi ldang tshad la rgyud bcu bdun sngags srung khros ma'i rgyud dang bco brgyad klong gsal 'bar ma'i rgyud dang bcu dgu po'i rgyud la bu'i rkang grangs dang bcas pa'i dgongs nyams slob dpon rnam gnyis kyis/ bi ma'i gsang ba snying thig dang*/ pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro snying thig gnyis por gang zag gcig gi lam gyi cha rkyen tshang la ma nor ba bstan pa dang*/ 10) snying thig ma gnyis kyi dgongs pa ches gsal bar mdzad pa kun mkhyen chen po'i bla ma yang tig dang*/ mkha' 'gro yang tig gnyis/ de gnyis ka'i yang tig zab mo yang tig ste/ kha byang las/ mkha' 'gro yang yig gsang ba'i dem dang bcas// gsungs pas yang tig gnyis las logs su mi bsgrang bas de phyir snying thig ma bu bzhi zhes grags pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 11) snying thig ma bu bzhi'i dgongs nyams gcig tu dril ba klong chen snying gi thig le zhes mtshan de ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa mchims phu nags kyi dben gnas su kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab rnams mjal bas rkyen byas sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus kyi rten mkhar tshugs nas gsaul ba btab/

snying po'i sgrub pa la lo gsum bzhugs pas kun mkhyen chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs te lan gsum rjes su bzung ba'i mthar brjod bya don gyi dgongs pa rgyud la 'pho bar gyur cig rjod byed tshig gi brgyud pa rdzogs par gyur cig lan gsum gsungs nas don brgyud kyi dgongs pa 'phos/ mnyam bzhag tu rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yid dpyod dang bral ba mngon sum gzigs/ rjes thob tu mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi lam gnad thams cad bslab pa la ma ltos par skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi klong rdol ba kun mkhyen chen po'i byin rlabs kyi dgongs pa 'phos stobs las byung bas klong chen snying thig zhes grags shing thugs kyi thig le'i dwangs ma lta bu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa/ 12) de dag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pas blo khrid tshul kun mkhyen chen po'i sems nyid ngal gso dang sbyar ba bcas zhag 13) bar khrid kyi khog phub rnams la bsam dpyod btang bcug gnyis (132)pa dngos gzhi'i khrid rkang la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gsum la zhag 3) lam rgyud bye brag tu bstan pa la smin lam dbang dang grol lam gdams pa'i rim pa gnyis po 'og ma bskyed rdzogs thun mong pa'i dbang dang gdams pa las khyad par 'phags chos ngos bzung ba la zhag 1) grol byed gdams pa'i rim pa la le lo can 'bad med du grol ba ka dag khregs chod/ brtson 'grus can 'bad bcas su grol ba lhun grub thod rgal gyi khrid gnyis thabs las thabs byung gi 'brel ba grub tshul dang*/ de gnyis chos gzugs kyi nyer len du 'gro tshul/ 2) khregs chod kyi khrid la gang zag gi dbang po'i rim pas dmigs yul gyi blo can dang rig pa rang snang gi blo can gnyis drangs ba la lta thog nas sgom pa 'tshol ba dang sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba'i khrid lugs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang*/

dmigs pa yul gyi blo can gyi dang por bsgom rgyu sems nyid ngal gso'i lha dang mi'i sems 'dzin dang*/ theg mchog mdzod kyi dmigs pa yul gyi blo can 'khrid tshul gyi bsgom pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa'i skabs su mtshan ma a dkar la sems 'dzin pa dang rlung dang thig le la sems (133)'dzin tshul gsungs pa de deng dus mtshan bcas kyi zhi gnas sgrub zer ba dang 'brel mi 'grigs tshul/ de dag rdzogs chen rang gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin min pa'i dgag bzhag rgyas pa dang*/ 3) dang po khregs chod kyi khrid la sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshig pa/ dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo sprad pa/ rjes nyams kyi skyong tshul bstan pa gsum la nang gses sa bcad rnams blor 'dzin pa/ 4) de nas rtsad bcad pa/ 5) mtshang btsal ba/ 6) de la nang gses bdun/ 7) byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi rig pas gang dgag bya'i bden 'dzin ngos bzung ba bden med kyi nges pa bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bcas/ 8) de nas sems kyi byung sa/ 9) byung mkhan/ 10) gnas sa/ 11) gnas mkhan/ 12) 'gro sa/ 13) 'gro mkhan/ 14) de gsum dang bral ba'i sems snang stong rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa'i don la nges pa bskyed pa dang de rnams yid dpyod kyi lta ba'am rdzogs chen rang skad kyi chos can lta ba dang chos nyid lta ba gnyis las snga ma yin tshul dang*/ mngon sum rang rig gi lta ba thod rgal gyi (134)rtsa yi gnad la brten pa'i mngon sum yin pas ma hā a nu gnyis kyi thabs kyis drangs pa'i thabs byung gi 'od gsal de la mngon sum zhig btags kyang chog par bi ma la'i snang byed sgron ma'i lta ba'i rnam dbye rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ 15) bzhi pa thun mong ma yin pa yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la btags pa dang*/ de ltar gtan la phabs pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pa gnyis kyi dang po la lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi las/ kun gzhi dang chos sku'i shan 'byed/

sems dang rig pa'i shan 'byed/ kun rdzogs dang don dam gyi shan 'byed gsum dang*/ la bzla ba la la bzla rgyu'i zhen rtog phra ma ngos bzung ba dang*/ la bzla rang gi ngo bo la nang gses rtsol bcas a nu man chad kyi lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi dang*/ rdzogs chen rang lam gyi lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi por la bzla ba bcas kyi lta ba'i shan 'byed dang*/ la bzla song nas sgom pa la rtsol bcas bzung dran 'ju dran gyi dran pa dang*/ rtsol med gnyug ma'i dran pa gnyis shan 'byed pa/ sgom pa rang bab cog bzhag chen po bzhi'i dgongs pa dang*/ mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi (135)dgongs pa dang*/ spyod pa rang gi ngo bo la thabs lam brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang*/ grol lam bag yod kyi spyod pa'am mthun 'jug thabs kyi spyod pa gnyis las phyi ma gtso bor ston pa dang*/ 'bras bu la gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu byang chub mchog gi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rdzogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de rnams bsdu na shes rab dang snying rje chen po gnyis la 'du bas de gnyis byung na gnas skabs lam gyi 'bras bu yin tshul dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu tshe 'di dang 'chi kha bar do gsum gyi grol tshad nges pa dga' rab rdo rje'i rtags yig tshad yig gzhi bcas pa dang*/ gnyis pa rang grol mngon sum dang ston pa'i dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo sprad pa la nang tshan phye bas/ 5) rjes nyams kyi skyong tshul bstan pa la bdun du dbye ba ste/ de rnams kyi dbang rab tshe 'dir grol ba'i gdams khrid rdzogs/ de nas 'bring bar do grol ba'i gdams pa la 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gi gdams pa dang*/ 1) grong 'pho grong 'jug gi 'pho ba dang*/ 2) 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gi 'pho ba dang*/ 3) bogs 'don nam mkha' sum phrug dang*/ 4) tha ma rnam (136)smin srid pa bar dor grol ba'i gdams pa rnam shes rlung zhon dang bcas khrid rkang re nyin re bzhin chos thun du gnang nas bar du zhag mang por bsam bcug

kun mkhyen chen pos nga yi chos brgyud la bla ma bsten yun ring ba gdams ngag nyan yun ring ba zhig dgos gsungs pa bzhin 'bad khul gyis snga phyir lo grangs drug tsam la mnyes pa gsum gyis brten nas gdams ngag gi zhun thar bcad de nyams su blangs pa yin pas phyin chad phyi ma don du gnyer zhing snying nas chos bsgrub pa'i gang zag yod na bla ma bsten yun ring ba gdams ngag nyan yun ring ba zhig dgos pa lags/ de ltar dngos gzhi khregs chod kyi khrid rnams rdzogs pa na da res bla sgrub thig le'i rgya can 'di bla ma'i gsang sgrub ye shes bla ma'i sgrub pa yin pas zhag brgya'i bar nyin re la bsnyen pa khri tsam dang gtso bo sgom pa mi g.yo gsum ldan ltar nyams len gyis/ mtshams dam po mi dgos zhag shas re nas nga'i rtsar shog la dngos gzhi'i gnas rnams la dogs gcod zhib mo gyis gsungs/ de bzhin mtshams la zhugs pas zhag bdun phrag gsum nas snang nyams la kun mkhyen chen po nam mkhar mngon sum 'dra bar snang ba dang*/ shes nyams la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum po yid dang lhan cig skyes pa lta bu mtshan mo gnyid kyi dus na'ang mi 'bral ba zhig skyes byung ba mdun du zhus pas snang nyams dang shes nyams bzang po re yin/ goms na sla bar mi 'gyur ba'i// dngos de gang yang yod ma yin// gsungs pa ltar yin/ de rnams sa lam mthon po'i rtags gang yang min/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i shan ma phyed na/ ji skad du/ shes rab rang rtsal rdzogs pa dang*// yid kyi dran pa phyir shor gnyis// 'dra'o 'dra'o nor ra re// zhes pa de 'ong gsungs nas tshig gsum gnad du brdeg pa'i man ngag dang*/ gol shor tshar gcod seng go'i nga ro gnyis gnang*/ yang mtshams shig tu mkha' 'gro snying thig gi zhus lan bdud rtsi gser phreng gi khrid gnang nas/ da khyed kyi mtshams de grol la nye bla ma a ngag gis mdzod bdun lung gnang gis yod pas de zhu dgos gsungs bzhin mtshams grol nas/

mdzod bdun ngal gso skor gsum dang bcas pa'i lung zhus zin 'phral bka' drin can gyi mdun mjal du phyin pas klong chen mdzod bdun dang khyod kyi rtogs pa gnyis phan tshun phyogs e 'dra gsungs/ ga na 'dra nga la go ba tsam las mi 'dug zhus par thugs mnyes nas de go bcad/ go myong rtogs gsum gyi sgo nas lam lnga sa bcu'i 'gros zhig brtsi shes pa 'di 'gangs che/ deng sang go ba tsam la rtogs pa'i ngo sprod 'debs/ yengs med bsgom med lta sgom chig chod yin zer ba'i kha lta mthon po zhig tu ma song bar sa lam gyi rnam bzhag nges shes zhig gal che gsungs/ chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod 'di kun mkhyen chen po'i rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag tu bzhag pas le'u dgu pa yan chad kyis lta ba bcu pas sgom pa/ bcu gcig pas spyod pa/ bcu gnyis pas gnas skabs lam gyi 'bras bu/ bcu gsum pas mthar thug gi 'bras bu bstan pa yin/ don gyi go ba de zungs la dpe mjal gyis gsungs/ de bzhin kun mkhyen chen po la gsol ba shugs drag tu btab nas mjal kyang cher go rgyu ma byung*/ lan gcig ci go rgyu 'dug gam gsungs/ lar sems klong man ngag gsum dang khyad par sems sde'i lung mang drag pas sems sde dang gsang skor man ngag gi gnad gnyis mi gcig pa'i go ba tsam 'dis the tshom ches mang bar song zhus pas lung gar 'then yin mod gong ma'i lung 'og mar drang mi rung*/ 'og ma'i lung gong mar drang yang chog da chos dbyings mdzod 'dir bshad pa zhig e thub lta gsungs nas khrid du gnang*/ khyod bsod nams che 'dug 'dug khar zhus pas chog ngas khrid 'di zhu dus a bu rin po che'i gzims bcags te rdzogs chen gangs khrod nas nged la gsungs pa yin/ bzhugs na gzims 'gro bas ngas chos dbyings mdzod kyi dpe cha zhig phyes nas phyir 'gros kyis 'gro ba'i rjes la a bu byon nas nyin mtshan mang por gsungs/

chos dbyings mdzod 'di chos kyi nying khu yin/ gsungs pa bzhin a bu rin po che'i thugs dam gyi mthil yin/ ngas kyang yin khul yin/ da khyed kyi yang snying la bcangs dgos/ bshad pa de dag dang bstun te go ba yang dag blangs na sems sde dang nor dogs med/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i rgyud yi ge med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang rig 'dzin gyi 'das rjes man ngag gis brgyan pa dang*/ shrī sing has khyung chen mkha' lding gi gnad la brten ma brten gyi ngo sprod lugs gnyis po 'di la tshang bas man ngag snyan brgyud du bzhag pa yin pas de ltar dpe la lta rtog dgos gsungs/ de bzhin yang yang dpe mjal byas pas cung zad sngar dang mi 'dra tsam gyi go ba chags/ de tshul zhus par/ de yin/ rim gyis blo skyed thon dgos/ sngar zhig tu nged kyis gling mda' nor kho la dpe lta bcug ste nyin gcig ci go'am byas pas/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams rung ma 'khyams rung*// 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob rung ma thob rung*// kun bzang klong na 'khor 'das rgyu 'bras med// gsungs pa de go zer/ khong rtogs ldan yin pas de 'dra yin srid kyang kha lta de cung mtho/ de 'dra mi nyan/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i la rgya la gnod/ sgos su gang zag gi rgyud chud 'dza' bas gnod/ yang sgos slob ma bsod chung rnams la gnod/ des na lta ba dpa' dgos/ spyod pa sdar dgos gsungs pa de shin tu yin gsungs/ mtshams shig tu ye shes bla ma'i khrid zhus kyang dgung grangs mtho ba dang spyan 'grib tshul gyis de'i go bcad la yang gsang bla med kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag zhig bshad gsungs te shin tu gsang ba chen po thod rgal gyi snyan brgyud yi ge med pa khrid rkang shin tu mang ba yun ring po'i bar gnang ba la phyis su zin bris zhig kyang btab/ bar rnams su bla ma a stobs mdun bka' gter rags rim gyi thig dang rdul tshon blos bslang rtsig tshul dang*/

sgyu 'phrul blos bslang rtsig tshul sogs bslabs/ khyad par sgyu 'phrul blos bslang zhig shing rang gis rtsig dgos gsungs pa bzhin bgyis pas yun ring 'gor yang bka' drin che ba byung*/ da lta bshad sgom gang gi skabs su yang lag tu blang ba'i nyams myong gi nges pa thon pa byung*/ de skabs rngon pa zhig gis gla ba gcig me mdas bsad song ba mthong bas nged cag tshogs pa rnams nas mdo bton/ chos gos brdabs/ der sku mdun du phyin par ci red gsungs/ de tshul zhus pas/ 'o khyed rnams snying rje go log bya ba yin/ gsad bya sngar gyi 'bras bu la spyad pas lan chags re re nas byang*/ gsod mkhan sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la longs spyod pas da nas bar bskal lnga brgyar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang srog lan lnga brgya 'jal ba'i mgo tshugs pa yin pas snying rje na de la snying rje bskyed dgos/ khyed rnams go ba phran bu yod snyam yang snying rje tsam la'ang go ba ma chags pa re blun/ sa lam mthon po'i go ba de dka' tshod 'dra gsungs/ nyin gcig khyod nas lta shed khur 'dug kyang da phyin khro bo re bsnyen dgos/ dgos dus khyi khar lag cha med pa dang 'dra/ lta shed ngas kyang khur myong ste de 'dras mi phan gsungs/ khro bo gang 'dra zhig bsnyen zhus pas/ lar rnying ma'i rig 'dzin snga ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil bka' ma'i yang dag 'di yin/ gu ru rin po ches/ yang dag tshong pa lta bu la phur pa skyel ma dang 'dra bas yang phur bsgrags ma'i sgo nas dngos grub brnyes pas thugs dam gyi gtso bo yin/ khyad par snga 'gyur ba'i nus mthu'i mngon rtags shig ngoms bsam na ma gshin phur gsum zhig bsnyen pa gal che gsungs/ phur pa gang zab zhus pas spu gri rnam gsum yin kyang ci phan/ 'di phyogs na dbang lung phar zhog dpai rgyun tsam yang 'byor dka'/ gshin rje gang zab zhus pas lcags 'dra sdig gnyis tsam las go chod pa'i gshin rje med/

bla ma a stobs mdun ma mo sgang shar dang 'di gnyis kyi dpe bzhugs kyang re zhig skyur/ phyin chad de rnams thob dgos pa yid la zhog da res bla ma'i man ngag la zhib cha gyis/ rjes nas slob gnyer zhig la bslab sbyang gi ched 'gro dgos/ de yang dge phyogs zhig la song na mi tshe rtog ge'i rig pa la zad/ kaḥthog 'di rang re'i grwa pa yin kyang da ji med rdzogs chen phyogs na yang bshad pa shi ro zhig las sngar dus dge mang dang a bu bzhugs dus 'dra ba med zer gsungs/ yang nyin gcig da ni rdzogs chen la slob gnyer phyir 'gro dgos gsungs/ bla ma mi pham rin po che lo gsar khar rdzogs chen du phebs nas khong gi gsung rnams kyis gtsos lo shas su chos gsung rgyu yin tshul bla ma'i nye gnas 'od gsal gyis ye ge 'byor byung bas 'gro dgos gsungs/ lar bla ma rin po che mi pham gyis chos 'khor bskor nas de thob pa'ang legs te mkhas pa chen po'i gsung bshad la nga slob gnyer gsar bu zhig gis go rgyu ci yod mi shes/ thos pa zhig shes kyang mi tshe rnam g.yeng la skyel ba las mi 'ong bas da ni cis kyang bla ma dgung grangs mtho bas zhal bzhugs ring sku bcar zhus/ da dung nyams len gyi gnad 'gag re gsung thub na bka' drin che min kyang sngar gsungs pa rnams kyis ma tshims pa med pas 'di ga rang nas nyams len byed chog pa dang rjes nas nges med kyi rgyal khams nyul nas tshe mjug dben pa la skyel ba'i 'dun pa 'di gnyis thugs la gang 'gab zhus pas ci zer rang yul gang spang ngo tsha med/ sgom pa su che bsog 'jog mkhas/ zer ba de yin/ nges med kyi rgyal khams nyul bas nyin gcig bud med zhig dang 'dab sbrel rgyu 'ong*/ 'di gar bsgom na rang don tsam la des ma chog pa med kyang*/ da ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi nyi ma chu lha'i phang par mnal la nye bas gzhan don du slob gnyer zhig ma shes pas mi 'ong*/

khyod la gzhan don zhig e 'ong gi re ba che bas nga shi sgug byed rgyu med/ slob gnyer zhig ma shes par nga na yang ma 'ong*/ shi yang ma 'ong*/ nges par 'gro dgos zhes bka' nan tan du phebs byung bas ci yang zhu ma spobs/ sems la 'di lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig mjal bar dka'/ mjal ba'i dus 'dir ji srid 'tsho'i bar ram re re zhing sdod rgyu byung na gzhan don ma byung kyang 'dra snyam mchi ma shor bar bla ma'i gsung las mchi ma 'byin don med/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa ma mjal na ngu dgos/ mjal kyang gdams ngag ma thob na ngu dgos/ thob kyang sgro 'dogs ma chod na ngu dgos kyang khyed brgyud pa khyad par can 'od gsal snying thig gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bla ma dang 'phrad/ zab mo'i gdams ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag bum pa gang byos tshul gyis thob/ rang gi bsgom pa'i nyams myong dang 'brel bas sgro 'dogs lhag med du chod/ nyams len rang skya pher ba'i tshad la phyin/ ngas snying thig gi bstan pa khyod la gtad/ gzhan don nus pa'i mgor sleb pa yin pas nges par 'gro dgos gsungs/ bla ma mi pham ma phebs na ci byed zhus pas/ ma phebs rung rdzogs chen dgon na khyod la slob gnyer zhu sa zhig yod pa'i khag ngas theg 'gro chas bsgrigs dgos gsungs/ de nas gsung bzlog ma spobs par 'gro thag bcad/ khyim du khyug tsam song*/ gos dang lto bcas kyi mthun sbyor bsgrigs nas 'gro ran pa na sku mdun du shog ces gsungs 'phrin 'byor/ mjal du phyin pas nyin gung tsam nas slebs kyang dgong mo sa ma rub bar ma 'ong gsungs/ mun rub nas mjal du phyin pas bla ma'i zhal 'don kyi tshig mtshams rten 'brel la brtags mdzad srol yod pas pha dam pa'i smon lam sum cu pa gsungs pa'i mjug sprul sku phrin las kyis gzhan don mthar phyin par gyur cig ces pa dang 'phrad/

de lan cha shas su bskyar bzlos gnang nas sprul sku phrin las kyi 'gro don mthar phyin pa sangs rgyas kyi sa yin pas khyed de tsam cung mtho song ba min nam zhes lan 'ga' gsungs/ sangs rgyas song na da mtho song yang ci byed zhus pas/ de ste rtsed mo yin tshig mtshams kyi rten 'brel la brtags na khyod la tshe 'dir 'gro don dang phrin las la bar chad gang yang med/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs 'gro don mthar phyin dgos pa yin zhes lung bstan gnang*/ da nga na so rgas/ na rgyu mang 'dug pas phyin chad phrad pa e 'ong mi shes/ nga la a bus lo lnga bcu ma lon bar du rdzogs pa chen po bshad mi dgos gsungs kyang khyod nas da phyin chad sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gang zhu ba byung yang gdul bya'i rgyud tshod dang bstun par rgyas bsdus gang 'tshams re shod/ rdzogs chen du song na slob gnyer re shes 'ong*/ de nas ma 'dug kaḥthog 'di rnying ma'i bstan pa'i chu 'go yin/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas phebs rtsis gnang yang dgongs pa rdzogs shor song*/ de'i 'phro rang la a bu rin po che phebs kyang si ru gong ma tsam las phan thogs cher ma byung*/ a bus nga la song gsungs kyang byang sems ri khrod du lo shas mtshams zhig 'dug rgyu tsam ma gtogs sus bla ma yin par yang mi shes/ da phyin khyod 'bod mi 'dra yod na der song na phan thogs re 'ong*/ gong ma rnams kyi thugs bskyed kyi bden mthu bslu ba med/ smin gling dang rdzogs chen khong gnyis bzang po re yin snyam nas ha las mdog byed kyang cang min/ bla rabs cha shas zhig gi tshe tsam ma gtogs gsar chags red/ kaḥthog 'di de dang gtan mi 'dra/ chos rje dam pa yab sras byon nas snga 'gyur ba'i mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa'i dbu tshugs nas khyung po dkar ru nag ru man chad nas rgya nag po'i mtshams yan chad khong gi slob brgyud mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu 'ja' lus brnyes pa brgya phrag dang stong phrag mang po byon/

dge 'dun gyi 'dus pa 'bum tsho bco brgyad 'dus/ gso sbyong gi dus chos gos 'od kyis nam mkha'i mdog bsgyur thub pa tsam byung zer ba'i gtam de khungs ma yin/ de dus khyung po man chad na dam pa rin po che'i slob brgyud las sa dge bka' brgyud sogs kyi bstan pa dbus gtsang na sa bon tsam re ma gtogs med/ mdo khams phyogs 'dir kaḥthog pa'i bstan pa 'phel rgyas kyi skabs yin/ de'i tshad la dpags na deng sang bla ma re'i kho 'gro don rgya che zer ba 'di a'u tsi yin/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse gnyis kyi gdan sa'i rten 'brel 'bring shos de kaḥthog yin kyang rten 'brel 'grigs ma song ba bstan pa'i chag sgo re yin mchis/ rdzogs chen nas bla ma rnams mjal dus lag stong par ma 'gro che chung la ma ltos pa'i maṇ+ḍal re 'bul dgos/ slob gnyer sbyang ba na gzhung gcig la u tshugs ma byed par ci thob gang thob zhus/ bshad rgyun dang 'grel ba lon na tshig 'grel tsam sla mo yin/ don gyi gnas rnams la bsam byung shes rab kyis brtags nas mdo sngags kyi theg pa'i gnad rnams bsdu shes dgos/ rang gis nyams su blangs na 'dis chog gzhan la bstan na 'di tsam la gnad 'dus snyam pa'i nges pa rnyed dgos/ a bu'i grub mtha' ris med la sbyang dgos/ phyogs re rer sbyang ba 'di shes rab 'chal ba'i rgyu yin/ bstan pa phyogs med la sbyangs na yin min zab mi zab rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang gang 'byor sogs gzod rang gi shes rab kyis rtogs 'ong ba yin gsungs pa 'di 'dra zhig dgos/ snying thig gi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis grub mtha' ris med kyi gzhung bshad gdams ngag dang bcas pa ma gsan pa med pa lta bu rang rang gi rnam thar na gsal/ kun mkhyen chen pos kyang bod 'dir bzhugs pa'i khrid phal mo che la yig cha re ma bzhag pa med pa lta bu yin/ da sems bskyed pa'i slob dpon dang lus bskyed pa'i pha ma gnyis drin che bas rgyun par bla ma ma brjed par mos gus kyis gsol ba thob dang nga dang 'bral ba maid/

gang gis na bla mas brtse bas bskyang ba dang*/ slob ma'i mos gus kyi 'brel ba 'di gnyis khag che bas rang re dpon slob gzhan dang mi 'dra tsam yod pa 'di yin/ phyin chad pha ma gnyis ma shi bar rang yul gyi dben khrod yid 'thad rer sdod/ de nas ci byed khyed rang gis shes/ da ni sna thag khyod rang mgor dkris pa yin/ da song gsungs nas nged kyis yar la phul ba'i dngul de phyir gnang steng ṭaṃ nyi shu skor dang dar bsod btags lnga bcu tsam gnang*/ phyir thon nas phyag phul bas da dung yar shog gsungs/ mdun du phyin pas khyed rang gi lag pa 'dir thongs dang ngas smon lam gcig bya yi gsungs te bla ma yang tig gi gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas gnang nas da song gsungs/ de bzhin phyir thon phyag phul bas yang yar shog gsungs/ mdun du phyin pas da phyin chad rang cag pha bu mi 'phrad/ nga'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams nyams su ma 'jug par ci 'phel gyis ang*/ snod dang ldan pa rang dka' yang deng sang rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang khrid thob pa lta ci mtshan thos pa'ang tshe lo bcu pa'i dus na mkha' 'gro ma dpal gyi blo gros kyi gdul byar gyur nas skye 'chi bar do gsum gang rung gi grol tshad zhig la grol nges pa a ti bkod pa chen po'i lung las gsal bas bslu ba med/ khrid 'chad pa na rab snying thig ma bu'i dbang de ma byung kyang thig le'i rgya can dbang zhig ma thob na bshad mi rung*/ de rang gis bskur thub na dang min tshe bla ma gzhan re la bskur chug gsungs/ bur gor bcu gsum dang nang mdzod nyin mo bde legs zhig gnang nas khyod ngas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar mnga' gsol dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod pa yin gsungs nas phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis rgyas pa zhig gnang*/ bdag gis kyang gang du skye ba ma'i smon lam btab nas phyir 'ong ba na skyo drag nas re zhig dran med du brgyal song*/ de sangs pa na mchi ma 'byin bzhin de nub mched grogs gcig par zhag sa bgyis mtshan thog thag tu ngus/

phyi nyin mi 'gro na snyam pa mang du shar yang bla ma'i bka' bcags na de las 'gal tshabs che ba med snyam nas phyin/ byi ba'i lo zla ba dgu pa'i nyer dgu la rdzogs chen du theg nas shrī sing har rtogs ldan tshang khang sar gzhis bcags/ de nub gnod sbyin chen po za 'og gi zhwa gos lham can zhig gis phyag dang zhe sa phul dar btang*/ bdag gis khyod kyis de ltar gnang ba ci lags zhus pas sngon gyi dam tshig yin mod ngas sngar khyod mnga' ris paṇa chen dus bdag chen sa skya'i dbu blar mnga' gsol/ blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dus sog po'i rgyal po'i bla yi mchod gnas su mnga' gsol ba e dran gsungs/ mi dran zhus pas/ he he/ mngal gyi dri mas bsgribs pa yin/ da phyin kyang ngas grogs dan bya yi gsungs pa chos 'khor de'i bdag po dgyes pa'i mtshan mar mthong*/ bla ma mi pham byon mi 'dug sang phod tsam la phebs skad thos/ zhag shas nas bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zhu ba'i mdun dbu ma rgyan sa bcad dang tshig 'grel tsam khong gis 'grel chen steng nas bsdus pa zhig yod pa de zhus/ nyin re bzhin dbu ma rgyan 'di dbu tshad seng ge mjing bsnol bya ba yin ces bsngags brjod gnang 'dug bshad pa'i mjug rdzogs la khad zhig tu seng ge mjing bsnol de ci 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin gnang zhus pas/ tha snyad tshad mas gang bzhag don dam dpyod pa'i rig pas 'gog don dam dpyod pas khas gang blangs tha snyad tshad mas 'gog pa yin gsungs/ de yid la bde lo zhig ma byung bas/ tshul gnyis shing rta zhon nas su// rig pa'i srab skyogs 'ju byed pa// zhes pa dang mi 'grigs pas de ltar na bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag bya ba med pa zhig tu mi 'gyur ram zhus par/ khong thugs khog shin tu dul ba zhig bzhugs gshis dgongs 'tshoms sogs mi gnang bar/ 'o na khyod kyis go lugs shig zhog dang gsungs/ bdag gis bsam na sems can gyi lhan skyes kyi bden 'dzin de don dam dpyod pa'i rig pas 'gogs/

grub mtha'i kun btags pa'i gtso bo dang dbang phyug sogs tha snyad yang dag gi tshad mas 'gog de'i shugs kyis dbu ma rang gi tha snyad kyi rnam bzhag thams cad blo ma 'khrul ba'i tshad ma yang dag gis 'jog pa lags snyam zhus pas cung zhig thugs bsam btang nas de red de red gsungs/ rjes su dka' ba'i gnas rnams bdag la dri ba gnang*/ khong gis mched grogs rnams la da res kyi slob gnyer gsar bu 'di blo gros shin tu che ba zhig 'dug pas gzab nas bshad na ma gtogs kha nas tshig 'grel ci thon thon zhig gis tshim par mi 'dug ces sbran par thos/ de 'phral me nyag bla ma rig 'dzin rdo rje zhes bla ma mi pham mdun lo bcu gsum bzhugs nas mkhas pa'i grags pa khyad du thon pa zhig phebs byung*/ de'i mdun dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel/ tshad ma rig gter/ mi pham mchan 'grel/ don rnam nges rtogs ldan lhag bsam 'grel bcas zhus pas go ba lam tsam chags/ brda shan 'byed khong gis zin bris dang bcas zhus kyang de dus rnam 'grel ma thob pas go ba dpyis phyin pa ni ma chags/ ku se bla ma pad+ma dbang chen mdun bka' brgyad rnam bshad/ gsang snying spyi don 'od gsal snying po/ yang dag sgrub pa'i gsang 'grel don bsdus bcas thob/ de nas mkhan po blo gsal mdun sdom gsum rnam nges 'grel chen dpag bsam snye ma/ nges legs 'grel chung bcas zhus/ de rjes shrī sing ha'i 'du khang steng gsang snying khang du phebs/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang yid tshim pa zhig dang*/ mdo sde rgyan/ 'byed rnam gnyis/ rong ston ṭī ka rgyud bla dol ṭīka gsang 'grel phyogs bcu'i mun sel/ dkon mchog 'grel g.yung ṭīka rgyan gyi me tog rong zom theg chen tshul 'jug snang ba lhar sgrub/ yon tan mdzod rtsa ba dang 'grel pa a lag bstan dar gsung 'di la khrid rgyun mi bzhugs kyang go ba 'gangs che gsungs nas de dang rdo grub gsung rgya mtsho'i chu thigs/

a bu'i dka' 'grel bcas/ rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso rtsa 'grel don khrid bcas/ sgyu ma ngal gso rtsa 'grel don khrid dang bcas pa thugs brtse bas gnang bas khong bka' drin che ba'i bla ma gcig yin/ las thog mkhan po bsod nams chos 'phel lam bshad sgrub chos kyi snang ba'i mdun sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan a bu'i tshig 'grel dang*/ spyi don/ rje rin po che'i legs bshad gser phreng*/ sher phyin sgom rim bcas/ spyod 'jug thog 'grel/ gom rim/ bla ma mi pham sher le/ kun bsod sher le'i spyi don bcas thob/ 'di dus thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba la shin tu dad par byung yang go ba gting zab pa zhig ma skyes pas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba btab pas nyin gcig chos mtshams shig tu skyo bsang la phyin pas ya gi ri ngogs shig na sher le par ma gos ya shi nag po'i dpe ras can zhig rnyed/ de nas bzung sngar dang mi 'dra tsam gyi go ba skyes/ de nas rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po tshogs bshad kyi lugs yin gsungs nas shrī sing ha'i lha khang du gsang bdag dgongs rgyan gnang ba dang*/ yang slob bshad kyi lugs 'di dbon rin po che bstan 'dzin nor bu'i lugs yin gsungs nas nyung shas la gnang ba rnams thob/ de rjes bka' brgyad kyi sku mtshams zla ba drug bzhugs pa'i mtshams g.yog bdag gis zhus nas thun mtshams su dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/ 'grel ga las 'jigs med/ zla ba'i tshig gsal/ rma bya ba'i 'grel bcas gnang*/ chos thun dbu 'jug nub tho rangs khar gsal snang zhig la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dge slong gi chas can mthong na mi mthun pa med pa de bzhin gshegs pa lta bu zhig gi phyag na dbu ma rtsa ba'i po ti bsnams pa bdag gi spyi bor bzhag te/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// zhes sogs mchod brjod de gsungs nas 'phros su/ rten cing 'brel 'byung don 'di rtogs par gyis shig

lan gsum gsungs/ de'i rkyen gyis rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag ji ltar byas kyang bde ba zhig byung*/ de nas rigs tshogs lnga po mthar chags su zhus/ dbu ma 'jug pa rang 'grel/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu'i mchan 'grel/ shes rab sgron ma'i 'grel pa btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa sems tsam lugs gtso bor bstan pa slob dpon chos skyong gi 'grel dang zla ba'i 'grel pa bcas la bshad rgyun mi bzhugs kyang bstan 'gyur khrod na lung rgyun bzhugs pa yin gsungs nas gnang*/ de nas yid bzhin mdzod rtsa 'grel don khrid/ bla ma mi pham gsung grub mtha' bsdus pa dang le'u bco brgyad pa'i dka' 'grel/ a bu'i gsung thog mtha' bar dge'i gtam/ theg chen mdo mthong phan yon/ dben gtam lha yi rnga sgra/ gzhi bcu bdun zin bris/ theg chen dbu ma'i lta khrid/ bka' gdams gsung gi gces btus rnams khrid dang 'thor bu phal cher lung*/ snying thig rtsa rlung mdzub khrid rnams thob pas khong bka' drin shin tu che ba'i bla ma gnyis pa yin/ de nas a lags skal ldan rgya mtsho'i yang sprul mdun snyan ngag le'u bar pa'i rgyan dang*/ bod mkhas dang khams pa'i 'grel gnyis/ bla ma sman lha'i mdun rtsis skor gza' lnga lnga bsdus/ dbyangs can sgra mdo/ sdeb sbyor a bu'i gsung*/ zhe drung mngon brjod bcas dang*/ stong za bag wa bla ma mdo sngags mdun mi pham sdud 'grel mdo sbyar bcas/ 'byed rnam gnyis 'grel/ 'jam dpal mchod chog bstod sgrub/ dag yig sum rtags 'grel si tu chos 'byung gsung bcas nod/ de nas mu ra sprul pa'i sku pad+ma bde chen bzang po der phebs/ rdzogs chen rang lugs kyi rtsa ba'i brgyud pa zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang rgyas pa 'phrad tshad rang grol/ 'bring po 'gro drug rang grol/ bsdus pa gtor dbang rig pa don ldan/
