bar do drug gi khrid yig bcas/ gnas lugs cer mthong*/ gzhung pod gnyis kyi bklag lung*/ ye shes bla ma'i khrid/ nges don bstan 'dzin bzang po'i gsung mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid thar lam dkar po/ shrī sing ha'i lha khang nas a bu'i phyag bzhes spyod 'jug le bzhi'i gsung bshad dang 'brel zab mo lta srol gyi byang chub sems sdom dang*/ mkhan bsod chos gzim shag tu rgya chen spyod srol bcas thob/ sgrub grwa ba rnams la bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub dbang rgyas pa gnang bas zhag du ma 'gor/ mkhan bsod chos las thog mkhan po yin gshis dge tshul slong mang po gnang dgos pas nam gnang tshe bdag las gral la 'gro dgos byung bas sku mdun du bdag gi skyor sbyangs gal che bas las grwa gzhan nas 'tshol bar zhus kyang des mi phan/ 'di'ang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes la ltos pa gal che bas lag len la byang bar dgos/ khyod la'ang rjes nas mkho ba'i dus 'ong*/ de dus gzod phyag len sbyang dgos byung na dka' las 'ong gsungs/ mtshams zhig nas rdzogs chen bslab grwa'i skyor dpon byas/ thams cad kyi dogs gcod dang bslab grogs bgyid dgos pas sun po byung*/ mkhan po ye shes rgyal mtshan mdun gsang spyi legs bshad rol mtsho dang*/ chos grags zin bris gnyis zhus/ a bu'i mdun nas spyod 'jug lan bcu gsum gsan nas sku tshe gcig gi nyams bzhes byang chub kyi sems kho na la rtsal 'don mdzad pa mkhan dkon mchog nor bu'i mdun a bu'i gsung rgyun gyis brgyan pa'i spyod 'jug gi bshad pa gnang bar gsol ba btab pas ngas chos chen po rang bshad mi shes/ deng sang slob gnyer ba 'di tshos ci zer gyi kha nyams nyul ba las med pas bshad pa la don cher med/ 'on kyang khyod de dang cung mi 'dra bas su la go ma 'jug dang sang nyin bshad gsungs/ spyod 'jug rtsa ba dang sa bcad gnyis po thugs thog nas shar gyis gsungs te mtshams 'di na a bu'i gsung rgyun 'di dang 'di bzhugs/

dpyad tshul dang bsam tshul 'di 'dra dgos zhes zhi lhag gnyis kyi lam gyi 'gro tshul man ngag dang sbyar ba yid 'phrog pa'i bshad pa zla ba gcig gi bar gsungs/ phran la zhal kyal tshul du bshad pa ci 'dra gsungs/ ngo mtshar che zhus pas/ de yin rdzogs chen dgon pas ngas slob gnyer mi shes zer yang*/ shes rang shes te ci phan/ phyi ma don gnyer dang nyams len don gnyer can su yang mi 'dug pas snga mo nas bshad pa ma byas pa yin gsungs/ khyed nas 'dul ba mdo rtsa e sbyangs gsungs/ ma thob pas dam pa mchog gi bka' drin skyong bar zhus kyang de mi 'ong*/ ngas dang po nas byang chub kyi sems kho na la blo sbyongs pas slob gnyer gzhan la bsam dpyod cher ma btang*/ mig yang sdug dpe cha la brten mi nus pas gzhan zhig nas zhu ba gal che/ 'dul ba 'di yon tan gyi gzhi ma lta bu yin/ sngar yin na dgon pa 'dir 'dul khrims dam po yod kyang da lhod 'gro ba'i skabs yin/ dbu ma thal rang gi lugs rtsod pa kha phyir bltas zhig las sems nang la skor mkhan cang med/ 'dul ba 'di la mi gzhi bzang zhing blo brtan po zhig dang shes rab khyad par 'phags pa re yang dgos/ tshul 'chos dang ngoms chos su ma song bar nges 'byung gi blo bcos min zhig dgos/ da lta nas de 'dra 'ong dka' bas bcos shing 'jug pa yin/ khyod kyang mi gzhi skyon med gcig yin ces bsod chos gsung las thos/ bsod chos mdun 'dul ba zhig e thob ltos gsungs pa yid la bcags/ mkhan bsod chos mdun 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ dbon rin po che'i mchan 'grel/ 'dul ṭīka rin phreng*/ mtsho sna pa'i 'grel pa/ dge 'dun grub kyi gleng 'bum/ rje rin po che'i gsung dge tshul slong gi bslab bya gnam rtse lding ma/ ser mdo mchan can/ 'dul ba me tog phreng mdzes/ shākya gshes gnyen gyi 'dul ṭīka bi ma la'i 'dul ṭīka bcas/ khong gi phyag dpe rin chen phreng ba dang gleng 'bum gnyis gnang nas 'di gnyis la ltos/

da res phyogs 'di na mchan 'grel zhig la mgo 'khor nas sdod pa'i dus zhig byung 'dug gzhung chen po la lta rtog byed pa su med/ las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag 'dul ba nas gsungs pa 'di las rig pas dpyad du med gsungs/ de nas dge bshes kun bzang bsod nams kyis nye gnas a dpal khong rdzogs chen du mngon pa'i bshad srol 'dzugs par gdan drangs nas rdzogs sprul rin chen ches gzhi byes gnyis nang rig pa bzang shos bcu tsam gyis sbyangs brtson dgos zhes bdag kyang yi ge'i nang 'thus bzhin mngon pa sbyang rgyu'i dbu btsugs/ khong dge bshes chen po yin pas rtsa 'grel phal cher thugs thog rang nas gsungs/ rang 'grel stod cha yan dang*/ rgyal po'i sras/ gang spel/ mchims mdzod che chung gnyis bcas bsgrags nas gsungs pas dang po zhag shas su tshig 'grel tsam yang ma zin pas thams cad ha las/ thugs mug ste mi shes par thag bcad/ bdag shrī sing ha'i ri ngogs sngar a bu bka' drin can gyis mngon pa gsungs pa'i pha waṃ chos khri 'dra ba zhig yod pa'i rtsar phyin/ mngon pa ma shes kyang rtsa ba tshar cha shas bton nas bag chags bzang po zhig zhog nges kyi smon lam re 'debs snyam nas chos khri'i rtsar dam pa'i chos mngon pa 'di slob dpon rang gi dgongs pa ci lta ba bzhin rtogs nus pa'i smon lam mang du btab rjes cung zhig gnyid du song ba'i mnal lam du slob dpon dbyig gnyen sha 'gags sngon po can chos gos gsum dang dbu zhwa ri khrod zhwa mo 'dra ba rna thung can mnabs pa zhig mjal ba'i mod la rgya gar gyi yul ljongs yin rgyu ba zhig tu bdag kyang slob dpon blo gros brtan pa'i bag chags 'al 'ol dran pa'i mur/ gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom shing*// zhes sogs mchod brjod de gsungs nas 'grel mdzad de mchims mdzod che ba 'di mngon pa'i dgongs pa ci bzhin bshad yod pas de la gzhi bcol nas ltos dang mngon pa shes 'ong gsungs pa nas/

de 'phral sku zhog bla brang nas mchims chen 'grel pa de g.yar nas mjal bas cung zhig shes pa byung*/ dkyil tsam la sleb dus mgo rdzogs gnyis nang ngan byed rkyen gyis mched grogs phal cher byer/ mngon pa'i mjug mthar chags su sbyang mkhan yong shar mkhan po/ dge rgyas bla ma/ rdor li/ nged bzhi las ma byung*/ phyis nas mkhan po lha rgyal las thog gsar bu'i dus bdag gis phul bas phyogs der bshad rgyun ma chad tsam byung*/ mkhan a dpal mdun blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus/ gtam rgyud rin chen spungs pa/ kun bsod gsung blo sbyong smon lam bka' gdams gces btus bcas thob/ bla ma mi pham sos thog der 'dan khog nas rdzogs chen du phebs/ rdzogs chen tshang nas ser phreng gi bkod pa rgya chen po bcas bsus nas gdan 'jags/ de'i zhor la zhal mjal tsam byung*/ shrī seng ha'i lha khang steng bzhugs/ nye gnas 'od gsal brgyud mjal kha zhib par thob/ chos 'brel zhig gi bka' drin zhus kyang skabs shig ci mi red gsungs/ khong gis mkhas 'jug gi bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dbu btsugs nas zla gcig tsam na nags chung ri khrod du phebs/ dbyar zla lnga pa'i nang shed du sku mdun phyin pas mkhas 'jug de nyin brtsams grub 'dug de ring rgyal phur gyi sbyor ba 'dzom pa'i dus bstan bcos mthar dbyung ba dang 'phrad pas khyed rten 'brel legs zhes/ dpe cha'i dbu nas 'di mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes mkhas tshul gsum la 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar lta bu yin/ sa paṇa gyi mkhas 'jug dang 'di gnyis khyad par 'di che/ sdom byang 'di blor 'dzin dgos/ sdom byang yin rtsa ba min gsungs/ de dang gzhung gnyis sbrel te dbu nas cung zhig 'grel 'phros lung lta bu dang*/ bzhag pa nas kha shas bzhag de 'dra'i ngang dgong mo tsam la rdzogs/ de 'phral dpe cha mgo thog tu bzhag nas 'di khyod la gtad pa yin/ dbu mjug tshang ba tsam 'don thub ma song yang nga bstan bcos mkhan pos gnang ba thob pa yin pas phyin chad 'chad rung*/

'di la brten nas khyod kyis bshad pa zhig byas na mkhas pa mang po thon 'ong*/ lung gces nas khyed gnyis la bshad pa dgos tshul gyi gsung shog snga phyir 'byor kyang nga rtsa dkar nad 'dis rgyun du mnar ba'i steng lo yang rgas pas bshad pa la sun pa skyes/ bstan bcos kyi dpe cha 'ga' re bzhag na rnying phyogs la phan thogs re 'ong du re yang dus dbang gis dka'/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas yun ring tsam zhabs pad brtan na snga 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' rang rkang gi srol chen po phye gyin yod kyang bsod nams kyi skal bar ma dbang bas zhi bar gshegs/ de rjes rnying phyogs la go ba chags mkhan bla ma lung rtogs bzang shos yin/ de 'phros bsod rgyal dang rdo grub gnyis la'ang go ba mi skyon tsam re yod/ de min mkhas pa cang mi 'dug nga sngar kaḥthog tu song nas si tu sprul sku la byams chos sde lngas gtsos bshad pa kha shas byas/ de dus bshad grwa re'i 'dun pa byas kyang thog tu ma khel/ da res si tu sprul sku khong gis bshad grwa re'i thugs 'dun gyis nga la gdan 'dren zhu ba'i bang mi dang yi ge 'byor kyang 'gro mi gru ba 'dra/ phyin chad khong gi thugs bskyed dus smin re 'ong na khyod kyis rogs dan re ma 'chug gsungs te mtshan brjod kyi dpe cha dpe ras dang bcas pa 'jam dbyangs ril bu bdun cha bcas gnang*/ nye gnas 'od gsal nas kyang bla ma bka' drin can gyi slob ma yin pas nga la nam yang thugs brtses bskyangs/ yang nyin gcig da res mar me khri mchod kyi mjug de grub dgos shog gsung byung bas nged phyin nas nyin kha shas rogs dan bgyis/ mtshams su sku mdun nas sems don sangs rgyas lag bcang gi skor tshan mang po ldeb bzhi bcu tsam yod pa'i lung zhus/ 'od gsal brgyud gang blo ma'i rjes gnang thob par zhus pas nyin gcig gang blo ma'i 'od zer dgu phrug gi rjes gnang dang bstod sgrub bcas gnang*/

nged kyi 'jam dpal rgyud lugs 'di da sngon bka' rgya yin/ byin rlabs kyi bab gzhan las che/ 'di gcig 'bri na dpe g.yar chog gzhan su la'ang ma ston gsungs/ de bzhin dpe de khyer nas shrī sing ha'i ri ngogs brag skyibs shig tu dpe bshu byas zin nas dpe cha yar 'bul du phyin/ 'di la dbang zhig yod na thugs rjes 'dzin par zhus pas dbang par ban phyogs med kyi de las med/ bskur yang mi nus/ lung zhig 'don gsungs nas sgrub thabs skong ba tshe sgrub gtor ma dkar dmar btang thabs dang*/ las tshogs dbu nas cung zad gsungs 'phros 'od gsal la zhus/ phyin chad khyod nas bsnyen tshad re ma song bar su la yang ma spel gsungs/ rjes sor bsnyen tshad gsum bskyal/ las tshogs phal cher bsnyen nas spel ba yin no// de nas mkhan bsod chos mdun brgal lan nyin snang dang*/ mngon pa kun btus sa bzang gi 'grel bcas gsung bshad dang*/ sa sde lnga/ theg bsdus/ dbyig gnyen kyi sum cu pa/ ka ma la shī la'i sgom rim gsum bcas bklag lung dang*/ rdzogs sprul lnga pa'i mdun yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang lung tshang bar zhus/ 'brug pa sku chen chos dbyings rol pa'i rdo rje'i mdun dgongs 'dus rtsa ba'i dbang chen don dbang dang bcas pa thob/ mdor na lo ngo gsum zla ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ring la nyin mtshan lto sbyar nas slob gnyer rang la nan tan bgyis/ stag gi lo'i ston kha der mar 'ong rgyu byas nas bsdad par nyin gcig 'brug pa sku chen pad+ma'i thang du bzhugs pas gsung 'phrin la/ de ring li gri gcig khyer la dbu skra bsil mkhan shog gsungs pa 'byor bas/ bdag gis li gri khyer nas sku mdun phyin par bzhad mo gnang nas ngas de ring mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang zhig bskur snyam yang gzhan gyis go na thams cad 'tshang 'ong bsam nas g.yo thabs byas pa yin/ da bu lug khyi thar khyod gnyis nas gnas khang phyag dar legs po gyis/

rgyan dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang tshogs gtor yang rgya chen po dgos/ de rnams ma grub par nga thang du 'gro gsungs te phyi logs gi shing ra'i nang phebs nas gdan khar bzhugs/ nged gnyis nas gsung bzhin bsgrub pas phyi gro tsam na tshags su tshud 'phral nang du phebs/ mkha' 'gro snying tig 'di grub dbang rdzogs chen pa zhes chos ming gang zag la thogs pa 'di kas yin/ 'dir chig brgyud kyi dbang brgyud 'dzin bu gcig kho na la gtad dgos pas mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rjes nga la gtad/ da ngas khyod la gtad snyam pa ste/ nga la grwa mda' karma'i lung bstan du da lo gangs khrod du song nas lo gsum tsam 'dug rgyu byung na tshe chos gnyis mthar phyin/ de la grub na zhe bzhi 'di la gegs che gsungs/ nga rang gi lung bstan du da lo ma shi nas yun ring tsam 'dug rgyu byung na de nas pad+ma 'od du 'gro/ da lo shi na yar lung phyogs su skye ba gcig brgyud mthar pad+ma 'od du 'gro bya ba yod gsungs/ bdag gis khyed re zhig bzhugs thub pa bka' drin ma chung*/ bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos/ phran nas thugs la gang 'bab kyi zhabs brtan lo zla'i kha mtshams nges pa can ci gnang yang bsgrub zhus pas ci zer/ ma shi na dga' ba las shi na dga' ba su med kyang da lo 'chi ltas dang mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba'i snang ba yang mang po byung*/ dbang 'di khyod la 'phrod dgos pa yod gsungs/ 'o na bla ma rdor li la e thob zhus pas gzhan sus ma go na chog gsungs/ khong gis dbang sgrub gnang*/ ngas mchod g.yog byas/ khyi thar bla ma rdor li 'bod par btang*/ bdag gis tshogs gtor zhig phyir mchod par khyer bas shing ra'i rgyab thams cad bud med rigs mi 'dra ba du mas gang byung bar sku mdun du ngas ni su la'ang dbang yod par ma smras/ khyi thar nas smras pa yin nam/ phyi rol du bud med mang pos gang nas byung zhus pas/ ngo shes pa su 'dug gam gsungs/

mi 'dug zhus par/ 'o de tsho mi min mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba 'dra yin 'gro/ dgong mo drang ba'i dus khang steng du tshogs mang po mchod dgos/ lhag ma'i dus keng rus mang po 'khrab 'ong*/ snying thig gi srung ma yin pas sems ma yengs par de dus dgongs pas zin dgos/ khyod dgongs pa e mtho lta gsungs/ de 'phral shrī sing ha nas khong gnyis kyang slebs byung bas de nub sta gon bgyis/ phyi nyin dngos gzhi gsungs/ dbang gi gtad rgya'i mgor da khyed rnams nas khas len gyi maṇ+ḍal re med na dbang 'don phod pa mi 'dug gsungs/ khyi thar nas thig le'i rgya can gyi bsnyen pa zhag brgya zhig dang*/ bla ma rdor lis thod rgal la blta rgyu zhag brgya'i dam bca' phul/ bdag rtog pa snga phyi'i 'phro 'du dbyings su zhig ste rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du ha re lus nas byung tshor gyi rgyu ba chad pas ngag nas gang yang ma thon/ da khyod kyis ci khas len rgyu yin gsungs/ ci dran ma byung nas nyid kyis dgongs zhus par/ 'o na mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid 'di tshar bcu gsum 'chad rgyu gyis/ rang gar bshad pas mi 'ong rang gis nyams su blangs nas bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gnang ba thob pa'i dus 'chad spel dgos gsungs/ de bzhin dam bca' zhus pas gtad rgya'i dbang smon lam dang bcas pa gnang*/ tshogs kyi lhag ma'i dus keng rus mang po dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' na phar 'khrab kyin 'dug par lhag ma'i gtor ma de rnams la 'bul snyam tshe bla mas lhag ma phyir phul la shog gsungs/ de bzhin phul du phyin pas sgo yi phyi rol na rdo rje g.yu sgron ma bud med 'phyor sgeg gi rnam pa can du snang*/ dbang zin nas da rdor li khyi thar gnyis song*/ ngag mi nas nged kyi bca' kha rnams bsdu dgos gsungs/ khong gnyis rang gnas su btang*/ bdag de nub sku mdun bsdad/ nang mo dbang chas rnams bsdu tshags byas par khar sang dbang dus khyed kyis ci mthong gsungs de tshul zhus pas/

keng rus rnams la skrag snang dang bud med de la chags sems skyes sam gsungs/ lar de 'dra gang yang ma byung*/ shes pa gtad med du song nas byis pa'i ltad mo mthong ba ltar 'di yin ngos bzung med pa zhig byung zhus pas/ 'o de yin de yin dgongs pa chos nyid kyi klong du chos thams cad 'ub chub pas mkha' 'gro ma bdag gi dbang du 'dus bya ba yin pas phyin chad khyed la bar chad med gsungs pa 'byung 'gyur gzigs pa'i gsung du dge de nas rang yul du 'ong bas bka' drin can lo snga ma'i zla ba lnga pa'i nyer lnga la dgongs pa zhing khams su gtad pas sa phyogs thams cad mya ngam gyi thang lta bur sor 'dug bdag bzhugs sar phyin nas gdung rten la phyag dang mchod 'bul byas pas gdung rten rtser 'ja' yi thig gi ko mog la rdo bskyur ba lta bu'i nang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gcig mjal/ gdan sa der mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na la brtson/ bla ma'i sku dang gsung gi snang ba yang mang du byung bas dus kun tu thugs rjes 'bral med du bskyangs par nges pa'i yid ches thob/ de nas rta hor rong dang smar khams kyi chos zhu gnyis 'byor/ de gnyis kyis gtsos chos zhu re zung la byams chos sde lnga sogs chos thun 'ga' re bshad/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod dang por 'chad nyin snga dro'i char 'ja' 'od kyis lung pa khengs pa tsam byung*/ yon tan mdzod 'chad pa'i zhor la tshogs 'bum phrag gcig bsags/ bka' drin can gyi dgongs rdzogs la dmigs te dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad nyung ngu zhig kyang byas/ gdung rten mdun phyag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bum phrag bcas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos shing mi pham bstan rgyas smon lam de grangs mang bsags/ bka' drin can gyi gsung gi snang bar/ dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra// khyed dang skye ba bcu gsum 'grogs// bzang ngan las kyi 'brel ba kun// pad 'od sa la 'drenapar mchi// zhes gsungs pa zhig thos/

snying thig gi phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon gyi bsnyen mtshams la zla ba gsum bar bzhugs/ bskyed rim gyi ngo bo la thal 'byin bzhi'i dgongs pa rdzogs par byas/ de dus phyi gling gi byad ngo mang po byung yang sngags kyi srung ma'i thugs rjes bskyabs song*/ de grub pa dang gter gsar drag po rnam gsum kyi nang tshan gshin rje'i bsnyen pa btang*/ 'khor lo bzhi'i dgongs pa dang sbyar zhing mjug tu gtor bzlog zhig kyang byas/ zor gtor lha rgyal zer ba'i grwa pa zhig la bskur bar gtor ma la me rang 'bar du byung zer/ dgong mo gnam sa bar snang gi pra ltas legs/ khyad par nam mkha'i skar ma rnams skar mda' bzhin 'tshubs shing rgyug pa chos zhu kun gyis mthong*/ kha skong gi sbyin bsreg btang ba'i thal sol chu nang du btab pa'i rkyen gyis 'ur sgra chen po grags/ dgun grang ngar rgyas pa'i sgang la thal sol btab pa'i chu de'i yas man mda' rgyang tsam tshun gyi 'khyag rom thams cad chur zhu ba sogs byin rlabs kyi ltas khyad par can nyams su bstar/ de dus nyag rong gi dmag zing che bas bla ma'i bzhugs gnas 'dir sdod stabs ma bde nas sngar gyi bzhugs gnas phal cher 'grim/ snying thig gi drag po dpal chen 'dus pa dang ma mgon lcam dral gyi bsnyen pa btang*/ sngags kyi srung mas g.yu yi me long dwangs ma'i ngor kun tu bzang mo de'i thugs kar as mtshan pa zhig bstan nas da rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa spel ba'i dus yin sdong grogs bya gsungs te ral pa'i nyag ma rnams bya sgro lta bu'i leb mo zhig tu song bas bdag la g.yogs snang byung 'phror 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i nyams mtha' dbus dang bral bar shar/ de'i rjes tsam na gtsang btsan chen po rdo rje legs pas mgar chas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i gzhong pa zhig gtad byung bar bltas pas gser dang lcags kyi tho ba sha stag tu song 'dug de gnyis bzang ngan gang yin dang gang len dgos ma nges shing sems the tshom pa zhig gi ngang khong gis gser gyi tho ba 'dis longs spyod rgyas/

lcags kyi tho ba 'dis dgra 'dul ba yin/ gcig las gnyis len du med zer bas gser gyi tho ba de blangs pa'i nyams shar/ de skabs shig na snying thig gi rtsa rlung 'di la gsung rgyun gyi bshad pa zhib mo zhig yod na nang rgyud sde gsum gyi rtsa ba'i man ngag 'di kha tshang bas ci drag snyam pa rgyun par shar ngang nub gcig mchims phu'i lung pa pad+ma kha phye ba 'dra ba'i lte bar rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa sngags dkar dkyus ma'i chas can zhig gis snyan brgyud kyi shog dril dang gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor rnams bstsal ba'i snang ba zhag brgyud mar byung kyang dngos su lag khrid 'pher ba ma byung bas gzhan la ni ma yel/ de nas dkar ldings ri khrod du phyin/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro gnyis dang rgyud lugs 'jam dpal la bsnyen pa btang*/ las tshogs rten 'brel snying po 'bum phrag bcas bsags par dgun grang ngar che sgang yin kyang maṇ+ḍal gyi 'bru sa la 'thor ba rnams la myu gu mtho gang tsam re skyes byung pas rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa'i don la nges pa 'drongs/ de nas 'dus pa nyi shu skor la sgyu 'phrul zhi khro gnyis kyi dbang dang gsang bdag dgongs rgyan gyi bshad pa bgyis/ de 'phral mtshams dam po byas te snga dgong gnyis la thod rgal bltas pas mtshams shig nas thig le stong sgron mkhar gzhong tsam pa lnga brtsegs su shar ba dang*/ snying thig brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dran pa'i mos gus kyis rkyen byas/ zhi khro longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang zhing khams kyi snang bas khengs/ rig rtsal rdo rje lu gu rgyud phra ba'i shes rab nang dbyings su thim/ nyams kyi 'dzin stangs kyi shun pa thams cad yal nas rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes kyi gshis su slebs/ yul dang yul can gyi 'dzin pa zhig ste 'od gsal rtog med chen por 'byams klas nas nyin phyed tsam song*/ phyi dro'i skabs bla ma 'od zer byung nas khyed ci na'am snyam kyang gzim 'dug ces nga'i me bus pas tshag sgras rkyen byas dbang po yul la sad pa'i rjes thog der ye shes zang thal du shar bas snang ba'i bden 'dzin zhig ste bden med kyi snang ba la 'di yin gyi gza' gtad med pa dang shin tu phra ba'i rdul phran gyi dngos po dang de skad cig gis skye 'gags byed pa mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur/

nyon mongs phra rags kyi rtog pa rnams gar song cha med du yal/ rtsal chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab khyad par can rdol ba sogs sa lam mthon por phyin pa'i phyi nang gi rtags tshad thun min rnams rang gi myong ba yang dag gis gtan la phebs/ snang ba bden med du shar ba'i lag rjes su dril bu rdo thog tu lhung bar rdo la dril bu dang dril bu la rdo rje'i rjes phan tshun gnyis char dod/ sgrub chu chad pa'i chu mig nang klu gtor btang bas mar gyis nya sbal sogs bzos pa srog chags dngos su song*/ de ma thag chu rgyug pa byung*/ de nas rgya skor sprul sku kun bzang theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yid bzhin mdzod dang ngal gso'i khrid gsan par phebs/ khrid rdzogs pa dang khong la snying thig ma bu khams lugs su brgyud pa bzhugs pa'i dbang lung tshang bar zhus/ rang gi 'khos 'byor la dpag pa'i maṇ+ḍal rten mtshon yang gzab rgyas khul du bgyis/ de 'phral khong yar phebs/ bdag mkha' 'gro gsang ba snying thig gi mtshams la zhugs/ mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang gsum dang shan pa srog sgrub bcas kyi bsnyen pa btang*/ gter srung ldang lha'i gsol mchod zhig kyang brtsams/ bla ma yang tig gi rtsa ba gsum dang spros bcas spros med kyi dbang gi bsnyen pa rgyas par btang*/ de'i phyi lo 'khyil kho zhes pa'i dben pa zhig tu mkha' 'gro yang tig gi bsnyen mtshams skabs/ nub gcig gnyid du nye bar bud med dmar mo 'jigs su rung ba sen mo lcags kyu ltar gug pa zhig byung nas nga la sbar shad byas snang gis rnam shes mda' 'phang ba bzhin 'og min du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo bzhugs pa'i pho brang gi shar sgor phyin pas bud med dkar mo mu men gyi bum pa thogs pa zhig gis khrus byas rjes/ kyai/ khro bo mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku sogs/ mkha' 'gro snying thig rang gi sgo zhus de lan gsum bskyar bas/

dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shag gis phyes pa dang mnyam du/ za ging*/ rnga ging*/ rgyug ging*/ stob ging*/ sgrol ging*/ sbyor ging mang po nyi zer kyi rdul ltar 'tshubs pas snang ba yengs ma lam du dar gcig dran med du lus/ keng rus rnams rgyug 'khrab 'jags rjes bdag da lta'i snang ba gtan mi 'char bar lha lcam pad+ma gsal lus la dar smug gi gos dang rin po che'i rgyan can me tog gi thod bcings pa zhig tu snang ba la bud med snga ma des me tog dmar po phub tsam zhig gtad de nga yi lag pa nas 'jus zer/ nang du khrid pas rdo rje khros ma zhi ba rigs lnga mkha' 'gro ma bye ba mang pos bskor ba'i gtso mo'i mdun der dbang stegs pad+ma dmar po'i khar 'od dmar po'i dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yas phyogs su zi ri ri 'khor ba zhig gi steng bsdad nas me tog gi zhwa thod de phud par brtsam pa na snga ma'i bud med des de phud mi dgos/ gu ru rin po ches khyod la gnang ba'i zhwa yin zer/ de nas gtso mo des mkha' 'gro gsang ba snying thig gi rin po che dbang gi sgron ma nas dbang rim par bskur/ sngar gyi me tog de gtso mo la phul bas gsang ba'i mtshan 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal zhes btags/ bum dbang gi rjes su dbang gong ma gsum dbang gi ma 'grel dang sbrags/ rtsal dbang gong ma gnyis bcas tshig bcad rnams gtso mo'i rtsa zhal dang*/ sngags rnams dbu yi phag zhal des gsungs nas snying thig chen mo'i khrid bcas gnang*/ de'i rjes su mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis dbang gi bkra shis brjod/ 'di khyod kyi nor skal yin gsungs nas dngul dkar me long rgyang gsal/ za 'og smug po'i gos gser g.yu spel ba'i rgyan thod pa smug phri le ba dum bu lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la mkha' 'gro snying thig gi chos tshan re mig 'phrul ltar 'char ba bcas stsal/ yang dbang gi bum bskor gcig stsal nas da song gsungs/

mi yul du sdod dka' bas 'di ga rang du sdod chog pa zhus kyang da lam mi 'ong*/ tshe srog la bar chad du 'gyur/ slad nas 'ong bas chog da res mi yul du song la mkha' 'gro snying thig gi bstan pa'i bdag po khyod yin pas 'gro don gyis/ byang gi gtso mo de la 'di mar skyol gsungs/ de dang mnyam du byang sgor thon te ma zad du phyin pa na dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba thod pa'i pho brang zhig gi nang du khros ma rigs lnga bzhugs pa'i gtso mo des me long dang thod pa phyag tu blangs te oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang de gnang tshad zhig la thams cad mi gsung bar bkra shis kyi bden tshig brjod pas me tog gi char chen po rdog nu tsam bab/ shrī swasti zhes pa'i sgras phyogs thams cad du khyab pa dang*/ byang gi khros ma ljang mo de la 'di bar chad med par rang gnas su skyol cig pa'i bkas bsgo ba gnang*/ de dang nged gnyis lhan cig tu bya rgod gzan la bab pa bzhin 'ong nas bdag gi phung po'i steng du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma de bab pa dang phung po'i spyi gtsug nas dur khrod lha mo me tog ha lo'i mdog ltar mdzes pa zhig byung nas mdun du 'khod/ bdag kyang spyi gtsug nas sngar bzhin zhugs pas dbang po yul la sad pa na las kyi mkha' 'gro las dur khrod lha mo la chad tho bsgrags/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba snying tig spel ba'i srung mar bskos nas song*/ de nas bzung re zhig bar dur khrod lha mo de rgyun par yod pa'i snang ba byung*/ yang dben khrod de nas rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog zhig bgyis pa'i mtshan mo'i gsal snang la zhing khams shig tu bla ma bka' drin can lung rtogs rin po che bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb par phyag phul byin rlabs zhus pas gral gong der gdan zhig bting 'dug pa'i khar sdod bcas gsungs/ bdag gis bla ma gshegs nas da bar nyams len la 'bad pa'i rtogs 'bul zhig zhus par skabs su mi gsan par a bu'i gsung bla ma rgyang 'bod de mgur 'dra zhig mdzad de gsungs yang snga ma'i 'phros nas zhus pas rtogs pa bzang gsungs/

bdag gis kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung gi gsang ba gdams ngag gi 'gros dang man ngag gi mtshon tshul 'di shin tu ngo mtshar che zhus pas/ kun mkhyen chos rje la ngo mtshar che rgyu ci yod/ nged kyi bla ma dpal sprul rin po che bya bral gu yangs kyi mdzad pa 'di ngo mtshar che tshul gyis bsngags brjod gnang 'dug bdag gis de bas ngo mtshar che ba gzhan yod dam zhus pas khyed rang gi bla ma ku ma rā dza de bas ngo mtshar che gsungs pa dang mnyam du bud med gzhon nu ma zhig dang skyes phran gcig bcas byung nas bla ma ku ma rā dza mjal du 'gro zer bas de'i rjes su phyin pas gnas yar stod sham po gangs kyi rwa ba'i thang me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa zhig tu rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza ras dkar gyi gur zhig na sgo dam por byas 'dug pa'i phyi rol du slebs/ phyag dang gsol ba btab pas nang nas khyod su yin lan gsum gsungs/ ci yang zhu ma nus par grogs skyes phran zhig 'dug pa des 'di skal ldan snying gi bu gcig ngag gi dbang po'o zhus song bar kun mkhyen yin rgyu'i snang ba dar cig shar/ de nas gur sgo phyeba'i nang du phyin pas gur de gzhal yas khang*/ bkod pa blos mi 'khyud pa na bla ma ku ma rā dza dka' thub gyi chas can zhig gi rnam par bzhugs pa la byin rlabs zhus pas de gnas gyur nas rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rje'i skur gyur pa'i steng phyogs na rdzogs chen ston pa bcu gnyis pos chos gsungs/ pho brang nang gi khyams thams cad zhing khams drug cu rtsa bzhi gtso bor gyur pa'i zhing khams kyi bkod pa dang ston pa'i rnam rol bsam gyis mi khyab pa gdul bya sems can grangs med pa dang bcas mig 'phrul ltar yom yom shig shig tu snang*/ bdag gis chos nyid don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal la mnyam par gzhag pas sngar gyi grogs skyes pa des/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhis rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud de snyed gsungs pa la ma yengs par nyon ces bskul pa la ched du nyan pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsung gi gdangs rnams gcig tu 'dres pas a ā i ī sogs dang dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal nas nam mkha' glog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs gsungs pa tsam las gzhan ci yang ma thos/

rang gis bsam pa la rgyud kyi mtshan de ltar thogs pa de 'dra zhig yod na gang zag su zhig gis 'dzin pa dang nyams su len nus/ shwa lo ka ci tsam yod snyam pa dang*/ sngar gyi grogs skyes pa de mgon po legs ldan nag po bing dbyug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ bud med de sngags kyi bdag mo zhing dbyug dang dam shing 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur pa'i zhal nas/ bsam pa'i blo yi dbye ba bzhin/ byon dang 'byung 'gyur byung ba yi// rgyud kyi mtshan thogs de lta yis// da lta shwa lo ka shes byos// mi gsung gsung ba med pa'i dbyings// gdul bya'i dbang gis so sor snang*// gcig dang du ma'i mtha' las 'das// kun kyang sde gsum dgongs par rdzogs// gsungs pas zhing dang ston pa gdul bya'isnang ba phar bltas na mtha' mi mngon pa ltar snang yang de dag so so rang rgyud pa ma yin par bla ma'i thugs rje ye shes kyi rol par ro gcig pas dngos grub phyi la re ba byis pa ltad mor yengs ba lta bu ma don med pas/ nang rang rig don gyi bla ma dang dgongs pa bsre dgos snyam/ rig 'dzin chenapo ku ma rā dza mkhyen ces gsol ba btab pas snang ba de dag chu sna rgyug pa brang 'phrad pa ltar slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje la thim/ de yang mthing ka khyab pa chen po'i thig le gcig tu yal nas snga ma'i skabs bzhin ku ma rā dza dge slong gi chas can ri dwags kri'i ṇi'i lpags pa'i steng du bzhugs pa la gsol ba drag tu btab rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas/ sngar bdag gis khyod la rdzogs pa chen po bcu bdun rgyud ma bu snyan brgyud man ngag dang bcas pa'i dbang gdams ngag thams cad byin pa yin mod/ da lam yang bskyar du rab tu gnas par bgyi gsungs nas sba smyug zhig gi rtser rma bya'i mdangs thig gcig dang mgul du dar 'phan ser po'i ngos su mtshal gyi kha dog lta bus kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams gang shar rang grol rtsal zhes bris pa spyi bor bzhag

spyan lta stangs kyis gzigs te dgongs pa gtad nas a a āḥzhes gsungs pas sngar rig 'dzin chen pos gsungs pa'i gnas rnams yid la tur gyis dran/ dka' ba'i gnas thams cad rang grol la song nas tshig don gnyis ka la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i nges pa rnyed pa 'di rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza'i bka' drin las byung ba yin pas slad nas bdag gi rjes su 'jug pa dag gis brgyud pa gangs la thug pa'i chu 'gor yid ches pa'i phyir bris pa lags/ de yang rang lo nyer dgur son du nye ba rta yi lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang tsam na lus bskyed pa'i ma drin mo che glo bur du mkhris skran nad kyis btab nas sman dpyad dang rim gro ci byas kyang phan skyed ma byur bar gter chen rin chen gling pa'i brtags babs su rgyal chen sku lnga'i gsol mchod stong rtsa grub na phan ngo bab par nged dpon slob 'ga' res bton/ stong rtsa grub pa'i nub nga gnyid du song ma song gi mtshams shig tu rta yi rmig sgra dang*/ dril g.yer gyi sgra bcas rta pa mang po zhig byung snang la bltas pas/ chos skyong rgyal chen sku lnga thams cad kyang chibs rta dar dang za 'og rin po che'i sga cha can la bcibs shing za 'og ser smug gi na bza' gsol ba/ zhwa mo lcags mda' can mnab pa sha stag byung ba dang bdag la gus 'dud zhe sa dang bcas/ khyed bka' nan che bas nged cag da lta pe dkar dkor mdzod gling nas 'ong*/ lan gcig 'dir mchi rgyu/ sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan/ sngon las bzlaug tu med/ 'phral gyi rkyen ngan min/ zhes zer nas yud tsam zhig nas ga shed du gshegs song*/ de tsam na mdzes byed pad+ma skyes yin snyam pa'i bud med zhig gis khyod kyi a ma de sngon gyi 'phen pas tshe zad la thug pa nged lcam dral gyis ci bgyi ma mchis phar la gzigs dang zer bar bltas pas/ ma rgan gyi nad mal de na bud med nag mo skra dang sma ra dmar ser khyug ge ba gcer mo stag lpags kyi sham thabs can khri'u la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyi bsdad bzhin du bud med mang pos khyogs la ma btegs grab 'dug pa mthong bas gsal snang de yal/

ma'i rmi lam du'ang ben+de gser gyi gtsag bu bzung ba zhig gis nged kyis sman par btang ba yin zer nas rtsibs ma'i bar nas rma btod rta rnga'i nyag ma 'dra ba mang po blangs song ba rmis zer/ de nas zhag bcu gsum bar nad med 'dra bar song*/ slar yang nad khams phyir ldang gis zla ba bzhi'i bar nyin mtshan med par snying rje dang bde sdug gtong len/ nad g.yog kyang bgyis pas des rang gi sdig sgrib dag pa yin snyam bgyid/ lug gi lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu'i nub mo cung zad gnyid du yur ba'i snang char dbus lha ri mer pa brag gi byang ngos der brag phug mi shong tsam gyi nang nged nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po yin rgyu dang sgrub pa la bzhugs tshul gyis 'dug pa'i mdun der/ bud med mdzes ma bzang gos kha dog lnga ldan rim par brtsegs pa'i phyi na sos sngon po dri ma cung zad chags pa gsol ba zhig phebs 'dug par bdag gis 'di su yin snyam pa'i mur bud med des/ bu mo nga ni nyer bzhi'i yul nas 'ong*// ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad pas// rdo rje phag mo dzñā na sa ga rā// gsang sngags rgyud kyi bdag mo nga min su// zhes gsungs nas 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i dbang dang rgyud bshad bcas gnang*/ 'o da nas bzung bod yul sa 'og kun gyi zab gter smin grol thams cad la rang dbang ba yin/ dngos gter gyi dgos pa chung*/ snga ma rnams la 'chad nyan gyis gsungs nas mig 'phrul lta bu'i snang char na bza' nang ma sku drod can de phud nas nged kyi lus la g.yogs byung bas rkyen des bde stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du 'byams klas/ de'i rjes kyi snang char phyi rol gyi tsha grang dang rdo dbyug tsher ma sogs reg bya 'jam rtsub thams cad bde bar shar nas nyams des zla ba gcig gi bar 'khyongs pa byung*/ de'i byin rlabs kyis rin chen gter mdzod lan gsum dang*/ gzhan yang sngags kyi smin grol gang 'chad pa'i skabs su'ang bar chad cung zad ma byung ba 'di rgyal yum 'phags ma mchog gi thugs rje'i mthu las byung ba lags/

de nas zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin sa g.yos shing 'od zer gyi snang ba dang bcas ma rgan mo dus kyi chos nyid du gyur te phung po zhugs la sbyangs pa'i bar snga phyi thams cad du ltas khyad par can mang du byung yang snyigs dus kyi skye bo'i rna bar mi mdzes pas de tsam las ma bris so// de nas ljon pa lung 'dir 'ong nas mar me khri mchod gcig bzang spyod stong tshar gsum bcas bsgrubs/ de dus bsam pa dag pas yin snyam gang ltar yang mar khu 'phel ba dang*/ mchod stegs kyi ngos la mchod pa'i sprin gzungs rang byon du phebs shing mar zhun skag pa'i steng du rtags brgyad rdzas brgyad kyi ri mo bkra ba kun gyi spyod yul du gyur/ gter chen ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rin po che'i mdun rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi lung zhus/ nyin gcig gter chen gsung las nged rang dpon slob tshe rabs mang por bla slob res mos kyi 'brel ba yod pas sang nyin gsang bdag zhal lung 'di la dgongs rgyan gyi bshad bsdus shig gyis/ ngas zhu dgos gsungs pa bzhin phul/ rgyud 'bum gyi lung grub pa dang rdzogs chen du lan gcig song*/ mkhan po lha rgyal mdun tshad ma rnam 'grel zhus/ gzhan don rjes dpag gi skabs cung zad blo 'jug dka' ba byung bar lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba btab pas ji bzhin shes pa byung*/ de dus 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod pa zhig kyang brtsams/ mkhan po gzhan dga'i mdun go ram pa'i 'jug ṭīka lta ngan mun sel/ theg mchog dbu ma'i spyi don/ mngon rtogs rgyan dka' 'grel/ 'jug ṭīka rang lugs khong gis bkol ba de dang*/ klong snying rtsa rlung bcas thob/ mkhan po lha rgyal dang khong rnam gnyis la tshig gsum gnad brdeg gol shor tshad gcod gnyis phul/ mkhan po bsod chos mdun mkhas 'jug dang rab lan bcas zhus/ khong la khregs chod snyan brgyud kyi khrid dang*/ ye shes bla ma'i khrid gnad bsdus zhig dang*/

gzhan yang blo gsal 'ga' la zla ba brgyad kyi bar 'dod chos rnam so sor phul/ mtshan mo mar me'i snang ba la brten sher le mdo rtsa/ sdom gsum rnam nges rnams bshad dgos pa byung*/ re zhig 'dug snyam kyang brel zing gi g.yeng bas sos bsod po ma byung nas phyir 'ong rtsis la rdzogs sprul rin po ches/ spyir phyi ban rnams mkhan por bsko srol med kyang dben po tshang dang lung rtogs gnyis khong gi ma dgon gyi bla ma dngos dang khyad par med pas mkhan po lha rgyal rjes su khyed mkhan po sdod dgos/ gto ri'i khang pa/ pad grags khang pa/ klu rgyal khang pa/ klu phrug khang pa bzhi ka gang gi blo bab che yang gnang chog gsung*/ phyag mdzod nas de bzhin bka' sbyar/ khyad par klu rgyal klu phrug gnyis kyi khang pa 'khor gzhis bcas gnang gsung byung yang*/ sngar bla ma bka' drin can lung rtogs kyis rdzogs chen du yun ring ma 'dug gsungs don bzhin sdod rgyu'i blo sna bstungs nas kar gling zhi khro'i sgrub chen phyag bzhes chos dbyings rol pa'i rdo rjes chog bsgrigs gnang ba'i sgrub khog de steng nas sgrub chen gyi lag len dang*/ gzhan tshogs chen 'dus pa'i sman sgrub gyi phyag len bcas dbu mdzad pad nor dang*/ mchod dpon kun bzang bstan 'phel gnyis mdun sbyangs nas rta khog sar kaḥthog tshang gis rten sbyar zhi khro nyin shas 'tshogs rgyu yod pa de sgrub chen du zhal bsgyur bas sgrub chen lan bcu dgu tsam tshugs/ de dus sgrub khang la 'ja' yi ka ba zug pa/ tshogs chang 'dzad med du 'phel ba/ rtsa ba'i ril bu las mang du 'phel ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi'i sa stegs la ston kha yin kyang me tog dkar po yu ba ring po can mang du skyes shing sman gyi pho brang du sku rang byon byung ba dang*/ a ru nag chung mang po sman phye'i nang glo bur du byung ba sogs 'brel tshad don ldan gyi rtags mngon du snang ba yin snyam bgyid/

rjes nas 7skyabs rje si tu'i bkas zhi khro bka' brgyad sman sgrub du bsgyur dgos phebs par smin gling gi phyag bzhes can gyi bka' brgyad sman sgrub tshar bco lnga tsam tshugs/ ri khrod ljon pa lung du re zhig sdod rtsis kyis phyogs 'dus kyi dge 'dun mang du yod pa la dgun khar mdzod bdun gyi lung 'don pa'i sngon du yum ka'i dbang zhig bgyis par thod pa chus bkang ba chang kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par song*/ me long la yum lnga'i sa bon bris pa rang byon ltar 'bur du dod/ mdzod bdun lung dbu 'dzug nyin bud med rin po che dang mu tig gi rgyan can zhig byung nas chos thun gcig tsam nyan nas gar song cha med du song*/ de gzhi grwa rnams nas phyi grwa zhig gi gro skyol yin snyam bgyis/ phyi grwa rnams nas 'di ka'i bud med yin snyam byung zer/ don la rdo rje g.yu yi sgron ma dgyes pa'i rtags su go sems nyid ngal gso la bshad pa zhig byas par de nyin ri klung thams cad 'ja' yis khengs/ nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od zlum po 'khyil ba'i thig le du ma'i nang nas me tog dkar po se ba'i me tog tsam mang po bab/ dgong mo 'ja' phal cher sa la thim/ 'ga' re nam mkha' la song bas thams cad kyis ngo mtshar bar brtsis/ bdag ni blo yi spros pa chos nyid du chod pas bzang ngan gyi snang ba gang la'ang re dogs kyi 'dzin pa zhig nas thams cad mnyam rdzogs chen por phyam brdal du song*/ de nas nub gcig gi snang nyams la bud med rgyab thams cad spos shel spus gtsang ba sha stag gi rgyan phyar ba'i rgya khyon tsam gyis brgyan pa dre'u la chibs pa zhig 'ong nas da 'gro dgos zer/ khyod su yin gang du 'gro smras pas bdag snga 'gyur mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bdag mo re ma ti bya ba yin/ nyid kaḥthog tu 'gro don skyong ba'i dus la bab pas 'gro zer/ bdag gis nga gdan sa chen po la 'os pa'i bla ma gang yang min/

snyoms chung gi chos zhu re zung bskyang na 'thad smras pas/ e 'os/ nga rang gis shes 'di chibs zer nas sa la bab te rnam phrag nas rgya gser 'dra ba'i bzang gso gyi gding ba zhig blang nas sga steng du bkab/ srab mda' nas bzung te 'dug pa rmis pas ci yin snyam pa dang*/ phyi nyin kaḥthog si tu rin po che nas bslab grwa 'dzugs bzhed kyis der 'ong dgos pa'i gsung shog 'byor yang re zhig ngang 'then byas pas lo shas 'gor/ mtshams rer gsung bris nam 'byor la sngar gyi bud med de 'ong nas 'gro dgos zer/ nyin gcig bud med de la nga song na phan thogs 'byung ngam/ si tu rin po che khong thugs bskyed ci 'dra smras pas khong sa bcu'i sems dpa' chen po bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gang nas gang du rab byung gi rgyun btsug ris med pa'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba dang bshad grwa dang sgrub pa'i sde 'dzug pa sogs thugs bskyed rlabs che/ khyed dbu 'od ye shes 'bum pa dang zangs ri 'bum pa sogs kyi dus gdan sa de bskyangs bskyangs pa yin pas rang mi rang khyim du 'gro bar mi spro'am zer/ de nas gzod 'gro thag bcad yod par nub gcig nying 'khrul gyi snang bar/ dam pa yab sras kyi gtsos dge slong mang po khang pa chen po zhig gi nang du bzhugs 'dug pa de'i sgo tsam na dpe cha mang zhig brtsigs pa can gyi nang du phyin/ rje nam mkha' lta bu mtha' dbus bral/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ byin rlabs zhus/ dpe cha 'di rnams ji lags zhus pas/ 'di rnams mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi dpe cha yin/ bdag po sprod mkhan med nas rgyun ring por song bas dpe yang kha yar brlag 'ga' re la si tu sprul sku nas bdag bgyis pas 'di dag lus pa yin gsungs/ da dung mang tsam gda' zhus pas/ bu med na pha nor mang bas ci phan bdag po yong na gnang rgyu yin gsungs/ 'o na mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi dpe cha zhig gnang thub pa zhus pas/

nged kyi dus na spyi mdo la rtsal du bton nas bshad pas de dus phan thogs chen po byung*/ da phan 'gro don yod pa mi 'dra/ sems phyogs khyed rang la yod pa des chog sgyu 'phrul 'di la bshad pa zhig byed chog ces dbu nas mar/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes pa tsam gyi mthar/ chos rnga chen po'i sgra yi sogs gsungs pas gsal snang de yal/ kaḥthog tu ma song ba'i snga rol du rig 'dzin chen po sna tshogs rang grol gyi mdun rdzogs pa chen po dgongs pa zang thal/ mkha' 'gro yang tig bla ma yang tig bcas kyi dbang zhus/ de dus rtogs 'bul zhig byas pas thugs dgyes tshor cher mdzad/ rang re gnyis rtogs pa go bsdur byas kyang chog gcig gis gcig la rtogs 'bul byas kyang chog khong dgung grangs bcu gsum dus kaḥthog tu phyin/ si tu chos kyi blo gros mdun rdo rje snying po'i sngon 'gro gsan/ de dus 'chi ba mi rtag pa nges par rgyud la skyes te lo shas sgrib sbyong bgyis/ de nas si tu gong ma'i mdun rtsa rlung dang rdzogs chen gyi khrid zhus/ dgung grangs nyer gcig dus rig pa'i ngo bo mthong*/ so bzhi'i bar rig pa rkyang 'dod kyis nyams len byas/ de dus rgad pos rtogs pa 'di 'dra zhig rnyed/ de yan ci yang bogs dbyung du mi 'dug ces rtogs pa brnyes tshul gsungs byung bas rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa bya ba 'di 'dra zhig la bya snyam pa shar/ der khong gi sgar bzhugs zhal slob rnams la nged sar rtogs 'bul dgos tshul phebs pas slob ma phal cher rtogs 'bul zhu byung ba la rang gi shes tshod kyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ de nas rdo rje snying po'i sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i khrid gsungs pas de dang slob ma'i gtso bo phal cher la khrid rgan rang gi steng nas yun ring por gsungs/ kaḥthog pa'i lugs kyi khrid rkang mang zhig gnang nas 'di rnams si tu gong ma las khong gis gsan pa'i brgyud pa khyad par ba yin/

khyed kaḥthog tu 'gro na lo re la sngon 'gro 'di tshar re chad ma 'jug gsungs/ da khong la smin gter gyi mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid 'di khyod la shes rab kyi rtsal ci yod kyis bshad pa phul dgos gsung byung bar/ nyid nas sngar gsan yod las che/ lung tsam 'bul dgos na ma gtogs bshad pa 'bul mi phod zhus kyang skyon med/ 'di la rten 'brel gyi dgos gnad che gsungs pa'i bka' nan ldog ma spobs par de'i bshad pa phul/ gter ston rin chen gling par mdzod bdun lung dang*/ ngal gso'i bshad pa phul/ tshur khong gi gter gsar gshin rje/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po/ rdo rje khyung khra bcas kyi dbang gnang shing rtsa ba'i chos bdag tu lung gis zin/ chos rgyal chen po'i skye phreng yin tshul dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan tshig bcad dang dngos 'bul spom mtho ba gnang*/ de nas sgo 'dzi gter ston ye shes 'byung gnas phebs/ de la mdzod bdun lung tshar gcig phul nas ljon pa lung du phyir theg de'i dbyar ngos la kaḥthog gnyer pa rig rdor dpon g.yog bsu ba slebs kyang khrom chu phyur ba dang 'phrad pas a 'dzom sgar las 'dir ma thar/ si tu rin po che'i gsung bris g.yag gi rwa rtser bcings nas tshu rol du btang ba 'byor ba'i lan du sang phod sprel lo nang kaḥthog tu 'byor rgyu dkrigs chod kyi yi ge phul/ lo gcig bar gter gsar 'jam dpal zhi drag gi bsnyen pa btang*/ bdun phrag gcig nas 'jam dpal nag po'i zhal mthong*/ me tog sngon po'i char sgrub khang gi sa gzhi non pa tsam bab/ rten gyi ril bu rnams bdud rtsir zhu/ drag po'i bsnyen pa e ring 'bum phrag bdun bzlas/ dregs pa sde brgyad kyi snying dus gcig la za ba'i rmi ltas byung*/ phyis su si tu rin po ches khong gter rdzun red gsungs kyang nged la ni log lta ma skyes/ gter ston rang tshad ma yin pa 'dra mdzad pa 'dra min dang zhal rdzun phran bu re gter ston rnams kyi gshis ka zhig tu snang ba dang*/

gter chos kyi tshig don phun tshogs sha stag bzhugs/ gter chos kyi 'gros 'dra ba tsam gyis rdzun par sgrub mi nus/ sngar gyi rtsod med kyi gter chos phal mo che'i tshig ris nyang gur sogs kyi gter tshig dang phyogs 'dra ba mang du bzhugs kyang de tsam gyis rdzun par bsgrub ga la nus snyam pa dran/ spre'u lo zla ba drug pa'i mgor bsu ma 'byor/ de 'phral kaḥthog tu phyin pas tshes bcu'i 'tshogs pa dang 'phrad/ tshogs mang nas rol bsu dang rgyud sde'i khang du 7skyabs rje si tu rin po che gzim khang sgo 'gags bar bsu ma la phebs/ der mjal dar rtse sprod dang nang du mdun gral la gsol ja/ nyin dgung gi gsol tshigs bcas mnyam du gnang*/ rgyud sde'i dbu dang po 'dzug skabs nas sleb pa'i re ba byas kyang ma sleb/ rgyud sde dbu tshugs nas lo gnyis song*/ da res phebs shin tu legs/ sang tshes bcu'i tshogs pa la legs bshad kyi maṇ+ḍal zhig phul dgos gsungs/ phyi nyin rin po che dang*/ rje dbon bla ma a stobs/ mkhan po kun dpal rnams bzhugs pa'i tshogs gral du bka' brgyad kyi bla ma rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i dgongs pa mos gus lam gyi zab gnad du rim dgu'i gnad phal cher tshang ba'i bshad pa byas pas mkhas pa mgu ba'i legs bshad du song*/ rin po che dang*/ rje dpon rnam gnyis nas phyag dar sker sgron gnang*/ tshes bcu'i nub dri med zhing skyong gi 'dra zhal mdun bdag gcig pur bdud phur gyi dbang lung gnyis ka gnang zhing*/ sang nyin nas skyor dpon dgos rgyu'i bka' phebs/ phyi nang rgyud sde'i lha khang du chos kyi khri la mnga' gsol te/ ston pa'i sku gser zangs ma/ rdor dril/ bum pa/ sman raka shing gi gtor ma/ dung dkar cha/ phyag shing*/ mig thur/ g.yab dar lcags rdor can/ chos gos/ gzan/ stod 'gags/ sham thabs/ bzhugs gdan/ bzang gos kyi stod 'bog dpe cha skor theg pa spyi chings pod gcig

shes bya mdzod pod gsum/ mchod rten chung ngu rnams gnang nas bshad pa zer na khar sang gi bshad pa de 'dra dgos/ don gyi khog ma khrol na tshig 'grel rkyang pas gar yang mi phyin/ slob gnyer gsar bu rnams la don gyi gnad bslang te bshad pa bka' drin ma chung gsungs te phyag dar gnang te chos kyi khri la chos kyi rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur ba'i skal ba bzang po thob/ de nas dbyar gnas la mkhan pokun dpal bzhugs/ sdom gsum rab dbyer ngag dbang chos grags 'grel/ go ram pa'i dka' 'grel/ shāka mchog pa'i dris lan gser thur/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gsung rnams sbrags ston kha nas tshad ma rnam 'grel dang rig gter rnams gsungs/ rig gter nang phyogs snga phya gtsang dan gsum gyi 'dod pa bkod nas dgag pa'i skabs rnam 'grel gyi phyogs snga dang mi 'dra bar snga rabs pa'i phyogs snga de rigs pa shin tu phra ba'i gnas yin pas rigs pa'i 'gros nges dka' ba byung*/ rig gter rang 'grel la dpyad pa'i skabs zhig tu rmi lam la bdag sa skya'i sgo rum gyi gzims shag tu slebs 'dug par chos rje paṇa chen la gsol ba btab pas bzhugs khri gcig na chos rje grags pa rgyal mtshan spyi gtsug cung mtho ba la dbu skra dkar seng nge ba rab byung gi chas can du bzhugs pa la byin rlabs zhus/ bdag la sa paṇa rang gi phyag dpe'i steng nas rig gter gyi gshad pa zhig zhus pas/ 'o khyod gnas gsar pa'i dus tshar chen dang khyod gnyis lam 'bras phyogs la bka' drin shin tu che/ man ngag slob bshad kyi yig cha yang mang du bzhag 'on kyang da res kyi skye ba 'di la bstan pa 'dir phan pa zhig mi 'ong bas rig gter gyi bshad pa mi 'ong gsungs/ 'o na chos rje'i phyag dpe'i khrod nas rgya dpe ldeb gcig gsol ras zhu byas pas po ti gcig nas shog ldeb gcig rang blangs pa la gzigs te 'di nga yi zhen pa bzhi bral bya ba de dang 'phrad 'dug pas 'di bshad gsungs te gnang ba rmis pa chos rje grags pa'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan mar rtogs/

de nas yid bzhin mdzod/ man ngag mdzod/ chos dbyings mdzod bcas la bshad pa gnang*/ bya yi lo 'go zin mtshams rdza stod phyogs su rgya zing gis mkhan rin po che kun dpal yar phebs dgos shar/ ༈ gsum pa gzhan don ji ltar bskyang ba'i rnam bzhag mdo tsam smros na/ de yang mkhan rin po che/ yar phebs shul bdag gis mkhan po'i khur blangs nas bshad grwa de bskyangs pas rgyud sde snga ma'i mjug lo gsum dang*/ phyi lo lnga tshan gnyis ste snga phyir lo bcu gsum la zhabs zhus bgyis/ de'i ring la rab tu byung ba gcig pu'ang gsum stong bzhi brgya tsam byung zhes rje dbon rin po ches rtsis bgrang gnang 'dug gzhan don nus nges pa so bdun/ dbang chos kyi 'brel ba grangs med pa byung*/ de'i bar rgyud sde'i dpe tho nang gzhung che phra/ nyis brgya lhag tsam bzhugs pa rnams rgyal rong tsha kho/ mgo gser gyi chos zhu mang po/ 'jang phyogs dbus gtsang stod smad lho 'brug sogs 'du ba shin tu mang bas nyin re la chos thun bdun re tsam dang gsum bzhi man mi dma' ba bshad/ rdo rje snying po'i dbang lan gsum/ snying thig ma bu tshar nyer bdun/ mdzod bdun tshar bcu gsum bcas gzhan don ltar snang gi khur rgya chen po blangs/ skabs su dgongs 'khrol yang yang zhus kyang gtan nas ma gnang*/ rin po che thugs bskyed rlabs che bas rang la dka' tshegs cher byung yang bstan rgyun dang rang gi sgrib sbyangs su dmigs te dka' ba dang du blangs nas mchog dman gyi chos zhu su byung gi ngo bzlog ma myong*/ zhar la rang gis kyang 7skyabs rje si tu'i mdun bka' brgyad rnam gsum las snga ma gnyis sgrub dbang dang 'brel ba rang shar dbang rkyang*/ tshogs chen 'dus pa khams dbus kyi brgyud pa gnyis char/ rdo rje snying po'i dbang tshar gnyis/ bdud 'dul dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ rin chen gter mdzod chen mo/ shes bya mdzod/ gdams ngag mdzod dus 'khor jo lugs dang*/

zhwa lu lugs gnyis kyi dbang gong ma gong chen dang bcas pa/ jo zhal gnyis kyi yig cha ci yod/ dam pa rin po che'i zhi khro phur gsum/ ma mo'i srog gtad thun min/ kun mkhyen sde bdun gyi srog gtad/ thun min rje mkhyen brtse'i 'od gsal snying thig dang grub thob snying thig gi dbang gdams man ngag dang bcas pa/ zab mo nang don/ rgyud bla ma/ brtags gnyis bcas kyi 'grel pa 'jam mgon kong sprul gsung*/ phur ṭīka 'bum nag dang nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi rnam bshad 'jam mgon rin po che'i gsung*/ yang dag gsang 'grel bla ma mi pham gsung*/ rong ston sher phyin 'grel/ byams chos sde lnga'i sgom rim/ tshad ma'i sgom rim/ sher phyin g.yag 'grel/ gsang 'grel bka' mchims phu ma chos rje dam pa'i gsung gtsang ston gyis zin bris su btab pa/ spyi mdo'i mchan 'grel dam pa rin po che'i dka' 'grel sa bcad/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo'i mchan 'grel/ bsam gtan mig sgron khrid gtsang ston gsung*/ sems sde'i pra khrid theg pa spyi chings ye shes rgyal mtshan 'grel/ shākya rdo rje'i dka' 'grel/ gsang snying 'grel zur cho'i btsun pa dkon mchog tshul khrims gsung*/ sngags 'chang nam mkha' rin chen 'grel/ zur mo dge 'dun 'bum gyi 'grel/ sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i 'grel/ lam rim che chung gnyis/ thugs thig mchan 'grel/ lam chung 'grel nam mkha' dpal ba'i gsung*/ dam tshig gsal bkra dang phra rgyas gnyis mchan 'grel bcas/ dam pa'i gsung sgra mthun don 'phags dug sbrul gyi stong thun/ ral gri'i stong thun/ ljon shing gi stong thun/ rgyal po dza yi lam rnam bkod/ nag mo khros ma'i dbang*/ mtshan brjod dbang mar lugs/ 'grel pa rong po stobs ldan rdo rje'i gsung*/ bi ma la'i 'grel pa/ gu ru tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi gter ma rdzogs chen du bkral ba chos dbang gi spros bral don gsal chen po'i rgyud dang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bcas kyi khrid/

rdor gling klong gsal 'bar ma'i khrid/ spu gri rnam gsum gyi rgyud 'grel/ bka' brgyad rnam bshad gsang sngags lung gi bang mdzod dang tha ram/ bka' bsgo lde mig bcas/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa mtshan can rim lnga gdan rdzogs/ gnam zhal don khrid/ klong gsal bka' brgyad kyi don khrid bcas khrid du thob/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos lung*/ grol thig rtsa rlung*/ byang ba'i sngon 'gro gzer lnga/ klong gsal rtsa rlung khrid bcas nod/ rje dbon rin po che'i mdun nas bka' brgyad pod dgu'i bklag lung*/ dgongs 'dus pod bcu gsum dang*/ bdud 'dul pod dgu'i lung*/ dam pa yab sras gsung 'thor pod gcig 'khrul zhig dbang drag rgya mtsho'i gsung 'thor bu'i skor/ chags med ri chos dang them med skor bcas kyi lung*/ gling tshang mkhan po'i mdun rgyud bzhi dang 'grel pa baid+yur sngon po pod bzhi/ man ngag bka' rgya lhan thabs/ dar mo'i bka' rgya ma/ mi pham gsung rtsa chu'i 'grel pa rtsa rgyud rde'u 'grel sngo sman lag khrid bcas/ mkhan rgyal mtshan 'od zer mdun mkha' 'gro yang tig gi khrid zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung*/ nges don snying po'i lag khrid/ gsang spyod rdo rje'i lam bstan/ bla ma yang tig gi don khrid skor gsum/ snyan brgyud skor gsum dang*/ rang grol skor gsum gyi don khrid bcas nod/ bka' ma'i mchod khag bcu gsum gdong drug bcas kyi dbang lung tshang ma/ yang mkhan po kun dpal kaḥthog phebs byung ba'i mdun nas snying thig rtsa rlung lag khrid dang*/ 'brug pa bla ma phrin las mdun rdo grub dngos slob a lag nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i gsung bka' rgya can gyi khrid skor dang yig cha phran bu'i skor rnams zhus/ mgo log bsod nams dpal ldan mdun rje'i byang chub lam rim che chung gnyis/ gsang sngags lam rim/ de'i snyan brgyud rim lnga'i khrid/ gzhan yang dar ṭīka

rnam bshad snying rgyan/ rje'i 'jug ṭīka sher ṭīka rtsa shes ṭīka chen rig pa'i rgya mtsho bcas zhus/ dpal yul mchog sprul pad+ma nor bu'i mdun/ gter mdzod lung bka' rgya ma pod gsum/ gnam chos pod bcu gsum steng dgongs gter bcas pod bco brgyad/ gnam chos khrid bzhugs so cog rang gling gter chos kha bskang bcas pod bcu gsum/ byang gter pod drug smin gter pod drug 'ja' tshon pod drug grol tig pod gnyis/ lok+t+ri'i gzhung pod gcig chos dbang yang gsang spu gri pod gcig bka' ma'i gzhung pod skor rnams rje dbon rin po che dang rang la yod rigs bcas phan tshun 'bul res kyis kha bsab pa pod nyer drug bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang rgya bod mkhas pa mi bzhi'i rnam bshad/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang phran tshogs dang bcas pa thob/ yang 7skyabs rje si tu'i mdun phyag chen man ngag rgya mtsho/ lhong bya bral ba'i rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ bar khrod pa bkra shis rin chen khrid bcas thob/ gter chen dri med mdun tshe bdag lcags 'dra sdig gnyis pod bzhi/ gnubs lugs dbang chog mu tig phreng ba/ dbang bka' rin po che'i phreng ba 'di spyir mchod rten rab gnas dbang min kyang slob ma la bskur srol yod pas zhus/ thugs chen yang snying 'dus pa'i gzhung pod bcas/ yang rin po che'i mdun nyang gter khros nag pod gcig mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i nang tshan pa kha shas/ gtsang pa bla ma'i mdun sa lugs mkha' spyod pod gcig dbang khrid chos nyid dngos bstan gyi byin rlabs bcas thob/ de dag ni rang gi mang du thos pa'i sgo rags rim tsam du smros pa ste zhib tu thob yig las gsal/ de dag gi skabs su bdag la dag pa'i snang ba byung tshul mdo tsam gleng na/ de'ang bdag rgyun par byang rwa sgreng gi gnas su 'gro 'dod yid la bcags pa'i nub gcig rmi lam gyi snang char rwa sgreng du slebs/ dgon pa 'dra ba ni mi 'dug

brag 'bur lta bu'i steng na rgyal bu 'brom ston pa'i gzims chung yin snyam pa'i shar phyogs su sleb pa dang bud med zhig bsu ba la 'byor/ rang gi kun rtog la bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa chen po zhig tu bud med ci la yod dran/ khyod su yin/ nga la rgyal bu 'brom ston pa dang mjal sna zhu byas pas/ de cung zad 'dzum nas nga khyod la tshe rabs thams cad du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rje btsun ma yin pa mi shes sam/ da nang du 'gro gsungs/ lam sna gnang nas gzims phug tu phyin pas gzims khang 'dra ba de rdo'i rtsig pa lta bu yi ge 'bru drug gi rang bzhin phyi nang gsal ba de thams cad phyogs kyi kha dog can steng 'og gnyis sngon po dang dkar por snang ba'i khang pa zhig tu khrid nas nang du yig drug gi rang bzhin can gyi khri stong pa zhig bstan/ 'di rgyal ba 'brom ston pa'i bzhugs khri lags pas phyag dang byin rlabs zhus/ khong da lta dga' ldan na bzhugs zer/ bdag gis phyag dang byin rlabs zhus/ nga 'dra ba'i bsod nams dman pa bla ma dang mi mjal ba ci yin snyam snying bton pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis non/ ngag nas kyang ya gi dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab sras gnyis bdag la thugs rjes dgongs te gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas ngus pas bud med des rdo leb chung ngu zhig gi steng srog chags phra mo bzhi phyogs bzhir 'gro ba de'i phyi na yang gcig 'gro ba bcas lnga bstan te so sor mdzub mo btsugs nas/ 'di la byams pa/ 'di la snying rje/ 'di la dga' ba/ 'di la btang snyoms/ 'di la byang chub kyi sems zhig sgoms dang zer/ de bzhin bsgoms pas tshad med bzhi dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bcas cig char 'char ba zhig byung bas bud med des/ de yin/ rgyal bu 'brom ston pa sku dngos su mjal yang thugs kyi dgongs pa de las gzhan med/ khyed rgyal bu nyid dang mtshungs pas jo bo rin po ches khong rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba'i dbu zhwa 'di yin zer/

rum nas paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhwa rna ba ha cang mi ring ba zhwa khyon la rtse khru gang tsam gser skud kyis dung dkar ri mo ltar mang po dkris pa zhig blangs te gnang byung bas paṇ+ḍi ta sa yi snying po'i bag chags zhig kyang dran/ de tsam na mi mang po 'tshogs byung ba la bud med des khyod 'brom ston pa dang khyad med pas tshogs pa 'di tsho la chos shig shod zer/ de dang mnyam du thams cad kyis sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang sogs bton song bas/ rang gi bsam pa la/ zhwa 'di gyon na bud med kyis byin pa'i zhwa yin pas khong tshos shes na ngo tsha/ chos bshad pa la zhwa ma gyon na mi rung*/ jo bo rin po che'i dbu zhwa yin yang srid snyam du bsam blo cung zad btang*/ de nas the tshom med par zhwa de gyon pa na byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs nor bu'i phreng ba de yid la bkra lam gyis byung ba de'i chos thun rgyas pa zhig bgyis pa'i mjug tu bud med des/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs bton nas tshogs pa thams cad gyes/ bud med de rje btsun ma yin par nges nas bka' gdams lha bzhi'i byin rlabs shig zhus pas snga ma de dag lha bzhi'i byin rlabs yin/ da phyi rol na logs shig tu lha bzhi'i byin rlabs ngas mi shes gsungs/ zhwa mo de yar phul bas khyed rang gi yin pas khyer chaug gsungs nas phyir gnang ba na rmi lam sad/ de dus rgyal ba yab sras sku mched gsum brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig bris/ yang mtshams shig tu/ me yos lo dang chu glang lor// thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs 'gyur te// stag yos lo pa'i sngags pa des// thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba na// me sprel lcags stag rnams la 'tshe// zhes pa'i lung bstan ltar rang gis drag po rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyen pa nangs nub gnyis la thun du bcad/ nyin mo chos 'chad kyi bya bas brel yang lhar snang gsal ba dang bsnyen pa yid bzlas ma chad par zla ba dgu'i ring la bsnyen pas nub gcig gnyid shin tu 'thug pa zhig byung*/

de las sad pa'i snang char dril g.yer gyi sil sgra lta bur mang du 'khrol 'dug par bltas pas bud med dkar chas can bzhis 'ja' sgor rnga gdan 'dra ba zhig la rigs lnga'i rtags kyis mtshan sa phyogs bzhir dar thag bzhi btags pa'i sne nas bzung ste/ da steng du phebs zer/ gang du 'gro byas pas/ mon kha ne ring seng rdzong dang stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub tu gu ru yab yum bzhugs yod pas byon pa drag zer/ de 'dra'i sa thag ring por bdag rkang 'gros kyis mi 'pher bas mi 'gro/ gu ru rin po che dang nam yang 'bral ba med byas pas/ rkang 'gros kyis bgrod ga la dgos gdan 'dir bzhugs pas chog zer/ de nas gdan de yang rngams su gru gang tsam yod pa zheng khang pa'i rgya tsam du gyur pa'i steng bdag 'dug pa dang mnyam du nam mkha' la yer gyis btegs nas nub phyogs kyi bar snang la phar bzhud de song bas sa gzhi la yul gru dang lung pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa snang*/ bdag gis 'di dag gang yin byas pas/ bod yul gyi sa cha yin/ dgos pa med 'gro zer/ yang song song bas 'og na yul gru chen po du ma yod pa'i sa phyogs zhig gi nam mkhar khong rnams ngal gso ba lta bu byas shing snod gcig nas sha rlon pa dang chang mang po blang nas bdag la'ang drangs/ khong rnams kyi de dag gsol zhor la yul gru 'di dang 'di yin/ 'di na rgyal po dang blon po/ rab byung*/ dge bshes/ skyes pa bud med sogs sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis bstan 'gror sman pa mang po yod tshul sogs kyi gleng mo mang du bgyid 'dug bdag gis sha 'di mi sha yin 'gro snyam nas ma zos par khong tshos shes nas/ 'di ni sha min pad+ma'i 'dab ma yin/ chang min gsol na nam mkha'i chang drong zer nas dngul chu lta bu zhig drangs byung ba de 'thung*/ sha de pad 'dab dngos 'dra ba chang gi dri mnam zhing ro skyur ba zhig 'dug pa thos/ da dung gtam ngo mtshar can yod zer nas bud med kyi bsngags brjod dang lung bstan 'dra ba mang po gzhas bro 'khrab pa'i ngag lta la drang 'dug par/

bdag gis gter ston lung bstan gyis phung bya ba yin/ de tsho mi shes 'gro byas pas/ yin yin khyod 'dra ba'i nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag la mi dgos kyang dbang po 'bring dang tha ma'i gang zag la dgos pa yin zer/ 'o na deng sang lung bstan yin zer nas gdol spyod kyis gzhan mgo bskor ba mang po mthong ba ci yin smras pas/ de 'dra rang min ste spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel shes pa nyung zer/ dus tshod dang 'brel bar lung mi ston par dus min du lung ston pa ci yin byas pas/ he he/ dus su lung bstan kyang don sgrub mkhan med pas ci bya zer nas yang song bas/ stag tshang gi ri brag sngon po dang dkar po shas che ba/ smad kyi cha nags rong rtsub mo la stod kyi cha brag dkar pad 'dab 'dra ba/ phyogs gsum ches mtho zhing lho ngos dma' ba'i nyams can khang pa thog so mang po'i tshad du long ba'i rtsar slebs pas bdag sa thog der bzhag khong rnams ging 'dril gyis ya ki brag ngos su bya 'phur ba ltar song*/ bdag gis kyang 'byung ba nam mkha'i rlung bzung nas khong tsho'i phyi la thogs med du phyin pas gnam sa bar snang thams cad badz+ra kī la ya'i rang sgra 'brug ldir ba ltar grags/ de dang mnyam du nam mkha' nas lha rgyal lo zhes sgra chen po zhig grags byung bar grogs gcig gis/ da res thengs gcig la bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba yin zer/ der ri de'i byang 'dabs kyi thang yangs pa zhig gi ri ngos la gtad pa der stag tshang gi phug pa mi shong tsam gyi steng ngos la kī la ya'i yi ge rang byon 'dra ba che chung gi tshad 'bru re la mi tshad tsam rang sgra dang bcas 'gul shig shig byed pa zhig snang bas de gu ru rin po che dngos yin snyam gyis/ rdo rje tshig bdun mas gsol ba btabs pas yig 'bru rnams gcig tu 'dres pa skad cig gis gnas 'gyur te mthing nag rdo rje khro phur dang*/ smug nag rdo rje khro phur gnyis mar me dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin gcig tha dad kyi dbye ba mi phyed pa zhig tu mjal bas rang rig pa rtsal gyi dbang zhig blangs te/

oṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje gro bo lod// sngon gyi thugs dam chen po bzhin// sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// de bzhin nyid dbyings gnyis su med// ces rig pa'i me tog dor bas sku de las mthing nag rdo rje khro phur mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du bdag la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi lus rdo rje gro lod dngos kyi skur gyur pa na sngar gyi mkha' 'gro ma gcig stag mo zhig tu gyur pa la mkha' 'gro gcig gis de zhon zer/ de bzhin zhon nas hūm̐ gi nga ro bsgrags pas sa gsum 'jig la khad kyis rgya gar gyi lho phyogs su song bas dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal yin snyam pa zhig tu phyin pa na lpags pa 'dra ba'i gur zhig na gu ru yab yum/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer sogs gter ston mtshan thos myong ma myong mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ dkyil 'khor gcig gi steng du mi ro zhig bzhag nas bzhugs 'dug par ci lags zhus pas/ nyang gi zhal nas/ bka' brgyad kyi dbang mo che gnang rtsis yin gsungs/ de tsam na stag des mi ro de thal gyis gtor song bas khog par sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba tsam shar/ tshogs pa rnams kyis rnga brdungs nas lha bskyed zhig gsungs/ sngags pa 'ga' res chang bum 'dra ba zhig khyogs la btegs nas 'di dbang gi bse sgrom smug po bya ba yin dngos grub longs gsungs/ nang du bltas pas chang skyur lta bu zhig 'dug pa hub gang btung*/ chang 'di la ro 'di las med pa ci lags zhus pas/ ro 'di tsam yod pa dga' rab yin/ bod kyi bla ma chos dkrugs dkrugs pas chang shed chad pa yin gsungs/ da ro can yod dam zhus pas/ sngar klu bdud ti pa tsa'i mgrin pa na yod pa'i lcags sgrom khyod la gtad rgyu de la ro nus yod kyang khyod kyis rtsis med du bor gsungs/ yang stag mo de sngar bzhin rgyug pas rgya gar gyi yul gru phal cher bgrod nas dur khrod kyang mang du 'grim/

rnal 'byor pa yin rgyu'i lnga ras can ḍā dril dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bzung ba dang bya dang nya dang mtshon cha bzung ba mang po dang 'phrad kyang stag mo des nga ro res thams cad zhum zhum ltar byed 'dug dur khrod chen po brgyad na rgya gar gyi bka' babs rig 'dzin so so la bod kyi rig 'dzin res sgrub g.yog bgyis nas gsung gleng gnang bar/ bka' brgyad la spyi bka' sgos bka' mang po yod tshul gsungs 'dug pas bka' brgyad 'di la 'di zhes mtha' gcig gis tshad bzung du med pa 'dra/ de nas rgyang ring po zhig na mchod rten chen po nam mkha'i sprin nang du slebs pa du ba lta bu'i rnam pa zhig mthong*/ dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten mkha' 'gro'i pho brang de yin par shes nas der rgyud kyi dpe 'ga' re zhu dgos snyam bum pa'i shar sgor gtad de phyin pas bu mo chung ngu dbu skras mdun rgyab phal cher g.yogs pa mang pos bsus/ bum pa'i nang du phyin pas a phyi shin tu rgas shing mdog zhan pa mig gis mi mthong ba/ zhal na so gcig kyang med pa/ snyan gyis yo li gsan pa'i rnam pas gos hrul ngan pa zhig gis bstums nas bzhugs 'dug pa la/ bdag gis 'di ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dngos 'dra bas bde dgyes gsang gsum gyi dbang zhig zhu snyam nas gsol ba btab pas mi gsan pa'i tshul gyis a a rang gsungs/ yang zhus pas gsum po mi 'ong gsang ba 'dus pa de bya gsungs nas ljags kyi steng nas rdo sngon po gru bzhi pa e waṃ ma ya bzhi'i yig 'bru can zhig lag tu byin nas 'di sbyin pa phangs gsungs te mi snang bar gyur/ de nas byang sgor phyin pa na skyes pa zhig gis ngo gnag nas bsdad 'dug pa la/ khyod ci nyes zhes dris pas khang pa 'di nas sngar yang mang po rku shor/ da yang ma zhig brlag song ba khyod kyis khyer song zer/ bdag gis khang stong na rdzas yod ma myong ba khyer rgyu ci yod/ stong pa'i rdzas de khyod la bzhag yod pas gnyer ka gyis/

he he byas pas/ khos bdag khang pa 'di yi srung ma yin/ khyed kyis khyer ba la mi dga' ba med kyang de sbyin pa'i slob ma snod ldan med pas mi dga' ba yin zer ba dang skad cig gis mgon po phyag bzhi pa zhig tu gnas gyur nas khyed rang dpal gyi ri la 'gro na rogs dan bya gsungs nas des lam sna byas te rgya gar lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bor phyin kyang klu sgrub yab sras ma mjal/ de na bud med mang po zhig cho+e lo rang bkye nas gad mo rgod kyin 'dug pa der phyin pas phal pa'i bud med lta bu mang pos shwa rdel kha dog lnga pa du mar yig 'bru lus dben/ ngag dben/ sems dben/ 'od gsal/ sgyu lus/ zung 'jug bris pa'i shwa drug tshan can sha stag gis rtsed mo bgyid 'dug par/ bdag la'ang sdod la shwa rtses zhes lag tu shwa rdel yig 'bru bris pa drug tshan gcig gtad byung bar/ bdag gis lus dben ngag dben du bsdus na grangs lnga las mi thob byas pas ci zer/ shwa 'di tsho la nged rnams mkhas/ da shwa 'phong zer/ de bzhin 'phang bas sgyu lus bya ba de la babs/ de ci yang mi smra/ yang gcig bor bas zung 'jug bya ba de la babs/ khong rnams nas 'od gsal med pa'i zung 'jug bya ba 'ong don med pas rgyal kha ci la thob ces 'phya ba'i rnam pa bgyid/ chang gi btung ba zhig byin nas da song zer/ de nas rgya gar gyi yul gru phal cher nyul nas rgya bal mtshams su mdzod lnga stag rtse'i gangs ri'i rtser phyin pa na lha btsun chen po mjal/ nyams rtogs kyi maṇ+ḍal phul bas thugs mnyes tshul gnang*/ bdag gis nyid kyis dwags po bka' brgyud rnam rtog chos skur 'dod kyang rang re mi 'dod gsungs pa/ dwags po rin po ches/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// gsungs pas sems nyid kun rtog gi gnas lugs las rnam rtog chos skur bzhed snyam mi 'dug zhus pas/

khyod ngam rdzong ston pa'i bag chags des bka' brgyud pa la zhen pa che ba yin kyang sgam po ba khong rnam rtog la chos skur bzhaid pas smras pa min/ da lta gnas 'gyur rig gsum gyi ngo sprod 'debs pa 'di tsho sems las 'gro sa med/ gol ma gol gyi sa mtshams 'di shes pa gal che gsungs/ de tsam na gsal snang de yal nas sad/ da lta yang mdzod lnga stag rtse'i gnas kyi snang ba nam 'char la lha btsun chen po'i sku'i snang ba re 'char gyi 'dug dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang zhu ba'i nub dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten nang rdul tshon gyis dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bris/ thugs dkyil nus dkyil gnyis mi snang bar/ sgra gcan gyi thig le sngon po sha stag gis gang ba dang*/ zhwa lu lugs kyi dbang gi dus thugs dang bde chen nus ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bkra ba zhig rmis/ yang skabs shig na dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong min pa paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gsung gi dmigs thun re re nas dmigs brtse ma 'bum phrag re bton pa'i rjes tsam la rmi lam du yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas su phyin pas rje yab sras gsum dang*/ steng ngos na rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po dang*/ g.yon ngos su jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa mjal/ rje'i mdun nas lam rim chen mo'i lhag mthong gi thal bzlog dza ya a nan ta'i phyogs snga dang dogs pa gcod tshul rnams dris pas de rnams la dogs gcod 'ga' re gsungs/ da mkhas grub rje 'di khyod la dge ba'i bshes gnyen du lo nyer lnga'i bar g.yar po gnang chog de nas nged la phyir sprod dgos gsungs pa bdag gis brtsis pas lo drug cu rtsa grangs shig tu slebs 'dug pa de tshe tshad yin nam snyam kyang ma nges/ mkhas grub rje lha'i bu chung zhig tu gyur nas bdag la gnang byung ba rum du bcug nas 'ong ba'i lam zhor la bltas pas pu sti phra la ring ba ma ki 'dul mngon nas ya ki dus 'khor man chad kyi rnam bshad skabs lnga bcu pa bya bar gyur/

de'i rkyen gyis rje bla ma'i gsung gi gnas gang la'ang blo gros kyi 'jug pa sngar las khyad du thon pa zhig byung ba rje'i byin rlabs su yid ches thob/ de nas rim lnga'i khrid kyi brjed byang dang*/ dus 'khor gyi brjed byang*/ drang nges sngon po'i skabs kyi brjed byang*/ thal 'gyur lugs kyi tshad ma'i zin bris/ tshad ma'i ldog pa'i rnam bzhag dang gzhan yang phra mo mang zhig bris/ de rjes klong gsal ye shes rab 'bar gyi bsnyen pa tshar gnyis btang ba'i phyi ma'i skabs kaḥthog gi 'du khang du gso sbyong la phyin par de'i sbug gi klong gsal 'dra zhal de zhal 'dzum pa mdzad de dbu'i lwa thod nang gi a mi de was mig drug lan gsum gsungs/ bka' brgyad dang dgongs 'dus dus 'khor bcas la bsnyen pa rgyas pa re btang bas/ dus 'khor gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs bde chen nus ma'i dkyil 'khor steng dus kyi 'khor lo dpa' bo gcig pa'i zhal mthong zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags gsal/ dgongs 'dus kyi bsnyen pa'i skabs dgongs btsan dang sha za kha mo che gnyis nas dgongs 'dus 'chad nyan dgos pa'i zhu 'bul bgyid pa rmis/ thang rgyal snyan rgyud mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen pa'i dus rgya gar dur khrod rā me shwa rar rje grub thob chen pos rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs/ yang skabs shig rims nad lta bu'i nad drag po zhig gis btab te 'chi la nye ba byung bar rim gro 7skyabs rje si tus rdor sems kyi sbyin bsreg 'bum ther gcig gnang song ba de'i thugs rjes yin pa 'dra/ nub gcig gi snang nyams la rje grub thob chen po dngos su byon nas khyod snying rje'i chu rgyun gyis bkru/ shes rab kyi dbyug pas brdung dgos gsungs te bdag gcer bur phyungs/ ril ba spyi blugs kyi nang nas 'o chu lta bus mgo lus khyab par bkrus pas lus sems bde lhan gyis song*/ sba dbyug zhig gis stod smad kun brdung bas bde 'dzin de yang stong nyid du grol nas gang yang yid la byar med par lus/

de las sad pa na nad zug la'ang dwangs skyed cher thon 'dug 'di nub rin po che khong gi gzim lam du rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang po phebs te khyod la thang rgyal tshe dbang rgyas pa zhig gnang ba rmis pas da res bsnyung gzhi 'dis mi skyon ces gsungs/ rims nad kyis btab pa'i dus der dpal ldan lha mo'i a ru ra zhig gnang*/ chibs kyi bong bus bdag gi lus la lces ldag pa sogs rmis pas ma gcig 'di nyid dpal kaḥthog pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyis mchod rin chog pa'i lha zhig tu 'dug yang skabs shig na bud med rnga ging 'dra ba mang po byung nas nged la'ang rnga gcig gtad de thams cad rnga re la zhon nas song ba nub phyogs kyi gnas ngo mi shes pa me tog dmar po phub tsam mang pos gang zhing de'i 'od kyis nam mkha' yang dmar por bsgyur nus pa/ phyogs thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi drwa bas khebs pa'i gnas su rje grub thob chen po sku bong ri tsam mtho ba zhig gi mdun dkyil 'khor chen po mdog dbyibs dmar zlum ling tshe dgu pa can/ ling tshe rer sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba re snang ba rnams gnang*/ byang shar gyi ling tsher drag po mthu yi skor rdo rje dme log bskor ba'i 'khor lo zhes shin tu zab la 'dril ba bcas kyi dbang gdams yongs rdzogs gnang ba de dus dran kyang phyis su brjed/ yang mtshams shig tu yul gru so sor dmag 'khrugs sogs dus ngan zhig 'byung nye'i shoms la 7skyabs rje si tus ma mgon srid pa g.yul mdos gnang rgyu'i thugs bzhed kyis bdag la dam pa lha khang nas ma mgon bsnyen pa kha gso dgos zhes phebs par brten bsnyen pa la zhugs pas/ nub gcig gsal snang la dge slong gcig gis rta nag po mi ro'i sga cha can zhig bdag la gtad byung ba la zhon/ lcags kyi mda' gzhu gcig sprad pa lag tu bzung ba na bdag skad cig gis gnas gyur te/ dpal ma ning nag po dar nag gi ber dang thod pa'i phreng ba can lhu tshigs bzhi la mig gis brgyan pa/

ral pa dug sbrul gyi chun po gyen du 'phyo ba khro zhing gtum la rngams shing brjid par gyur pas srid pa gsum gyi srog gi bdag po nga yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal chen po skyes pas yul khams shig tu rgyug pa dang yul gyi smad phyogs tsam na g.yag rgod 'dra ba mang po snang bar bdag gis nga rgyal chen pos bswo sgra 'brug ltar bsgrags pas de thams cad 'brong rgod la rdzi phog pa bzhin gsar rnying gi chos skyong mang por gnas gyur nas dpa' zhum shing 'dud pa dang mnyam du dam can chos rgyal yin rgyu'i mi nag po ral gri thogs pa zhig rgol du byung bar de'i snying kar mdas bsnun pas glo snying dum bur gtor ba'i tshal bu mda' sgro la 'byar 'dug kho ling gis 'gyel nas ro ru song*/ der snying rje drag po zhig skyes pa dang chab cig bdag dge slong zhig tu gyur 'dug snying rje de la skyes na nus mthu bod khams tsam na 'gran bral zhig 'byung ba la tshegs mi 'ong snyam pa shar/ kaḥthog tu dbyar gnas pa'i skabs shig dung brda'i rkyen gyis gnyid sad nas mgo btegs pas snang bar dar rgyas chos gling du bdag gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub dang*/ nye skor du rang gi bu yin rgyu'i byis pa che chung bzhi tsam mgo nag hrug ge 'ga' re nyal/ gcig ldang ba'i snang ba mig lam la shar bas kaḥthog tu yod pa yid la ma shar ba'i gsal snang de chos dung gnyis pa rdzogs la nye ba'i bar byung*/ 'du khang du chos khrid kyi dus su rgya mthong gi logs ris rnying par bla ma mang po'i 'dra zhal yod pa'i nang sngags pa dkar chas can las 'ja' dkar po zhig 'phros nas bdag gi spyi gtsug tu zug pa slob ma 'gas mthong 'dug rjes su 'dra zhal de gang yin brtags pas/ gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub kyi 'dra zhal du 'dug pas rig 'dzin chen po 'dis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan mar rtogs/ de nas bzung sngags kyi chog khrigs/

phrin las kyi phyag bzhes/ smin lam dbang dang grol lam gdams pa'i rim pa rnams mthong ba tsam gyis blo la 'jags pa zhig byung*/ yang mtshams shig tu dgon pa'i gling skor la nged dpon slob 'ga' zhig phyin nas 'jam dpal gnas kyi khrus chus nye reg bgyis dus gnas ri dang nged gnyis 'ja' tshon phra mos 'brel ba'i nang du dhīḥyig mang po'i 'phro 'du byed pa grogs 'ga' res mthong*/ gzhan ma tshos de nyin gnas kyi brag nas 'brug cig nam mkhar 'gro ba'i mthong snang byung 'dug ces gleng rgyu snang*/ mchog sprul chos kyi glang po'i mdun karma chags med gsung gnam chos khrid chung*/ rad gling klong gsal snying thing khrid ri chos dang them skor bklag lung*/ them med nang dzam lha dang*/ lha mo ku ru ku l+le'i rjes gnang bka' rgya can sogs zhus/ rig byed ma'i bsnyen pa btang ba'i nub gcig gi gsal snang la mkhas grub karma chags med rin po ches zi ling mtsho sngon mo'i 'gram nas sog yul gyi mi dang mi min gyi gdul bya phal cher rig byed ma'i rig sngags kyis dbang du mdzad/ smar khams phyogs nas klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po rdo rje'i tha tshig la bkod pa sogs gsal bar dran/ bdag rang bzhin gyis byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rang gi yi dam yin snyam du yid lhag par dad pa dang snying rje chen po rang shugs kyis 'byung ba zhig yod/ de nas yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 7skyabs rje si tu rin po ches ljon pa lung 'dir dgon gzhis phran bu zhig btab na rje rang gi sngar rgyud sde phyag btab gnang ba'i snga rol du gzim lam la me tog pad+ma chen po zhig la de 'dra ba lngas bskor ba re re'i lte bar ral gri legs po lngas mtshan pa las 'od 'phro zhing de 'dra ba lnga phrag re 'phro ba'i ltas la brtags na rgyud sde 'di las 'phros te da dung lnga phrag lnga 'debs pa'i rten 'brel yod pas khyod rang gi dgon pa zhig btab na legs cha che tshul sogs kyi dbugs dbyung thob par brten/

ljon pa lung 'dir gsar btab gyi gtsug lag khang ka ba bzhi bcu'i khyon gyi rten brten pa dang bcas pa gegs med du grub pa 7skyabs rje rang gi byin rlabs dang thugs rje'i mthu yin par 'khums/ rmog grub phag mo'i lung byang las/ sbal sbrul gnyis kyi rdo rje rgya gram rtsod// ngag gi ming can shar gyi phyogs nas 'byung*// 'od kyi me long lag mthil tsam zhig la// ma chags kaḥthog phyogs su gnas bcas na// phrin las mdzad pa mtha' ru rgyas pa 'byung*// zhes gdan sa'i rten 'brel rab nges med kyi rgyal khams/ 'bring kaḥthog tha ma da lta'i gnas 'di yin pa las 'bring dang tha ma'i rten 'brel thog tu son/ de nas dpal yul bshad grwa'i dbu 'dzug mkhan phyin/ 'dus pa sum cu'i skor la lha las phul byung dang*/ khyad par 'phags bstod/ dkon mchog rjes dran 'grel chos rje mi pham gsung bkra shis mi zad pa'i sgra dbyangs sogs gzhung phran 'ga' dang zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug bcas kyi bshad pa byas/ de nas bzung bshad pa dar rgyas che zhing mkhas pa yang mang du byung*/ o rgyan gsang sngags gling pa'i lung byang las/ dpal yul sgrub pa'i grwa la bshad grwa rgyas// sngar med mdo chos mang po dar nas 'ong*// zhes pa'i lung bstan dus thog tu khel bar 'dug gdan sa de nyid du gnas pa'i skabs shig na chos rje dpal sprul rin po che'i zhal mjal/ spyod 'jug le'u bzhi ma'i bshad pa dang sems bskyed sdom pa bcas thob 'phros kyi gsung las/ khyed rang gcig pu zhi ba la gzhol ba las bslab grwa re tshugs na bstan pa la zhabs 'degs des che/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i snang ba 'di 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi phyag bzhes dngos gtsang re dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung la 'chad nyan re yod med kyi rjes su byed pa yin pas 'dul ba'i phyag bzhes dang 'chad nyan re ci nas gal che/ ci yang mi shes pa'i rtogs ldan yin zer ba mang po 'di tsho bstan pa snyigs pa'i rtags su byung ba yin/

grong sngags pa mang po 'di wa bu mang gis khung gcig gi sgo mi chod zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ rnying phyogs la dgon gog mang po snang yang dgon go chod pa mang po mi 'dug gsungs/ de nas gser 'phyang gi lor kaḥthog nges don dbang po'i sku phreng lnga pa phyag tsha mchog sprul rin po che nas snga phyi lan grangs zhus ngor zla yul du bskyod nas grwa lag bshad sgrub gling gi bla brang du gzhis bcags/ mgo gser sogs kyi chos zhu gtos che ba la rin chen mdzod chen mo'i dbang lung 'bul rgyu'i sna sel tshul du rdor sems sgrub mchod phyi dkyil rdul tshon dang 'brel bar sgrub chen gyi lugs zhag dgu'i khongs su grub par bgyis/ de 'phral thog mar byin rlabs sgo byed du bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i zlum po bzhi dbang dang gtor dbang*/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mdo byang chen mo zhag bdun gyis grub/ de bzhin gter mdzod dbu nas rim par dbang dang lung*/ khrid la deng sang dkar chag nang 'khod khrid rtags phog pa tsam las 'don srol med kyang*/ 7skyabs rje si tu rin po cher khrid rgyun bzhugs ring dang*/ bsnyen yig phal cher 'jam mgon rin po che dang*/ mkhan bkra shis 'od zer/ thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'od zer rnams kyi mdun nas gsan pa'i bka' srol gyi khrid du gnang ba thams cad bshad/ de ltar zla ba drug gi ring rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes phra mo la'ang las sla khyad gsod du ma song bar bshams bkod kyi yi ge dang*/ dkar chag nang 'khod bzhin dbang rnams sgrub thabs chog khrigs dang 'brel/ chog khrigs phyag bzhes dang 'brel ba yid ches pa'i gnas su bskur bas deng sang gi lag len rtsing po rnams dang gtan mi 'dra ba 'di gcig pus kyang rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher byas par sems so// de ltar dbang lung gi dbu tshugs nas mjug ma grol bar bla grwa legs thus dpon slob bdun res nyin re bzhin snga dro rdor sems bdag mdun rgyas pa skong chen lnga tshogs mchod dang bcas pa/

rjes 'brel mchod pa phud skong dang srog chags rgyus skong gnyis res mos/ smin lugs dam can spyi gtor bcas dang rtsa gsum gyi dbang lung re rdzogs mtshams su bla khag brgyad po res mos kyis tshogs 'khor re la rgya dngul rdel tshad bzhi re'i dngos rdzas 'gro nges gnang song*/ des 'gres kyis dbang lung khrid gsum mtha' rgyas gegs med du grub nas phyi mtshams bkrol zhing zhag lnga'i bar phyogs 'dus kyi khyim pa pho mo rnams la chos dbang thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa sangs rgyas stong dbang dang 'brel ba/ rad gling thugs chen stong dbang dang 'brel ba/ zhig gling thugs chen stong dbang dang 'brel ba/ zhi khro 'phrad tshad rang grol/ 'ja' tshon zhi khro bcas snga dro dbang sgrub bgyis/ dgung tshigs zin pa dang dbang bskur yang 'dus pa ha cang gtos che drag pas phyi dro dgon du nyi thal bar dbang 'grim dgos pas dka' las shin tu che yang gzhan don bsam pas kun nas bslang te brtsonapa cher brten khul bgyis/ de dus gsung mchog yi ge drug ma'i phan yon nyung bsdus re bshad pa'i rkyen gyis phar la ched du bskul ma dgos par ma ṇi dung phyur khas len mkhan bdun brgya lhag tsam re byung*/ gzhan dge sgrub sdig spong rkun rgya dang jag khrims ri rgya klung rgya/ 'bum rdzas yungs rtsa dkar po mis rko rgyu sogs/ sde shog so so nas khas len byed mkhan mang du byung*/ 'di dus sngon gyi las ngan gyis 'phangs pa'i yi dwags rnam smin rtsub mo myong ba'i mi ma yin mthu che bar brtsi ba zhig kyang snying rje chen po bka' rtags phyag rgyas rtsis la phab/ dngos dang brgyud pas sems can la phan thogs rgya cher byas/ mgo log gi sde khul nas dpon 'go bsam gnas so sos gdan zhus 'byor kyang dbyar thog der dus zing gis rten 'brel gzhan dbang du gyur/ 'di skabs dang byang dgon sogs nas zang zing gi 'dul nor rgya cher byung yang*/
