dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par thar pa rgyal bstan rin po che'i sri zhu dang*/ de'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs gzhan phan gyi rang bzhin las dkor gyi gzi byin sgrub pa sogs dam pa'i rnam thar du 'bri ba'i rigs 'di zog po'i mgo skor tsam las dgos pa med pas ma bris/ don du dngos rdzas che phra ci byung gi dge rtsa gzhan don rdzogs byang du 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas ma zin pa ni gcig kyang med/ dngos rdzas rigs kyang phal cher rten bzhengs kyi tshogs su song ba las bar ma dor chud zod ma byas/ de nas snyi stod du sgar btegs nas chos sgar btab/ snying thig la bu bzhi dang klong snying gi dbang lung btsugs/ 'dus pa mang po la sngon 'gro dang ye shes bla ma'i khrid bshad/ snyi'i na mo che 'di rdo rje phag byin gyi gnas yin pas dang po cho 'phrul kyang mang du byung*/ rjes nas bud med gzhon nu mdzes sdug can zhig tu brdzus nas zho dang rkyang sha lag pa zhig phul nas/ ci bcol gyi phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs nas song*/ de nas kaḥthog tu 7skyabs rje si tu rin po ches stong grwa 'dzugs par khel nas phran la'ang nye 'phral 'byor dgos kyi gsung shog phebs pa'i nub rmi lam du grong khyer chen po zhig stong pa'i shul na a phyi rgan mo nyam thag pa zhig mchi ma 'byin gyin 'dug khyod la ci nyes dris pas/ grong stong pa la bdag po sprod mkhan med pas lan zer/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin la rtag par re bas khyed sdug bsngal gyi khur blangs pa lags mod byas pas/ ci zer/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub la nye/ dpe cha mang po 'di yang chud zos su 'gro zer/ bltas pas pho brang chen po zhig gi lcags ri'i nang dpe cha shin tu spus gtsang ba mang po bla gab med par brtsigs snang ba grangs mi mngon pa tsam 'dug shar phyogs kyi sgo steng nas dpe zhig blangs te gtad byung bar zhal phye nas bltas pas nam mkha' glog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud ces bya ba sngar slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes gnang rgyu de yin par shes nas 'dis ji ltar bya dris pas/

'di khyod rang gis lags pas nyar tshags dam po gyis/ gzhan la gsang ma drag la spel ma drag nga 'gro dgos pa yod zer/ gang du 'gro smras pas/ yid dga' chos 'dzin du 'gro zer nas yud tsam gyis phyogs gzhan zhig tu song snyam 'phror sad/ de nas kaḥthog tu 'byor/ rin po che'i mdun phyag dang bsnyun 'dri sngon du 'gro bas dngos 'byor gyi phyag rten rnams phul/ de dus nas bsnyun tshab che tshul gyi rnam pas bzhugs/ stong grwa'i dang por thugs chen yang snying 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'dzugs gnang*/ dngos grub len dus sgrub bum thugs rje chen po yab yum dngos su mthong zhing zab mo nang gi lam dbang yid kyis blangs pas byang chub kyi sems la bogs khyad par ba thon/ de 'phral pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi las gzhung bsrangs nas sid+dhi'i bum sgrub gnang*/ rin po che bsnyun gzhi'i babs lci bas nyin shas las tshogs dbur phebs ma thub/ rjes nyin gcig bla ma gsang 'dus kyi las byang gi byin 'bebs skabs rnga ging 'dra ba'i mkha' 'gro mang pos tshogs khang gi gnam byings khyab pa tsam gyis glu gar dang zhabs bro 'khrab gyin 'dug bdag gis 'di tshor skyabs rje rin po che zhabs pad brtan min 'dri dgos snyam pa shar tsa na/ de'i khrod nas mkha' 'gro ma rin chen gsal sgron bya ba gcig gis gzhas bro 'khrab pa'i ngag rta las/ nub kha'i nyi zer shar gyi ri rtser babs// tshes gsum zla ba shar ri'i phrag par thon// bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib gdul bya'i las la rag /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'di sun ma yin yang rung*// zhes zer bas 7skyabs rje nyid yun ring por zhabs pad mi brtan par shes nas snying bton pa lta bu'i mya ngan gyis gdung*/ sgrub pa zin 'phral zhabs brtan la dmigs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i sun bzlog gur drag rgyal rdzogs/ phur pa stong bzlog bcas bsgrubs/ nyin gcig sku mdun shog gsungs nas da res nged kyi nad babs dang bstun na zhabs rim gzhan gyis phan pa 'byung dka'/

nged la rang ngos nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa cher med kyang chung nas da bar rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi lam zab mo rnams skal ba dang ldan mi ldan thams cad la khyab mnyam du spel bas zlas nyams dang zhor nyams kyi nyes pas sa lam la cung zad bsgrib kyang mi shes pas/ nyang gter khros nag gi sbyin sreg rig 'dzin srog mthud de nged kyi gnam mthongs kyi steng thos pa 'di nas blug dgos/ nged nas kyang bsnyen pa ci lcogs byed pa yin/ dbyangs rol sogs rgyas pa btang dgos/ nged rang gnyis tshe 'dir da res las sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du mnyam 'tshogs e 'ong mi shes gsungs/ dam chen gzim khang gi yang tho gnam mthongs steng nas khros nag gi sbyin sreg 'bum phrag gcig zhag shas nas grub par zhus/ de 'phral sku mdun phyin pas da legs po byung rang nas kyang las byang btang ma thub kyang sbyin sreg gi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig tshar bar bsags pas chag nyams dag pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma gsal bar rnyed/ da ni zhabs rim gyi dka' las de tsho mi dgos gsungs/ da dung zhabs pad yun du brtan thub par gsol ba btab pas shi na dga' ba su med kyang da res mi phan pa 'dra gsungs/ phebs rjes ci ltar bgyi zhus par/ nged nas kaḥthog tshang gi sprul sku 'di rnams dka' ba'i tshegs byas/ dkon pa'i rgyus nyos pa yin pas khong rnam pas thugs bsam btang los 'gro gsung zhing spyan lta stangs kyis nam mkhar gzigs nas bzhugs/ de'i phyi nangs nas re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi pho brang du gshegs so// der zhag lnga nas sku gdung rin po che tshags su gzhug pa dang*/ mchod pa bshams bkod kyi zhabs zhus bgyis/ rang sgos kyis gdung mchod phul te gsol ba btab cing dbang bzhi len pa thugs yid bsre ba sogs yid tshims nges byas/ de las gzhan 'di byed 'di gyis kyi las khur gtad mkhan su yang mi snang bas bstan pa la rgan mo sems dkar gyi dpe las gzhan ci byar ma byung*/

de'i phyir lo gling gshis byang dkar dgon du song nas rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang lung btsugs/ de skor gyi dgon pa yod rigs kyi bla sprul grwa pa sogs shin tu mang po dang rgya dmu li yan chad zla ba gsum tsam re'i mtshams nas 'ong ba yin zer ba'i rnying ma/ bka' brgyud/ sa skya sogs kyi chos lugs mi gcig pa du ma'i bla grwa dang khyim pa pho mo sogs tshogs pa stong phrag gsum bzhir thal ba la dbang khrid sbrags ma zla ba lnga'i bar bton nas gegs med par grub/ de yang rang don dkor sdud tsam min par sngar 7skyabs rje si tus rin chen gter mdzod 'di 'jam mgon rnam gnyis kyi phrin las yin/ khyed nas kyang gter mdzod tshar gsum 'don dgos gsungs pa yid la bcags te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che ci gnas kyi thabs 'ba' zhig la bsam nas lhur blangs pa yin/ de'i bdag rkyen kho nas kyang mchog sprul rin po che mi 'gyur dang lhun grub sku mchod kyis rin chen gter mdzod chen po'i dpe cha bsdu ba dang*/ tsaka li dkyil thang bzhengs mdzad nas mchog sprul rin po che mi 'gyur nas rong phyogs su gter mdzod kyi dbang lung lan gnyis tsam gnang*/ bla grwa rnams nas rtsa gsum bsnyen pa khas len bgyid mkhan chig stong drug brgya/ rtsa gsum re re nas bsnyen pa dung phyur khas len mkhan sum brgya/ phur pa dang phyag rdor bsnyen pa khas len pa brgya phrag gnyis/ tshe thar 'bum phrag gsum dang lnga stong*/ khyim pa rnams nas kyang rang 'khos dang bstun pa'i dge sgrub sdig spong ri rgya dang klung rgya/ kha ba dkar po'i gnas bskor 'gro mkhan rnams la 'phrog bcom mi byed rgyu'i khas len sogs bgyid bcug phyogs de'i rgyal ngan zhig kyang dam la bzhag de nas spung ri dang sbra khol ri sogs nas gdan zhu rim par 'byor yang dbyar kha yin pas sa smad kyi tsha ba la 'jigs nas 'gro rgyu byol te sgar yar btegs pa'i lam zhor la ya so dgon du phyin/

rje mkhyen brtse'i zhal slob mkhyen rtogs grub pa'i dbang po bla ma yon tan rin po che'i gdung rten la rab gnas bgyis/ de rjes mtsho phu dgon du 'byor/ ya so dgon pa'i sprul sku blo gros rgyal pos khur 'dzin gnang nas 'dus pa brgya phrag phyed dang gnyis la zla ba gcig gi bar klong chen snying thig gi dbang lung khrid bka' phal cher dang*/ 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang gi dbang lung yongs rdzogs bcas bgyis/ de'i ring la zhabs brtan du dmigs pa'i yig brgya 'bum phrag brgya dang bco lnga/ tshe thar mang po/ klong snying rtsa gsum bsnyen pa grangs them gyi dam bca' 'bul ba drug cu skor dang*/ smin gling rdor sems la bsnyen pa dang*/ de nyid rgyun gyi thugs dam 'dzin pa'i dam bca' dang*/ yig drug dung phyur gyi dam bca' 'bul mkhan drug cu skor byang dgon dang 'di gnyis bar la yig drug dung phyur khas len mkhan sum brgya yar brgal byung*/ zhe dgu'i lo der skyabs rje rin po ches rang la 'tshub cha yod tshul gyi bka' brtags phebs don bzhin rang mal du bcad rgya'i khul gyis zhugs nas rin chen gter mdzod du bzhugs pa'i rtsa gsum gyi bsnyen pa phal cher nyin mtshan sbrel nas btang ba las/ dang po bla sgrub thams cad kyi rgyal po bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bcas phyag bzhes bzhin btang ba'i skabs shig na rmi lam du/ lho brag la yag gu ru lha khang dang nye ba'i thang zhig na bdag gu ru chos dbang yin rgyu bar zhabs phyi sras pad+ma dbang chen khrid de skyo bsang la phyin pa'i snang bar a tsa ra ras gzan dkar po dkris shing khur rtsa chen po can zhig ma ki thang stod nas byung ba nged dang 'phrad pas gus 'dus bcas/ bdag khyed la gu ru rin po ches bka' rgya 'di skyel mkhan btang byung bas dar cig bzhugs dang zer/ der yud tsam bsdad pa dang khur rtsa de phye nas rgya lugs kyi mgo tshel 'dra ba mang po blangs te gtad byung bar/

gcig na gu ru'i rtsa tshig gi yi ge bya ba mi tshe gcig la bgyid dgos rigs kyi yi ge dang lung bstan kha shas/ de'i mjug tungs thag ring du mi 'gro ba 'di dang*/ yo byad la chags sems med par mchod sbyin gyi phyogs su gtong ba dang*/ gu ru la mos pa mi log par bya ba dang*/ tshogs bsags pa'i yul bla ma yin par shes pa dang*/ tshes bcu'i dus mchod ma chag par bya ba 'di dang lnga'o zhes pa snang*/ yang gcig na chos dbang gi skyes rabs nyer lnga gsal ba gcig snang*/ skyes rabs re re bzhin 'gro don dang phrin las gdul bya rgya che chung rnams bshad pa'i nged bcu dgu par babs 'dug phran gyi ngos skal gdul bya rgya cher mi snang*/ skyes rabs gzhan rnams 'gro don phrin las shin tu rgya cher yod pa zhig 'dug de 'phral bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i las byang tsha ba dmar thag gi steng nas sngar kaḥthog tu bsnyen pa btang zin pas/ 'dir ni las byang me tog phreng mdzes la brten bsnyen pa btang ba'i mtshams shig nas dgongs 'dus gtso dgu'i lha snang nyin mtshan med par byung zhing*/ srung ma dgongs btsan dang sha za kha mo ches kyang dgongs 'dus kyi bstan pa spel dgos par bskul ma yang byung*/ de nas rdo rje snying po'i chos bka' mi 'khrugs pa'i bsnyen pa btang bas shar phyogs thams cad sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa mdo nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin mthong*/ ston pa mi 'khrugs pa'i sku las 'od zer sngon po'i snang bas khams gsum thams cad khyab pas ngan song gi gnas phal cher sbyangs nas thams cad mi 'khrugs pa'i bkod par shar/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod kyi mdo gsungs nas de'i cho ga tshul bzhin bgyis pa lta ci/ tha na gsang sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i bye mas reg pa dang*/ gzungs sngags tsam brjod pa de'i sgra thos pa tshun chad ngan song gi skye sgo chod nas sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du skye ba'i lung bstan thob/

de nas bzung phyi nang gi srin bu mi 'byung zhing skabs su yang yang zhing dang ston pa'i snang ba 'char zhing log par ltung ba mgon med pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po shugs 'byung du skye zhing*/ bzod pa'i phar phyin la rang byan tshud par byung*/ de nas bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa dang rang shar gnyis la bsnyen pa las rung tsam btang*/ phur pa chos dbang spu gri/ sangs gling thugs kyi nying khu/ pad gling spu gri/ byang gter spu gri ste spu gri rnam gsum dang*/ rad gling yang gsang bla med/ nyang gter khros nag rje mkhyen brtse'i yang gter mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus bcas kyi bsnyen pa/ ra shag ma mo sgang shar la bsnyen pa btang ba'i skabs su 'tshub slong shin tu che zhing dngos gzugs kyi bud med mang po 'du ba dang ming nas 'bod cing sgra skad sna tshogs thos pa sogs phal cher mthong snang thun mong bar byung*/ de nas gshin rje tshe bdag gi bsnyen pa zhi drag gnyis sngar lan mang bskyar zin pas/ 'di nas gshin rje king kang dmar nag gnyis 'char ka yang bzlog rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i chog bsgrigs steng nas bsnyen pa btang ba'i mjug tu nyams kyi snang char pho brang chen po po ta lar rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang mjal/ dgyes pa'i gsung gis legs so'i dbugs dbyung dang 'ja' sa shel bam chen po gcig gi ngos ris kyi yi ge la zil gnon dgyes pa phrin las grub pa rtsal zhes pa'i tham ka gnang ba shar bas tshe 'phrang las grol ba'i rtags mtshan du nges pa thob/ de nas mtshan mo'i thun smad thams cad du'abru gsum rdo rje'i sgra gdangs kyis bzlas pa byang bar byas pas rlung thams cad dbu ma'i dbyings su 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rtags thun mong min pa rang gis myong bas nges pa 'drongs/ de skabs na chos rgyal lung bstan rdo rje'i zhal mthong*/ sgyu 'phrul gyi lam rnam bkod dang o rgyan mkhan po'i gsung*/

rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi snyan brgyud shog dril yid bzhin nor bu gnyis zung du bsdebs/ de dang mnyam du bcu dgu'i grangs ldan gyi rdor dril spus legs bcas gnang nas chos kyi bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i dbugs dbyung thob/ der brten snying thig gtum mo'i rnam bshad dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gnyis yig 'jog byas/ de nas sangs rgyas gling pa'i tshe sgrub nyi zla'i rgya can dang*/ rad gling tshe sgrub kyi bsnyen pa btang bas gnas khang nang dri bzang gis khyab pa dang gtor ma bdud rtsir zhu/ tshe bum gyi steng nas tshe dpag med pa'i zhal mthong zhing byin gyis brlabs pa byung*/ de nas bla sgrub thig le'i rgya can la bsnyen pa bskyal skabs kun mkhyen chen po'i sku'i snang ba mjal/ gsung las da res rdzogs pa chen po'i grub mtha'i gnad gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos zhig brtsams na sngar tsā+air+ya'i mchod rten gyi rdul snyed kyis sems can gyi don 'byung ba'i lung bstan dus su bab 'dug pas rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad slong ba zhig dgos zhes bkas gnang ba thos pa'i rkyen gyis/ bla ma yang tig gi gnyis ka'i yang yig gi 'grel pa nyi ma'i snang ba/ rdzogs chen ma bu'i lde'u mig kun bzang thugs kyi ṭīka thod rgal gyi snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi ti la ka rnams brtsams 'phral mtshams grol/ de nas kaḥthog bsgrigs lam gyi dbur 'ong dgos pa'i lhan rgyas kyi zhu shog 'byor ba bzhin song nas der bla ma dgongs 'dus sgrub chen tshugs/ dngos grub len chog gi dus tha mal gyi snang shes chos nyid du dengs nas rig pa rtog med du re zhig 'byams klas/ slar yang de las phyir gsal gyi snang char sngar gu ru rin po ches dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phur rje 'bangs 'dus pa phyi ma'i skor la bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang dang*/ rgyud lung man ngag lhag lus med par mnog chos su stsal dus kyi snang ba shar/

dngos grub gyi rdzas 'bul ba'i bla ma rnams kyang dgongs 'dus pod bcu gsum grangs nges kyi mkha' 'gro ma sha stag tu shar nas de dag las nang dbang len pa las gzhan ci yang ma shar bas bla ma dgongs 'dus 'di byin rlabs kyi babs khyad par can du rtogs/ 'di dus rang nyid sangs rgyas gling pa'i bla ma chos kyi blo gros yin pa'i gsal snang zhig kyang byung*/ bsgrigs grwa grol nas tshur rang gi ri khrod du 'ong ba'i ra skyes shel gyi gnas 'debs su zhag tshugs bgyis pas mtshan mor gsal snang zhig la mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bka' babs bar mar grags pa gnubs chen rin po ches rjes su bzung zhing mdo'i 'grel pa rgyal po dza'i gsung lung bstan ma dang*/ rgyud spyi mdo dgongs 'dus rdzogs chen bsam gtan mig sgron bcas bstsal ba'i snang ba shar/ der brten gnubs chen gyi bla sgrub dang de'i khrid nyung bsdus shig kyang byas/ rgyud don la'ang go ba lam tsam chags pa 'di gnubs chen gyi byin rlabs yin par shes so// zhe dgu'i tshe 'phrang la khel dus gegs 'tshub chen po zhig byung kyang*/ dpal yul pad nor rin po che dbus tshogs pa byings nas bka' 'gyur dag tshar gsum/ brgyad stong pa brgya tshar gsum/ phur bsnyen dung phyur gsum/ tshe bsnyen dung phyur gsum/ seng gdong bsnyen pa dung gcig bka' brgyad khram phyis sun bzlog dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'bum/ ma mgon g.yul mdos/ sgrol ma g.yul mdos/ ma ti'i seng gdong khri bzlog slob ma so so nas go brag spo nyag dpal yul sde khul bcas nas tshe thar khri gsum dang chig stong*/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs 'bum phrag brgya/ rad gling tshe sgrub bsnyen pa'i zhabs brtan 'bul mkhan nyi shu skor byung*/ grwa lag dgon nas phyag tsha mchog sprul rin po ches zhabs brtan du yig brgya dung phyur gcig 'gro nges kyi dung 'khor bzhengs/ tshogs pa spyi nas rgyal bka' dag tshar gsum/

phur bsnyen dung gsum/ badz+ra gu ru dang seng gdong bsnyen pa dung re re/ bsam lhun dang bar chad lam sel 'bum phrag re/ bka' brgyad khram phyis/ rtsa gsum tshogs 'bum/ slob ma khag so so nas rtsa gsum dang tshe sgrub bsnyen pa 'bul mi mang po/ zla yul stod smad kyi khyim pa so so nas tshe bsnyen dung gsum/ tshe thar stong phrag gsum/ a bswe dhi la shog nas tshe bsnyen dung phyur/ tshe thar sum brgya/ sats+tsha 'bum phrag gu ru'i sku 'bum phrag bcas kyi zhabs brtan phul/ phyag tsha mchog sprul rin po ches mgo gser gyi yul gru so sor bka' khyab gnang don tshe thar stong phrag lnga byung ba'i zhu yig dpon khag so so nas 'byor bas de dag gi bden mthus re zhig gegs 'phrang las ci bder grol ba lags so// de nas ljon pa lung gi ri khrod nas bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi nang tshan khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sku rten dang*/ gsung rten du rgyud tshar lnga rdo la brkos/ bsnyen pa bskyar skabs shig tu jo bo yab sras kyi sku'i snang ba mjal zhing gsung byon par/ thig le re re nas 'jug pa ji bzhin ma yin pas thig le bzhi 'brel du 'dzam gling dag pa'i thig le'i gzhir dbu ru sa yi thig le rgyal ba 'brom ston pa'i thugs kyi thig ler khro bo mi g.yo ba gsal ba'i thugs kar bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos sku'i nyams len gyi thig le bzhi sbrags su nyams su len dgos tshul gyi bshad pa dmar 'byin du gnang*/ de bzhin bsnyen pa btang tshul gyi yi ge zhig kyang byas/ de nas rang lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa sbrul gyi lor smar khams phyogs nas dbus mda' shel gling sras dang*/ spom mda' bu gnyis gtsos gdan 'dren snga phyir byung ba don yod pa'i phyir smar khams su sgar btegs/ thab bsu dang rta bsu rim par slebs/ sgar thog tu 'byor nas zhag shas ngal gsos/ khong lcam dral rnams bskal mang rnam dkar gyi 'bras bu dus su smin pas bskul nas rin chen gter mdzod chen mo 'dzugs dgos tshul nan tan phebs pas thugs bzhed skong phyir sgar rang du gzhung sa chen po'i dmag byings che stabs kyis gu dog pas sgrub chen lugs rgyal chen tho 'dzug sogs ma bde bas/

gsang phu'i klu ra'i 'du khang du gnas spos te klong chen snying thig dbang lung dang mtshams khrid rgyas pa bcas phul/ khong rnams nas dbang lung phyi ma gsan pa'i zhor la sngon 'gro'i sbyangs pa rnams ci thon gnang*/ de nas snying thig ma bu'i dbang lung*/ kun mkhyen mdzod bdun gsung 'thor bu bcas kyi lung*/ sems nyid ngal bso'i gtsos ngal gso skor gsum khrid de'i khongs su dngos gzhi'i khrid dang*/ ye shes bla ma bcas kyi khrid rdzogs nas gter mdzod kyi dbang gi sta gon sna sel tshul du rgyal bka' dag tshar/ brgyad stong ci mang dang snga phyir yig brgya 'bum phrag brgya lhag tsam bsgrubs/ de 'phral phyogs dus kyi gter mdzod dbang lung zhu mkhan rnams 'tshogs nas rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub chen gyi dbu btsugs/ rgyal chen tho 'dzugs nang du tshogs pa thams cad tshud par byas shing dam sri mnan pa sgo byang phyi nang sogs sngon 'gro'i chos rnams legs par grub pa na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten/ sgrub 'bum gyis gtsos rgyan dang yo byad 'god pa sngon du 'gro bas sgrub gzhung zhag bdun gyi khongs su grub par bgyis/ de nas nang sgrub dbang dang 'brel ba bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang dang rdor sems dbang sbrel te bskur/ gtso bo rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor la rdul tshon dang*/ gzhan rnams ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor brten nas dbang khrid rnams brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin zhib cha bgyis te phul/ lung rnams sprul sku 'gyur med rdo rjes gnang nas zla ba lnga'i khongs su grub par bgyis/ 'di dag gi dus sgrub chen dbu 'dzug nyin 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub pa dang sa g.yo ba sogs byung*/ gter mdzod dbang snga phyi gsum ka la sa g.yo ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung*/ skabs shig na ngal bso'i chos mtshams 'jog skabs tshogs gtor rgyas pa btang*/

dngos rol sde dgu rjes 'brang bcas kyi gsol ka mthar chags su btang ba'i mchod gtor bsang nang du btegs dus/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis mthong snang thun mong du nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 'ja' tshon zlum po'i gur phan tshun du 'brel zhing de dag las sa gzhi la zug pa'i 'ja' tshon rgyal po btsun mo'i rna cha 'dra ba dang 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas kyi dbyibs can du ma dang*/ steng gi 'ja' gur na sprin mi rta'i gzugs can phan tshun du rgyug pa'i rnam pa sogs snang zhes thams cad la gleng rgyu byung*/ de'i rkyen gyis de phyogs skye bo phal cher ngo mtshar du brtsi bas dbang gi 'du ba'ang shin tu rgyas/ gzhan yang gtor ma la spra lo 'dra ba'i me tog skyes pa dang*/ mar me chung ngus nyin mtshan 'khyongs pa/ bdud rtsi khol ba sogs mang du byung*/ dbang lung gi sum cha tsam rdzogs pa'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu'i nub nyams kyi snang char/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs nas mkha' 'gro ma pad+ma myu gu bde ba rtsal na bza' dang sku nyams zhen se ba zhig byung*/ de ltar phebs pa ci lags smras pas/ nyid dpon slob kyi gter mdzod tshogs bskang rgya chung bas lan/ khyed la a mas da lam 'phrad dgos pa'i cha skyel ba la btang ba yin zer ba'i mur ma rgan dang 'phrad 'dod zhig kyang skyes/ nged kyi a ma gang du yod byas pas sa thag ring zhig na yod zer/ 'di dus rkang 'bam phyir ldang gis 'gros mi 'pher bas rmi lam skabs kyang de'i bag chags kyis 'gro dgos tshe ci byed snyam pa dran tsa na/ rkang 'gros mi dgos 'di bzhin phebs chog zer/ khong bya rgod zhig tu gyur te 'phur ba dang*/ bdag kyang de 'dra bar gyur 'phral nam mkha' nas song song bas lho mon kyi yul dang rgya gar rnams bcad/ rgya gar dang nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul gnyis kyi mtshams ri sgang 'jam po thig shing ltar drang ba zhig gi rtser babs/

de yang nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul ni rgya che la mtha' mi mngon pa zhig gi dbus rgyal khab kyi pho brang 'dra ba brtsegs thog mang po yod pa/ rtse na gyo 'beb dang*/ rgyal mtshan ba dan dang gdugs kyi rnam pa mang pos brgyan pa mthong bas/ ma ki rgyal khab chen po de rgyal po su'i pho brang dang grong lags zhus pas/ 'di nub phyogs o rgyan gyi rgyal khab mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i pho brang bya ba yin zer/ 'o na khyod kyis bdag mgo bskor ba min nam/ nged kyis da dung dbang khrid phal cher rdzogs ma zin/ las dang skal bar ldan pa 'ga' re la rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid kyi bya ba rnams 'phro lus nas yod pas re zhig nga mi 'gro byas pas/ khong gis sems shin tu 'phreng tshul mdzad/ 'o na da lam phebs rgyu thugs bzhed med na chog phyis yun mi 'gor bar 'dir phebs dgos zhes bya rgod zhig tu gyur nas rtsal ci yod kyis pho brang chen po der gtad nas phebs song*/ 'phral nyams snang de sad/ phyi nyin tshogs dang bskang ba gzab rgyas shig byas/ dbang lung gi skabs de dag tu dngos 'byor gzab rgyas yin khul gyis tshogs rgyas pa re btang yang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mnyes par dka'/ dngos 'byor dang yid sprul zhes pa'i khungs drangs nas zan ril chung ngu zhig la 'don rgyu'i grangs stong phrag khri phrag sogs btang bas ci yang mi 'ong ba 'dra/ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du// yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags// zhes pa ltar tshogs gsog pa las phyir zhing nyams pa'i rgyur 'gro ste/ nyang rin po ches/ yas nyung ngu la mgron mang po 'bod pa mi mnyes pa'i rgyu yin gsungs pa dang phyogs 'dra/ des na ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa tsam khungs su ma 'dren par dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa gzab spros dgos par 'dug snyam shar/ de nas dbang lung gi mjug rdzogs nas gtang rag tshogs mchod gzab rgyas dang*/

dngos 'bul yang rin po che'i rigs mang po/ bzang gos/ ja sig rta drel/ shing 'bras sna tshogs sogs stong 'bul tshan mang po'i bdag rkyen gnang*/ de 'phral la 'og phyag mdzod nas gdan 'dren byung bas der phyin/ thab bsu dang dar btang mang du 'byor/ btsan chen khro 'bar gyi pho brang brag ri dmar hang nge mthong sa nas bsang btang dus lus sbrid chil gyis byung ba'i rkyen gyis sems gzung 'dzin g.yo byed dang bral ba'i ngang du ha phyad de re zhig lus/ de'i rjes kyi snang char ma ki khro 'bar gyi pho brang phyogs nas btsan gyi rigs bswe khrab dang bswe rmog ru dar dang bzhon pa dmar po can mang po bsu ba la byung bas gsol ja drangs pa 'thung rgyu lus nas ltad mo la yengs song bas/ la 'og dpon mgon po sku drung na 'khod pas rin po che sku ltem pa min nam zer/ min byas pas 'o na gzigs snang zhig byung ba lags sam zer/ ngas gang yang ma byung byas/ der khong gi gzhis kar slebs/ chos zhu brgya skor tsam la gsol phog dang mthun sbyor phun sum tshogs pa gnang*/ khong la snying thig ma bu dang*/ mdzod chen bdun/ byang gter gyi dbang lung kha shas dgos gsungs par/ khong gi thugs bzhed bzhin dbang lung rnams rim bzhin phul skabs/ nub gcig o rgyan gyi yul du 'gro 'dod pa'i rkyen gyis sgyu lus bzung nas u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du song bas mkha' 'gro'i rigs ma nges pa sna tshogs bsu ba la byung bar/ gling bu dang gzhas bro'i ngag 'dres pa'i rta las rig 'dzin gdung glu zhes/ las+yai shāg rig 'dzin las+yai shāg las+yai shāg pad+ma las 'brel rtsal las+yai shāg ces pa mtshams su bcug pa'i glu tshig la*/ bsam yas mchims phu'i dge gong der// pad+ma thod phreng zhabs drung du// smon lam gcig tu mthun pa'i bu// sngon gyi go cha g.yel lam ci// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi 'du ba la// sngar nas mi phebs 'gor yun ring*// nged cag sems 'phreng skyo grogs zhu// zhes bsus/

o rgyan gyi yul de ni khang pa'i dbyibs nas 'bru 'dra ba la sa gzhi la ma reg pa steng g.yogs med pa 'od lnga'i mtha' lcags rked pa nub tsam gyis bskor ba/ rigs lnga rigs kyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa ang ras dang dar dpyangs re gsol ba dpa' bo'i rigs gtso bo la dpa' mo'i 'khor gyi tshom bu can/ dpa' mo'i rigs gtso mo la dpa' bo'i rigs kyi tshom bu can/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rigs 'dres pa mang pos gang ba/ mtha' 'di zhes mi mngon zhing*/ glu bro gzhas sogs rtsed mo dang gar sna tshogs pa 'khrab kyin sha chang dang shing 'bras sna tshogs la longs spyod pa sha stag tu snang*/ der dbus kyi pho brang mchod rten gyi rnam pa can seng khri'i thad na sgo bzhi 'dug shar gyi sgo drung du dkar mo zhi byed ma rdzing bur khrus byed pa'i zhal nas/ sgo 'di tshogs lam pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo yin pas khyod la mi dgos zer/ khyod ci byed pa yin dris pas/ bdag tshogs lam pa yin pas rgyud kyi sdig pa khrus kyis sbyong ba yin gsungs/ lho sgo na ser mo rgyas byed ma rdo'i gtun chen po zhig tu 'bras mang po brdung nas 'dug pa la ci lags dris par sgo 'di sbyor lam pas bgrod pa'i sgo yin pas khyod 'gro mi dgos/ nga sbyor lam pa yin pas ldan rtog gi spu ris gcod pa yin gsungs/ nub kyi sgo drung der rdo gcal chen po zhig gi dbus na pad+ma'i gdan khru 'phang phyed gnyis yod pa der slebs pa dang mnyam du nub sgo nas dmar mo dbang phyed pad+ma myu gu bde ba rtsal rin po che dang dar gyi 'phyang 'phrul sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ g.yas na me tog gur gum gyi chun po dang g.yon na chang gis bkang ba'i shel bum zhig bsnams nas bsu ba la phebs pa'i zhal nas/ tshogs sbyor las 'das pad+ma'i steng*// byang chub yan lag me tog spos// yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i chang*// gsol la mi slob lam 'dir shog

/gsungs nas pad+ma'i stegs la bkod de chang bum de gnang byung ba lhag med du btung*/ da nged byang sgo nas 'ong ngam dris pas de mi dgos 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi chang gsol zin pa des go chod/ sgo 'di dga' ba chen po dbang gi sgo yin pas 'di kar 'jug pa rten 'brel che/ nged pad+ma'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rigs bdag kyang khyod yinapa mi dgongs pa zer nas yud tsam gyis khong nub sgo rin po che dang dar gyi drwa bas brgyan pa'i gseng nas yar thon song*/ bdag kyang de'i phyi bzhin nang du zhugs pas rin po che'i gzhal yas khang nor bu dang pad+ma dmar po spel mas mdzes pa/ khyams dang nang gru chad gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng na sku gsung thugs kyi pad+ma dkar dmar mthing ka 'dab ma brgyad kyis rim par brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i lte bar chos 'byung rtsa ba phra la 'phel kha che ba gyen du bstan pa'i steng rigs lnga dang yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams bzhugs pa'i dbus kyi gtso mo'i mdun pad+ma'i steng la stag lpags kyis bkab pa'i steng du 'khod de gsol ba btab pa/ oṃ/ sngon gyi thugs dam chen po ni// rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba// 'chi ba chos kyi skur sbyor zhing*// bar do longs spyod rdzogs par bzhengs// skye ba sprul pa'i skur dag pa'i// dbang bskur chen po bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas shar gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas gri gug gis thod pa'i bdud rtsi blangs te/ oṃ/ stong gsal bum pa'i gzhal yas su// snang srid mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor shar// rang bzhin ma grub stong pa nyid// bde chen ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid// bde stong lha sku'i phyag rgyar rdzogs// ye nas rang dang gnyis su med// rang dang phra ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// 'khrul dang log par rtog pa sbyangs// mar sna phra mo'i thig le nyid// yungs kar bcu gshag tshad nyid las// bde chen ye shes skye bar 'gyur// kā la sha/

zhes sogs gsungs nas bdud rtsi 'thor zhing dbang bskur/ de bzhin las kyi mkha' 'gro mas/ āḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gnas las byung ba yi ge gsum// dkar dmar rlung sems dbyer mi phyed// 'gro 'ong rdo rje'i gdangs su bsam// zhugs gnas thim pa'i rim pa yis// gang gis dbye bar dka' ba yi// rtsa yi mdud pa gsum gnyis drug /phyi dang nang gi nye rgyu las// blang dang dor bas 'og gi kha// phyes pas 'od gsal 'char bar 'gyur// sgyu ma ma bcos rang la rdzogs// zhes gsungs/ de bzhin nub kyi mkha' 'gro mas/ hrīḥ lus dang ngag dang sems gsum po// ma dag bden 'dzin las dben pa// rigs lnga rigs kyi dbye ba yi// mkha' 'gro sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor yin// thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor bas// rlung lnga bsdus pa'i rten 'brel las// rtog pa ji snyed 'gags pa dang*// ye shes de nyid 'phel bar 'gyur// snang ba gsum gyi 'od gsal dang*// 'grogs pa kha dog lnga yi rlung*// ye shes mkha' 'gro nyid du shar// skye ba brgyud la mi ltos par// tshe 'dir 'bras bu thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de bzhin lho yi mkha' 'gro mas/ trām̐/ phyag rgya srog rtsol 'gro ba'i thabs// spros bcas dang ni spros pa med// rjes su gzhig dang ril 'dzin gyis// dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum gyis// lhan skyes ye shes 'char bar 'gyur// de yi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung*// nang gi bdag nyid g.yo med pa// lugs ldog nyid du nyer thob na// mkha' 'gro sdom pa ma lus pa// rten dang brten par bcas pa nyid// spyi bo 'am ni snying ga ru// stong gzugs rang ngor snang ba dang*// 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de nas dbus kyi gtso mos/ oṃ/ snga ma dag gi lam nyid ni// dri ma gnyis po ma spangs pas// rgyal ba'i thugs dang gzugs kyi skur// ji bzhin smin par nus min pas// zag med lam gyi dang po 'dir// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pas// don gyi 'od gsal mi rtog pa// stong pa nyid la mngon sum du// gnyis blo'i rgyu ba rab 'gags pa// 'phags pa'i ye shes de nyid kyis// sgrib gnyis nus pa cher bcom pas// mi slob sa la 'di yis reg

/des na spyod pa rnam pa gsum// lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo// dgugs dang sbyor ba'i spyod pa las// phyi dang nang gi mngon byang bzhis// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni// mchog gi ye shes skye bar 'gyur// des ni ma rig nyon mongs bcom// de ltar mnyam par bzhag pas na/ lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /rjes las byung ba'i sgyu ma'i lus// slar yang 'od gsal stong nyid du// mnyam par bzhag pa lan gcig gis// snang dang rang bzhin stong pa gnyis// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa nyid// slar zhing gang la'ang mi slob bo// zhes gsungs nas phyag gis se gol gyi brda byas pa'i rkyen gyis rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams gtso mo la thim/ gtso mo yang 'od kyi thig le mthing gar zhu nas dbus kyi gdan du 'khod pa las rang sgrar shar ba/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid// ma skyes pas na 'gags pa med// rnam grol ye shes rgya mtsho'i klong*// de bzhin nyid du rnam par dag /zhes thig le de nyid g.yu yi me long che chung mtheb skor tsam la skye ba med pa'i yi ge āḥyig dkar pos mtshan pa zhig tu gyur pa'i rang sgra las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis// mtshon pas chos rnams sgyu mar rtogs// yongs la khyab pa'i byang chub sems// thugs rje chen po cir yang 'char// zhes grags pa dang mnyam du yi ge yang a ha ri ni sa zhes pa'i rang sgra 'ur gyis byung ba dang chabs cig ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos// rten 'brel rang bzhin 'gags pa med// mkha' 'gro sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// cir yang 'char zhing 'byung ba'o// zhes grags pa'i rkyen gyis dbus dang phyogs kyi pad+ma'i lte bar rigs rang rang gi mdog can gyi chos 'byung rnams kyi lte bar dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum sum brgya drug cu/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu drug

nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum drug cu rtsa bzhi/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du thugs kyi pad+ma brgyad la sul+li ra ma la ya sogs brgyad na/ dpa' bo khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang*/ rnal 'byor gtum mo gnyis sogs thugs kyi rnal 'byor ma yab yum/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi gnas brgyad kyi pad+mar ka ma ru sogs kyi gnas su/ yab dpa' bo aṃ gu ra dang yum e ra wa gnyis sogs gsung gi rnal 'byor ma brgyad/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad ma pre ta pu ri la sogs pa brgyad na yab dpa' bo stobs chen 'khor lo dang yum shugs 'chang ma gnyis sogs sku'i rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs so// gru chad dang glo 'bur du gau ri ma mo brgyad dang*/ khyams su seng ha brgyad dbang phyug nyer brgyad/ gzhan yang sngo nag ser nag chen mo la sogs pa'i 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro dang*/ sgo bzhir rigs bzhi'i ging chen bcas bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba la 'dod rnam gyi lha mo rnams phyag bde'i tshul gyis yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs sgra sogs dang phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pas mnyes par mdzad do// reg bya'i lha mo dbyings phyug mas/ bcu drug dga' ba nam mkha'i chang*// dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod par rol// myos shing gnyid log 'od gsal thim// zhes pa'i rkyen gyis de'i tshe bdag gi sems gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa lugs 'byung gi snang mched thob par rim gyis bsdus te 'od gsal ba'i dbyings su thim pas yul chos kyi dbyings stong nyid dang ro gcig tu 'dres nas rlung sems kyi rgyu ba mtha' dag 'gags pa'i ngang yun ring du gnas nas slar yang rlung lang bar rtsom pa na lugs ldog gi nyer thob kyi rjes su snang ba gsum gyi 'od gsal gyis rgyu byas/ de'i bzhon pa rlung 'od zer lnga pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi snying khar mkha' 'gro sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa snang la 'dzin pa med pa/

stong la ngos bzung bral ba gsal zhing sgyu ma lta bur shar zhing de nas je rags su mched de shes pa yul la sad pa dang lhan cig rang mal du gnyid sad 'dug go /yang nam zhig na o rgyan gyi gnas der 'gro 'dod pa nyin shas byung ba'i rkyen gyis nyams kyi snang char o rgyan yul gyi skyed mo'i tshal shing ljon pa dang*/ sman shing dang bza' shing gi ra ba me tog sna tshogs pas brgyan pa zhig tu slebs/ de na pad+ma myu gu bde ba rtsal la sogs pa pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mang po brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa skyong ba zhig mjal ba dang*/ de dag rnams mnyes tshul gyis bdag la me tog dmar po'i phreng ba re phul/ 'dod yon gyi mchod pa sna tshogs bstabs te/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i dam tshig dgongs// 'dir bzhugs tshogs kyi spyod pa skyongs// thugs la 'thad dam rigs kyi bdag /zhes zer ba la gtso mo des/ da res bzhugs pa mi drag gis// byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa ni// gzhan la phan pa nyid yin pas// gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong bar zhu// zhes yun ring du zhabs pad brtan pa'i rdzas yin zhes chang dang shing tog gi rigs mang po phul/ 'gol 'gol 'dra ba'i gtam mang po dang*/ rjes su 'bam mtsho mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du phebs dang gros bstun legs par 'ong gsungs 'phror nyams de sad/ der la 'og nas btegs/ drung yig phyag mdzod gzhis kar song*/ zhag shas su khong gi zhabs rim dang 'dod chos rnams phul/ khang steng du khro 'bar gyi rten 'dzug dgos pa de yang bgyis/ de skabs grwa pa zhig la 'phral du sku phebs pa dang*/ de nub nas bzung khang steng du mi ma yin 'du ba'i rtags dang tshig 'bru mi gsal ba'i sgra sna tshogs thos pa sogs zhag brgyud mar byung bas ngo mtshar bar brtsi/ de dus sring mo stag lcam dmar mos mjal dar btang ba dang khams bde zhu ru byung*/ de rjes ru bzhi pa sku ngo skal bzang gi gzim shag tu phyin/

zhag shas su tshe dbang sogs zhabs rim dgos rigs rnams phul te spom mda'i gzhis su sgar btegs/ der re zhig ngal bsos/ slar dpal sprul rin po che'i gsung 'bum lung dang*/ khrid cha shas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel bshad bcas bton/ gzhis ka'i mgon khang gi gtso bo rdo rje grags ldan gyis sngar gter mdzod dbang dus zhal ras gser gyis byil byugs mdzad de bdag gis 'di bzhin sgrubs dang bzhin legs zer/ dbang cha shas kyang zhus snang byung*/ 'di dus kyang sher phyin bshad pa la thugs mnyes mnyes gnang nas zhus song*/ de yin pa'ang srid de gter mdzod kyi dbang gi dbu tshugs nas bzung de dpon slob la bar chad ci yang ma byung ba chos skyong chen po'i phrin las su shes/ de nas lha mdun rnam snang mjal du song*/ stong mchod rgyas pa zhig phul/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga klu dbang dgongs rgyan la brten nas gzungs sngags bsags pa sogs gtso bor ma byas par sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bstod pa bcom ldan 'das rnam snang nyid kyis gsung pa'i rgyu mtshan yid la bcags/ bstan 'gro'i phan bde la dmigs te sgrol ma stong rtsa bsags/ de dus zhal 'debs mang bas mar me dang zhal zas rnams snod dang lag tshags kyis sgrol dka' ba tsam byung*/ mar khu lhag pos rdo dang khro zangs kyi kong bu mang po bkangs te phul/ rnam snang gtso 'khor 'di rnams kong jos gter nas drangs pa dang rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa'i gtam sgros gnyis snang yang rang byung gi rdo las grub pa'i rnam snang thog tshad/ nye sras mi tshad lhag chos rgyal/ sgo srung khro bo dang bcas pa 'dug gsang ba'i bdag po zhi ba'i zhal ras la dbu skra dang smin ma sogs khro bo'i rnam par bcos pa'i zhal ras zhi khro sna tshogs su 'gyur ba dang dbu skra smin ma 'bar ba'i me ri 'khyil ba las me stag gi zi ra khol ba/ spyan 'gyur ba zhal 'dzum pa sogs nyin de'i ring la mjal bas lhag pa'i lha de'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan mar nges pa rnyed/

de nas 'bam mtsho khar phyin/ mtsho de ni rdo rje phag mo'i sku dbyibs mtsho de'i dbus su phag mo'i nu 'bur mtshon byed ri de'u gnyis kyang snang ba'i phrag pa g.yon ngos phyogs zhal dang nye bar mtsho dar dang dam rdzas phur ma rin chen ril bu rdog gsum gser dngul dang rin chen rigs grangs mang bcas phul/ sku'i sta zur g.yon phyogs su sgar babs/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i rkyen gyis char drag zhig kyang babs byung*/ de dwangs 'phral de'u che chung gnyis kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'ja' yis khyab par sbrel/ der zhag gsum tshogs mchod phul/ sang nyin sgar btegs pa'i nub ri gnyis nang bud med skad legs po can mang pos gzhas bro brdung ba yang thos/ de phyogs rgyas 'brog pa rnams kyis zhag gsum bar gzim gur dang gnas mtsho gnyis 'ja' tshon gyis 'brel bar mthong zhes gtam bshad rgyu snang*/ gang ltar yang gnas de'i byin rlabs kyis lus khams 'khrugs te yun ring song ba'ang de nas bzung gzhi med du dwangs song*/ de rjes spom mdar phyin/ zham rim ci dgos dang*/ dpal chen mo'i g.yang sgrub g.yang gta' sdom pa bcas grub/ dngos 'byor gya nom pa dang nor sna khyad 'phags shin tu mang bas bsnyen bkur gnang*/ de nas slar yang smar khams sgar du thegs/ gzhung sa'i dmag sgar spyi la tshe dbang dang rlung rta dpal bskyed/ dgra bla dpang bstod/ go khrab rab gnas bcas byas/ dbus mda' shel sras kyi rten gsum gsar bzhengs dang*/ grong dang gnas rten bcas la rab gnas dge legs 'dod 'jo dngos sta nyin gsum gyi khongs su grub par zhus/ dngos 'bul nor sna mang po'i maṇ+ḍal gnang*/ de ga'i phyogs kyi sa dge'i dgon khag yod rigs la dngul 'gyed dang*/ mang ja'i dod 'bul gyis bsnyen bkur zhus te sgar btegs/ sku ngos rags bsdus kyis zhag tshug gcig bar skyel ma bcas chung 'bum pa tshugs su phyin/

de phyogs yas man du sngar lo mang por lo nyes byung skad kyang de lor phyogs mtha' dag dang*/ khyad par chung 'bum dngasgar thog phyi nang du me tog phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rta gzan gyi sog btab pa rnams la'ang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa byung bas ngo mtshar bar brtsi zhing*/ zhag tshugs kyi grong pa rnams nas kyang 'khos 'byor la dpag pa'i bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa bgyid cing*/ phyin chad kyang ston legs pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu ba mang du byung*/ slad nas kyang lo gsum la ston thog shin tu legs po byung zhes pa'i gtam thos/ de nas 'bru gu mdo'i sa tshugs brgyud/ rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'dul rdo rje dang*/ gter ston stag sham pa'i mtsho rgyal bka' thang du gu ru'i sku gsung thugs gsum dbyer med kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stag tshang gsum las thugs kyi gnas mdo khams tsam na 'gran bral du grags pa gtsang gshis rdo rje gro lod du gnas 'brel la phyin cing gnas mgo dgon du gzhis phabs/ rang nyid kyis sbyin bdag zhus nas/ dgon thog der bzhugs dang yas man nas phebs pa'i bla grwa brgya skor lhag bcas kyis/ bka' brgyad las byang bde chen rnam rol steng nas sgrub khog dang 'brel ba'i bdud rtsi sman sgrub gsang chen myur lam gyi sbyor dngos rjes kyi bya ba rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin nyin bcu gsum gyi bar btsugs/ mjug tu sgrub dbang dang 'brel bar chos dang dam rdzas kyi 'brel ba rgya chen po btags/ tshogs pa rnams la dngul srang bzhi re dang*/ bla sprul rnams la babs 'brel gyis dngul srang sum cu/ nyer lnga/ nyi shu/ bco lnga/ bcu yan chad kyi 'bul ba yang mtshon tsam phul/ sgrub chen thog mtha' snga phyi'i 'gro song rgya gor rkyang pa la rtsis gshar gyis stong dngul gsum lhag song ba'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos shing bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs kyang zhus/

gnas rten gyi gtso bo gro lod rang byon du phebs pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon du bdud 'dul dang stag sham pa gnyis kyi phyag bzo'i sder sku so so'i rab gnas can dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa gsum dang gro lod 'dra zhal sogs bzhugs pa'i gnas phug tu sang nyin 'gro rgyu'i dgong mor phug pa'i nang du 'od 'bar zhing mchod stegs g.yo ba sogs dang*/ de'i nyin shas sngon la sngar mthong ma myong ba'i bya cha shas 'ong nas gnas rtsar zhag gcig bsdad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung zhes dkon gnyer la bshad rgyu 'dug phyi nyin gnas phug tu song nas tshogs 'bum zhig btang rtsis kyis rtsam pa zhib dkar dos po bzhi bcu/ gro rtsam dos po brgyad/ mar dos bdun/ chur dos gsum/ shing 'bras sna tshogs dos lnga/ sha bub gsum bcas bsags/ bdud 'dul gter byon gro lod la brten pa'i tshogs ci mang dang*/ bsang gsur sogs mgron bzhi dgyes pa'i thabs la 'bad/ 'di dus rgyal sras rin po che'i yang srid khri 'don la 'ong dgos kyi phyag bris bang mi brgyud mar 'byor bas 'don rgyu'i grangs 'bum phrag ma song yang*/ 'bul rgyu'i dngos po tshogs 'bum cha shas kyi dngos rdzas longs pa phul/ tshogs 'bum phul ba la tshogs rdzas rgyas pa de 'dra sngar ma byung zhes dkon gnyer ha las mdog byed 'dug rgyun bzhag tshe 'bar gyi rten thebs zhig kyang phul/ de dus dang po las byang gi spyan 'dren dus gro lod rang byon sku 'gul ba dang*/ me stag gi zi ra khol ba'i rkyen gyis rig pa chos nyid kyi gshis su rgya 'byams pa nyin gcig gi ring byung ba lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags su shes/ gnas kyi nyams gso dang gnas chen byin 'bebs byas pas de khul gyi yul phyogs su dge zhing bkra shis pa 'byung bar go de nas rgyal sras dgon du phyin nas ri khrod du gzhis bcag hor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis rgyal ba lha babs kyi dus chen gza' skar 'phrod sbyor legs pa'i snga dro'i char rig 'dzin klong gsal gyi gter byon pad+ma 'od 'bar dang tshe sgrub yang gsang bla med zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bdag mdun rgyas pa dang*/

khyad par sprul sku rin po che khrir phebs/ bgegs dang byur bsal mi shes pa sbyangs ba khrus gsol bcas sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag rgyal dbang pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi skur bskyed spyan drangs/ dam ye dbyer med du bstim pa la mchod pa phyi nang dang*/ rab gnas mnga' gsol maṇ+ḍal 'go bar btang*/ der maṇ+ḍal rnam bshad snyan 'jebs phun sum tshogs pa'i legs bshad kyis thog drangs/ kaḥthog gi gtsos dgon khag so so'i dga' ston dngos 'bul dang sbrags 'bul yig klog grub 'phral/ mtha' brten bkra shis tshe yi dbang bskur dang bcas pa grub par bgyis/ de nas sa skya ba go na khri chen sprul sku dpon 'khor dang gzhan phyogs 'dus kyi bla grwa mang du 'byor ba la bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang chen dang*/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang chen/ kar gling zhi khro'i dbang*/ bdud phur 'od 'bar/ klong gsal seng ha dmar mo/ zhi khro/ thugs rje chen po sogs dang snying thig ma bu'i dbang lung rnams phul/ de rjes go na dgon du gdan zhus par bskyod/ dbang chos kyi 'brel ba dang 'du khang sogs la rab gnas nyin gnyis su phul/ 'dir yas man dgon sde so sos bkur bzos dang dngos 'bul kyang rgya cher 'byor/ slar yang rgyal sras dgon du 'ong nas dgon yul thun mong la dbang chos kyi 'brel ba btags/ spyi sger gyi 'bul ba spam mtho gnang*/ de nas gser lding dgon du phyin/ dgon yul thun mong la dbang chos dang*/ gser lding rin po che'i gzim khang du yang srid la dmigs pa'i gu ru drag po'i tshogs mchod phul zhing yang srid brtags bsgril yang 'phangs/ de nyin dgun kha yin kyang yul mi'i mthong snang la dbyar gyi 'ja' tshon lta bus dgon gyi phyogs thams cad khyab par bshad rgyu 'dug yang srid kyi brtags pa gling gshis gter ston karma'i gdung sras dpal ldan rgya mtsho'i sras chung zhig yod pa la babs kyang rten 'brel gzhan dbang du gyur pas yang srid de sku tshe yun ring du ma brtan par thos/

de nas btegs te dmar yon dpon tshang nas gdan zhus kyi bsu ma dang dgon pa'i skyel ma mang po bcas 'grogs te 'ong ba'i lam khar sman chu kha zer ba sngon rgya bza' kong jo'i dbu skra bkrus pa'i chu 'thor shul shing shug pa'i sdong po dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi rten yin par grags pa de dang nye bar slebs pa na sman spos kyi dri bzang po zhig 'thul ba'i rkyen gyis lus sems bde ba'i ting 'dzin gyis khyab pas rig pa chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du 'byams klas nas re zhig gi dus phyir gsal gyi snang char/ mdun gyi nam mkhar lha gcig kong jo rgya yi bu mo'i cha byad can dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ sku dkyus phra la ring ba/ skabs su cir yang 'gyur ba/ phyag gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar dmar ba zung gis dpe cha bam po gcig bsnams nas sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud kyi dbu nas gleng gzhi dang mthun pa'i bkod pa rnam par 'phrul nas dbang dang rgyud bshad bcas gnang ba'i snang cha de ri pad+ma can gyi gnas 'dabs bar shar zhing*/ lha gcig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'ang thob/ de nas dmar dpon gyi gzhis su phyin/ khong gi thugs bzhed bzhin smin grol gyi chos bka' 'ga' re byas nas sgar btegs te lha thog tu ba'i nang 'byor/ mtshams chu mig dkar mo dang rang byon gyis yi ge drug ma mjal/ klu rgyal mi mgon dkar pos rdza lung dkar mo na rang la dbang ba'i nor skal zhig 'bul rgyu yod skad kyang dgos pa chung bas btang snyoms su bzhag de nas go 'jo'i sde khul du 'byor/ yas man gyi dgon khag dang*/ dpon sde so so nas gdan zhus byung yang dgun grang ngar rgyas pa dang*/ kha ba chen po bab rkyen gyis mdo drug stod smad/ pā la sde khul tsam la 'bru bsod byas pas 'bru dos brgya dang drug cu tsam 'dus song ba kaḥthog thub chen gsar bzhengs kyi zhal 'debs su phul/ lam zhor go 'jo dpon khag bdun tsam dang dgon khag brgyad dgu zhig la khyug tsam re phyin/

brag g.yab phyogs nas la phag dgon/ lha srung kho ra bdud ri rnams nas gdan 'dren byung kyang 'gro rgyu byol/ de nas gzhung lam rim brgyud kyis bsam 'grub dpon sar 'byor te zhag shas su ngal bsos/ de ga'i sde dpon spyi sger gyis zhabs rim rnams bgyis/ nyag bla byang chub rdo rje'i sgar du yang khyug tsam phyin/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs drug cu rtsa bzhi bsgrubs/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi 'bul ba gnang*/ smar khams nas 'di bar snga phyir rab byung sum brgyar nye ba bsgrubs/ rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid zhu ba stong phrag brgal ba dang*/ rtsa rlung gi khrid zhu ba bzhi bcu tsam/ ye shes bla ma'i khrid zhu ba brgya skor bcas byung*/ de dag kyang chen po'i spom khrid dang mkhas pa'i tshig khrid tsam min par rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung bzhin khregs chod kyi rig pa dang*/ thod rgal gyi sgron bzhi'i ngo sprod sogs gnad du thengs pa byas pas rtogs ldan rgan po rnams kyang yid dbang med du 'gyur nas rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid 'di 'dra ba thos ma myong zhes zer zhing rtogs 'bul dang dgos gcod byed mkhan shin tu mang*/ 'di dus khrid thengs re la sum cu bzhi bcur mnyam du 'chad pa las/ slob ma re re nas 'chad rgyu ma byung bas lag len rtsing po lta bur song yang 'du ba ha cang mang drag pas ci byar ma byung*/ smar khams nas btegs nas bzung khro 'bar dang*/ khyad par sring mo rta lcam 'di skyel mar yod pa'i snang ba rgyun dus byung ba bsam 'grub gzhung nas/ da skyel mi dgos pas phyir log na smras kyang da dung kaḥthog gi srung ma ma mgon rnams bsu ba la slebs mi 'dug pas de rnams ma slebs bar skyel ma la 'gro dgos zhes zer/ 'di'ang sngon gyi dam tshig gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i srung ma zhig yin par mngon/ de nas lam bar du nye zho med par kaḥthog tu 'byor/

'dus sde spyi dang bye brag mchog sprul rin po che khag so sor 'tshams rtags 'bul ba mtshon tsam re phul/ 'phros kyi dngos 'byor gser dngul yod rigs rgya gor stong phrag bcu dang sum brgyar longs pa zangs mdog dpal ri'i blos bslang chen po'i gser gsol gyi rten du sbyar/ slar yang rang gnas su 'ong nas phyogs kyi 'du ba rnams la chos 'brel ci nus su byas/ sprel lo gsar tshes nang grwa lag dgon du bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs dbur 'ong dgos rgyu phyag sprul rin po ches bka' phebs don bzhin 'gro bar khas blangs/ lo gsar nang gter ston dri med rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs sar phyin/ mchod 'bul dang sku gdung rin po che zhugs su sbyangs/ zla ba gnyis pa'i mgor grwa lag tu 'gro rgyu dkrigs chod yin kyang dpal yul nas grub dbang pad+ma nor bu bsnyun tshabs che bas phebs byams la brten nas 'dir 'byor/ 7skyabs rje si tu gshegs rjes rnying phyogs la cung zad phan du re ba khong las lhag med nges la brten lhag bsam dag pas zhabs brtan mang du phul yang phan skyed cher ma byung na'ang gnas skabs dgongs 'khrol zhus nas yun ring mi 'gor bar tshur 'ong rgyu byas te grwa lag tu sgar btegs/ lam khar zhag tshugs zhig gi gsal snang la rje bdag nyid chen po dang*/ chos rje mi pham rin po che bdag gi bla ma bka' drin can gsum bzhugs 'dug pa khong rnam gnyis dpal ldan zla ba'i dbu ma'i thal bzlog la dri ba dang dri lan gnang*/ khyad par du chos can mthun snang yod med la rje rin po che dang*/ bla ma mi pham gnyis thugs hur hur 'dra zhig mdzad nas rtsod pa gnang 'dug de la nyan na go rgyu zhig snang yang bla ma bka' drin can nas/ khyod kyis byas pa'i rdzogs chen gyi khrid 'grel 'ga' re yod pa ston dang gsungs/ gzigs phul bas thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad nas go bcad 'dug zer ba zhig rmis/

rmi ltas la brtags na dgon gnas der bshad grwa legs po zhig tshugs snyam shar/ de nas grwa lag bshad sgrub gling dang nye ba zhig tu zhag tshugs byas/ phyir nangs chibs bsu ring thung mang du 'byor zhing dgon thog der slebs/ phyag sprul rin po che'i gzim khang du bsdad/ blo gsal bzhi bcur nye ba la blo gros spel slad 'jam dbyangs bstod sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang bshad lung paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti'i 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi bklag lung*/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo 'grel bkra shis mi zad pa'i sgra dbyangs/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug thog 'grel steng nas dang*/ sher 'grel ke ta ka bcas zhib bshad bgyis/ gzhan yang phyogs 'dus kha shas la kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung*/ ye shes bla ma'i khrid/ rang grol skor gsum don khrid/ sems nyid ngal gso'i gnas gsum dge ba gsum gyi don khrid bcas rdzogs mtshams shig tu/ rmi lam gyi snang char mchog sprul pad nor rin po che zhing khams gzhan du gshegs par shes te sgyu lus gyi bkod pa bzung nas phyin par khong dang mjal te bsnyun dris pas/ da nad khams 'dis lus kyi don snod phal cher zag tshar ba 'dra bas sgyu lus 'dir sdod mi spro bas 'gro grabs yin gsungs/ zhing khams gang du thugs bzhed mchis pa der bdag gis grogs dan bgyid chog zhus pas/ khong gi nged rnam shes rlung zhon gyi gdams pa la byang bas zhing gang du phyin kyang chog khyad par 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i yang snying yi ge drug ma dung phyur lhag tsam bton/ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i bsnyen pa yang de tsam bskyal/ gu ru rin po che'i zhal yang yang mjal gyin 'dug pas po ṭa la dang zangs mdog dpal ri gang du phyin kyang tshegs med/ 'on kyang nyid kyi 'od gsal snying thig gi bstan pa 'di la bya ba cher bgyid pa'i long ma byung bas de la re ba ci nas che ba dang*/

nyid kyi zhabs drung du 'dun pa che gsungs/ bdag gis skabs shig des mi phan/ karma chags med rin po ches zhing khams 'dams pa'i rta pho las bde ba can bzang gsungs pa de yin/ re zhig der phebs nas sprul pa bzung nas ci 'dod pa chog mod zhus par/ 'o na bdag skabs shig pad+ma 'od du 'gro/ phyis nas bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur bka' drin che gsungs/ de'i nyin shas nas bsnyun tshabs lci bas 'ong dgos rgyu'i bang mi 'byor/ mgyogs stabs kyis tshur 'ong*/ 'dir slebs dus dgongs pa rdzogs nas zhag lnga tsam song 'dug thugs dam bkrol ba dang yang srid myur 'byon gyi smon lam zhus/ gdung rin po che tshags su gzhug pa dang mchod pa'i sta gon rnams bsgrigs/ dpal yul nas karma yang srid dpon slob kyang 'byor/ zhag gsum tsam du gdung mchod phul/ sras a 'gyur dang skal bzang bstan 'dzin bcas phebs/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul gyi sta gon grub 'phral tshogs chen 'dus pa dang bka' brgyad bder 'dus gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi la brten nas zhugs 'bul zhus/ de'i tshe sa chen po g.yo ba dang*/ sil snyan dang rom mo'i sgra rang grags pa/ spos kyi dri 'thul ba dang*/ gdangs chen lnga'i 'ja' gur zlum po 'brel bas bar snang khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du mas gdul bya'i yid rab tu 'dun par gyur te/ de nas gdung rus bsal zhing bsdu ba dang tshags su gzhag pa sogs bgyis te dpal yul du gdan drangs/ gshegs rdzogs la bdun phrag gsum tsam du mchod 'bul byas/ de rjes skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs la chos khrid dang*/ snying thig ma bu'i dbang lung rnams bgyis/ phur pa rgyud lugs kyi dbang bskur bas phur srung gi dbang dus su gtor ma las me 'bar zhing zi ra khol ba/ khyi spyang wa dang 'phar ba'i skad thos pa sogs slob ma 'ga' re la byung*/ yang skabs shig na 7skyabs rje si tu rin po che'i yang srid khri 'don du 'ong dgos pa'i bka' rgya 'byor ba bzhin kaḥthog tu song*/

mkhyen brtse'i yang srid rin po che 'jam dbyangs blo gros rgya mtshos khri 'don gyi rdor slob rang la dgos tshul gyis bka' lung spyir phebs bzhin du zhus/ de dus rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i yang srid tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khri 'don skabs/ sde srid chen pos smin gling gter chen la bka' 'dri zhus pa'i lan gnang ba de bzhin tshogs chen 'dus pa'i byang sems dbang gi skabs nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin bgyis te rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag tu mnga' gsol ba lags so// rang lo bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'i ston kha rmi lam zhig la tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho dang*/ gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nged dpon slob gcig dang tha dad kyi rnam dbye mi 'byed pa zhig tu dre'u dkar mo zhig la dpe cha rgyab gcig bkal nas song*/ sa tshugs shig tu chu dang me shing bsdus/ tsha ja bskol bas thab ka'i g.yas phyogs su me tog ser po phub tsam pa gsum dang*/ g.yon phyogs su me tog dmar po phub tsam bdun skyes 'dug tshar chen rin po cher 'di'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas ser po gsum 'di nged da dung rgyal bstan gzhir bzhengs su slong ba'i dge slong gsum gyi skye ba len dgos pa'i rtags dang*/ dmar po 'di dag khyed phyin chad sngags pa khyad par can bdun gyi skye ba len dgos pa'i brda yin gsungs pa 'di gang lags zhus pas/ kong po bu chu lha khang dang nye ba bde skyid khang gsar ma lags sam gsungs/ rang lo nga lnga par rkyen sel bcad rgya'i khul gyis gter chen rat+na gling pa'i gter byon phur pa yang gsang bla med 'di gu ru rin po che'i thugs kyi mnog chos mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la lhag chad snon phri med par gnang ba'i zab chos bla na med pa yin pas/ de'i bsnyen pa bskyal bas ci zhig na rmi lam gyi snang char mon kha ne ring seng ge rdzong du phyin snang la/

chu mig ring mo zhig gi mgor brag skyibs shin tu nyams dga' bar slebs/ der phur sgrom gyi dkyil 'khor zhig gi steng gnam lcags kyi phur pa dar dpyangs sngon po g.yo ba me stag gi tshwa tshwa phrom phrom 'phro ba zhig mjal ba la mos gus gyis gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid gnas 'gyur tshul gyis mtsho rgyal gyi skur gyur/ de'i mdun du gu ru'i thugs zin gyi gzungs ma a tsar sa le sgrub g.yog gi rnam pas bzhugs snang*/ bdag gis mos gus drag pos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa'i// sku yi dbyig tu sras bskyed cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ mtsho rgyal gyi mdun du gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i phur gdan gcig las ko mog la rdo bskyur ba lta bu rim par mched de dbus su gtso bo'i lha gnas gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba thod pa'i ra ba'i mu khyud can gyi phyi rol du sras mchog gi gnas su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ de'i phyi rol du phyogs mtshams khro bo brgyad kyi gnas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ gzhal yas khang gi gnam sgor steng gi khro bo'i gnas nyi gdan/ gtso bo'i gdan gru gsum khong seng gi rnam pas khyams kyi thad so'i bar thur du zug pa'i rtse mo zur gsum/ mdun du sgo dod par 'og gi khro bo'i gdan bcas snang*/ der mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud 'dra ba zhig gsungs te thugs ka nas gnam lcags gyi phur pa re re spros te/ lha gnas so sor phur sgrom gyi rnam par bkod pa dang de nyid gnas gyur gyis rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bkra lam gyis shar zhing a tsar sa le las rdor gyi tshul mdzad nas phur ṭīka 'bum nag nang na bzhugs pa'i dbang de nyid gnang zin pa dang*/ dam can gyi dbang gi mgor las kyi rdo rjes shugs glu ring po zhig btang song ba dang mnyam du skad cig gis dam can ma mo bcu gnyis sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa spungs se byon pa la bka' bsgo ba'i tshul gyis srog dbang zhig gnang*/

mtsho rgyal zhus lan rad gling gter byon de gnang bar gsol ba btab kyang*/ phur ṭīka 'di nged kyis gu ru rin po cher zhus pa slob dpon rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa yin pas 'di bshad pa khag che gsungs nas gnang*/ de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum mtsho rgyal la thim/ dam can gyi dkyil 'khor a tsar sa le la thim/ mtsho rgyal gnas gyur te gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa hūm̐ yig mthing kas mtshan pa hūm̐ gi sgra 'u ru ru grags pa zhig tu gyur/ de'ang nam mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal bas rang gi rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa yul chos nyid skye ba med par thim nas gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa zhi ba'i dbyings su re zhig rtog med du lus song*/ de nas yang nyams snang zhig la/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas sku nyams ha cang bgres pa/ na bza' bzang gos smug po chig rkyang mnabs pa zhig mjal/ sngar gter mdzod kyi dbang lung tshar gsum bton pa la thugs dgyes tshul mdzad/ khong gi gter byon yum bka' mkha' 'gro gsang thig 'di khyod kyi chos skal yin pas da lam dbang zhig bskur dgos gsungs nas dbang dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i rgyud ngo mtshar ba zhig kyang gnang*/ deng sang gi dus na bstan 'gro'i phan bde sgrub pa'i gnyer kha khyod rang la babs kyang spros med lugs su bgyi ba 'di gyong che gsungs/ gzhan yang lung bstan gyi rnam pa mang du gnang ba ni dgos pa med pas ma bris so// de ltar deng sang lnga brgya'i tha ma 'dir// yul dus dman pas 'gro ba'i 'dren pa snyigs// dad brtson blo gros shes rab shugs zhan pas// yang dag rnam thar rgya cher 'god du ci// 'on kyang mkhas dang grub brnyes bshes gnyen 'gas// rjes bzung zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi mdzod// thos bsam sgom pa lhur blangs sbyangs brtson mthus// rang rgyud cung zad dul 'di dam pa'i drin// mkhas mang mgu ba'i tshig gi sdebs sbyor med// grub pa brnyes pa'i lam gyi mngon rtogs ci// de lta na'ang sgro skur mtha' spangs nas// rang tshul ma gsang drang por brjod pa lags// bdag gi rjes su 'jug pa'i las can rnams// brgyud pa'i dgongs par ras chod gzu lum dang*// phri bsnan med pa man ngag kha mi gcig

/bslad du mi btub yid ches phyir du bris// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung te// da lta yan chad tshig gis ma bslad cing*// don gyi dgongs pa gcig thog gcig babs pa// dngos rdzas lag brgyud rgyal po'i bka' rtags ltar// de yang byin rlabs don brgyud bar ma chad// tshig brgyud bka' brgyud bar ma chad pa'i don// yid dpyod mi rnyed gsang mchog nges pa'i babs// bsod nams bsags pa'i skal ldan yid ches gnas// tshig don rnam bkra'i ye ge bris pa'i mthus// 'gro blo'i rmongs pa ma lus rab bsal nas// rdzogs pa chen po'i don la spyod pa dang*// don gnyis phun tshogs 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /

ces pa 'di yang sngar sde snod 'dzin pa du mas bskul ba dang*/ khyad par mchog sprul 'gyur med rdo rje dang*/ mkhan rin po che legs bshad 'byor ldan dang nus ldan rnam gnyis/ sprul sku dkon mchog grags pa sogs rig par smra ba'i bshes gnyen du mas snga phyir yang yang bskul ba don yod par bya ba'i phyir pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis rang gnas ljon pa lung nas sbyar bas bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong 'bras kyis rang rig kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cig dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/// /
